_about: STAGED TEST ARTIFACT — NOT wired into production. Validated source-ACCESS layer for the collector, built from the 5 audited source workbooks (Greece, Albania, Bosnia & Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Croatia). One entry per domain: how to reach it (route_tier), the tested endpoint/download, a recommended collection method, refresh cadence, and a live-verification reliability flag. Agents 1-6 should load their workstream slice (source_registry_A#.json) as a VALIDATED STARTING-SOURCE LIST before free-searching, so access is reused across runs instead of re-discovered. route_tier: 1-api / 2-download (tested, cheapest) · 3-html_scrape · 4-browser_session (JS/anti-bot) · 5-manual. reliability: verified = Claude re-hit it live; recheck = likely dead, re-test before use; unverified = trust the audit but not yet live-checked. COVERAGE: 5 of 17 footprint countries; the other 12 (incl. CY/AT/SI/SK/RO/HU/CZ) need their own source workbooks first. [v2: API-tier entries now carry a `worked_example` ready-to-run query; use it verbatim to avoid burning fetches on query-tuning.]

data.gov.gr.resource_type: JSON API (CKAN Action API) / statistics portal
data.gov.gr.recommended_method: GET CKAN Action API, no auth. Enumerate via https://data.gov.gr/api/3/action/package_search?rows=100&start=0 and paginate start+=100 (count=22662). Filter by org: q=organization:trapeza-tis-ellados (Bank of Greece), organization:aade-2026 (AADE), organization:eadhsy (procurement). For each dataset use package_show?id=<slug> to get resource file URLs; download CSV/XLSX/PDF directly, or use datastore_search?resource_id=<id> for row-level tabular data. Reproducible with plain curl, JSON responses.

api.method: GET (organization_list/package_list accept GET; write actions need POST — read actions all GET)
api.params: package_search: rows, start (pagination), q (e.g. q=organization:trapeza-tis-ellados), fq, sort, facet fields. organization_show?id=<slug>&include_datasets=true. package_show?id=<slug-or-uuid>. datastore_search?resource_id=<id>&limit=&offset= for tabular resources.
api.headers: None required. Optional Authorization: <ckan-api-key> only for private/write; all read access is anonymous.
api.auth_needed: No (open, no token; a registration-based token existed on the OLD portal but is not needed on the current CKAN instance)

download.url: https://data.gov.gr/api/3/action/package_show?id=<dataset-slug> (resource objects contain direct file 'url' for xlsx/csv/pdf/json downloads)
download.type: per-resource files (CSV/XLSX/PDF/JSON/XML) linked inside dataset resources; also DataStore export via datastore_search

data.gov.gr.next_action: Build harvester against /api/3/action/package_search with pagination; map target orgs (Bank of Greece, AADE, EADHSY, OAED/DYPA, Ethniko Typografeio) to their org slugs and pull dataset resource URLs. No auth or browser session needed.

Legacy /api/v1/query token API is gone (404) but the standard CKAN Action API fully replaces it and is open. organization_list requires POST (GET returns a 'use POST' message) but organization_show/package_search cover the same need via GET. Harvester extensions present include bank_of_greece_harvester, confirming ongoing Bank of Greece ingestion.

Transparency & law transposition docs: /aweb/portalfiles/*.pdf. EN versions available via /en/ and /en_US/ path prefixes; EL via /el/ and /el_GR/.

Standard WebFetch cannot be used because it upgrades to HTTPS; use curl/HTTP-capable fetcher. Prospectuses (deltia / deltia12minou / deltiaprotaseon12minou) render via ?apg= pagination and per-document links were not visible in the raw HTML page 1/2 fetched — worth a browser confirmation, but the dominant download pattern (vdrv + aweb PDFs) is confirmed working. be24.gr.recommended_method: Scrape the public marketing/service pages for platform intelligence only (headline stats such as number of e-auctions and e-procurement volume). payments360.boussiasevents.gr.next_action: Scrape speakers/sponsors/agenda and Presentations downloads; refresh per edition.

Statistics detail pages contain no HTML <table> and no download/export buttons - figures are in prose plus PNG charts, so scrape text. Financial statements are direct-download PDFs (verified). No API/XHR needed. 2024 annual report PDF is ~21.6MB - fetch on demand only, not repeatedly.

eba.europa.eu.resource_type: JSON API (register) + statistics/reports portal with CSV/Excel/PDF/JSON downloads
eba.europa.eu.recommended_method: For registers: hit the EUCLID JSON API directly with curl - GET https://euclid.eba.europa.eu/register/cir-api/metadata (CIR) or .../pir-api/metadata (PSD2), then POST https://euclid.eba.europa.eu/register/api/search/entities with JSON body {searchkeys, dataCollectionCode, page, size} to page through entities, and GET /register/api/entity/read/{id}.{type} for details; no auth. For a full-register bulk 'golden copy' JSON, capture the one filemetadata request the registerDownload page issues (GET .../{pir-api|cir-api}/filemetadata returns 404 without its params) to obtain golden_copy_path_context + file path, then GET that file. For market stats/disclosures: scrape/download the CSV+Excel from the transparency-exercise page and the linked PDF/press-release pages on www.eba.europa.eu.

api.endpoint: Metadata: GET https://euclid.eba.europa.eu/register/pir-api/metadata and https://euclid.eba.europa.eu/register/cir-api/metadata ; NCA list: GET .../pir-api/metadata_nca_list and .../cir-api/metadata_nca_list ; Search: POST https://euclid.eba.europa.eu/register/api/search/entities ; Single entity: GET https://euclid.eba.europa.eu/register/api/entity/read/{id}.{type} ; Related entities: GET .../cir-api/relatedEntities/{id}
api.params: Base URLs from SPA config: API_BASE_URL=/register/api, PIR_API_BASE_URL=/register/pir-api (PSD2 payment/EMI register), CIR_API_BASE_URL=/register/cir-api (credit institutions register). search/entities POST body includes searchkeys[], dataCollectionCode (e.g. PSD_MD / CIR_MD), page, size. entity/read takes {entityCode}.{entityType}.
api.headers: Accept: application/json; for POST search Content-Type: application/json. No auth/session header required.
api.auth_needed: No (public, free; no login/cookie/token needed - verified reproducible with curl outside a browser)

download.url: https://www.eba.europa.eu/risk-and-data-analysis/risk-analysis/eu-wide-transparency-exercise (full-database CSV + data dictionary/metadata Excel + PDF reports); register full 'golden copy' JSON download via https://euclid.eba.europa.eu/register/pir/registerDownload

eba.europa.eu.next_action: Build a paginated client against POST /register/api/search/entities for both CIR and PSD2 registers (loop page=0..N). For the bulk JSON golden-copy, do one browser network capture on https://euclid.eba.europa.eu/register/pir/registerDownload to learn the filemetadata params. Separately schedule periodic pulls of transparency-exercise CSV and consumer-trends/stress-test PDFs. Note: EU-wide transparency exercise is being discontinued (from June 2025) in favour of the Pillar 3 Data Hub - add that as a successor source.
eba.europa.eu.notes: All 15 sample URLs reachable (200); older-style paths auto-redirect to current /risk-and-data-analysis/... structure, so no dead links. EUCLID register is an Angular SPA but its backend JSON API is fully reproducible with curl (js_used=false). Registers updated by NCAs at least daily. Data also mirrored on data.europa.eu (dataset 'credit-institutions-register'). Transparency exercise discontinued from June 2025 -> successor: Pillar 3 Data Hub. filemetadata endpoint needs exact params (one browser capture) for the bulk golden-copy download only; search API needs no such capture.
eba.europa.eu.worked_example: GET https://euclid.eba.europa.eu/register/api/search/institutions?... (EUCLID public register JSON, no auth).

groupcenterhellas.com.recommended_method: Scrape corporate/service pages for vendor-profile intel only; no tender or dataset feed. Use browser UA (WebFetch hung once; curl with UA returns 200).

groupcenterhellas.com.notes: Regional CIT competitor; corporate site, no structured data.

hcaa.gov.gr.recommended_method: Scrape Drupal newsroom lists (/el/newsroom/announcements, /el/newsroom/press-releases); content is CMS-rendered (Drupal avtheme) with dynamic loading — a browser session or Drupal JSON:API (/jsonapi) may be needed. Filter announcements for διαγωνισμός/πρόσκληση.

hcg.gr.next_action: Confirm pagination param and URL-encode Greek category strings.
hcg.gr.notes: Server-rendered, scrapeable, dedicated procurement category filter.

iclg.com.recommended_method: Scrape the free on-page HTML chapter text (no auth needed for reading). Do NOT attempt the PDF — it requires registration/purchase (Single User PDF £295). Reference/context content, updated ~annually.

statistics.gr.resource_type: statistics portal (HTML pages with XLS + PDF downloads)
statistics.gr.recommended_method: Scrape each thematic publication page (e.g. /en/statistics/-/publication/<CODE>/-) for its XLS document links (per-table time-series files) and PDF press releases; download XLS files directly. No auth. Monitor /en/calendar for release dates. Both EN (/en/) and Greek (/el/) versions exist. Publication codes in tracker: SEL39, DKT39, DKT42, DKT45, DKT87, SEL84, SFA20, plus /statistics/pop and /statistics/ind topic indexes.

download.type: XLS (Excel time series) + PDF press release

statistics.gr.next_action: Build collector that enumerates the ~11 tracked publication codes, parses each page for XLS/PDF document links, and downloads on the schedule shown in the release calendar. Optionally request login credentials if the high-value open-data subportal (elstatmis.statistics.gr) datasets are needed.
statistics.gr.notes: All 11 sample URLs on www.statistics.gr are reachable (HTTP 200). Publication pages deliver data as downloadable XLS spreadsheets plus PDF press releases (document-ID based links). The separate 'High Value Open Data' subportal at elstatmis.statistics.gr requires login and is NOT covered here. No public REST/SDMX JSON API surfaced on the main portal. No dead sample URLs.
statistics.gr.worked_example: Browse https://www.statistics.gr/en/statistics → open the relevant release → scrape its XLSX/CSV download link (no API).

optimabank.gr.resource_type: HTML page (register of announcements) + PDF downloads
optimabank.gr.recommended_method: Scrape the static HTML announcements list at /about-us/investor-relations/stoixeia-metoxis/stoixeia-metoxis-anakoinoseis/ (chronological, non-paginated, no auth) to harvest PDF links under /media/<slug>/*.pdf; GET each PDF directly (no auth, supports range requests). Same pattern for financial results and newsroom pages. GR and EN mirrors exist via /en/ prefix.

download.type: PDF (announcements); ESG factsheet available as XLSX

optimabank.gr.next_action: Set up periodic scrape of announcements + financial results HTML lists and download new /media PDFs; optionally capture ESG XLSX factsheet. Monitor newsroom for A1 disclosures and HR page for A5 job intent.
optimabank.gr.notes: Corporate site of Optima Bank (Athens Stock Exchange listed). Fully static, no JS/API needed. Both Greek (default) and English (/en/) versions available. Announcements are individual PDFs under /media/. All 10 sample URLs live; none dead.

devs.kariera.gr.recommended_method: Scrape HTML listing at https://www.kariera.gr/en/jobs/it-jobs (paginate with ?page=N); each job detail at /en/jobs/it-jobs/<id>. Greek variant at kariera.gr/jobs.
devs.kariera.gr.next_action: Switch tracker source to www.kariera.gr/en/jobs/it-jobs and scrape paginated listing
devs.kariera.gr.notes: Sample URL https://devs.kariera.gr/category/jobs/ is dead (subdomain no longer in DNS). ~190 IT jobs currently listed on main board. Good A5 hiring/early-intent signal.

ft.com.recommended_method: Requires FT subscription + browser session; Cloudflare blocks automated fetches. Use licensed feed/RSS with logged-in session, or manual monitoring. RSS available at https://www.ft.com/greece?format=rss (subject to entitlement).

ft.com.next_action: Confirm FT licensing; if subscribed use authenticated browser session or RSS. Otherwise treat as manual monitoring.
ft.com.notes: Cloudflare 403 to bots and paywalled content. Not reproducible outside an authenticated browser session.

myergani.gov.gr.recommended_method: Portal itself needs employer TAXISnet login - not scrapable. For A5 labour-flow intent signals, collect the monthly ERGANI reports/statistics published on the Ministry of Labour site (ypergasias.gov.gr) instead.
myergani.gov.gr.next_action: Use it only as identity of ERGANI system; source public ERGANI monthly reports from ypergasias.gov.gr for actual data
myergani.gov.gr.notes: Login-gated employer filing system (Microsoft-IIS/ASP.NET). No public data behind homepage.

sifted.eu.recommended_method: Cloudflare blocks automated fetches; much content is subscriber-gated. Use authenticated browser session for monitoring, or RSS if entitled. Manual monitoring otherwise.
sifted.eu.next_action: Confirm subscription; use browser session. Good A6 competitor/vendor intel but not bot-accessible.
sifted.eu.notes: Cloudflare 403 to non-browser clients. A6 startup ecosystem source.

mydocman.gr.recommended_method: Homepage reachable (200) but the searchable case/appeal database requires account registration. Needs authenticated session; treat as manual/subscription source. For open A2 pre-contractual appeal data use AEPP (aepp-procurement.gr) or Diavgeia instead.
mydocman.gr.next_action: Verify subscription terms; otherwise substitute official open sources (AEPP decisions, Diavgeia, ESIDIS/promitheus)
mydocman.gr.notes: Not an open tender database; it is a paid/registered legal-document library. A2 relevance is indirect (pre-contractual appeal rulings).

piraeusbank.coupahost.com.next_action: Confirm whether Piraeus publishes public RFPs elsewhere; this portal is supplier-login only
piraeusbank.coupahost.com.notes: Coupa-hosted supplier portal behind SSO; no anonymous access to tender data.

atpsyte.gr.recommended_method: Scrape the Drupal listing HTML (view block 'blog_modern_prokiryxeis') at /el/prokiryxeis-diagonismoi; follow node links and download linked PDFs from /sites/default/files/. No auth.
atpsyte.gr.notes: A2 tenders. Cloudflare present but allows curl with UA; WebFetch alone got 403. Content is static/server-rendered.

estr.aml-authority.gov.gr.recommended_method: Scrape/monitor the public Authority site www.aml-authority.gov.gr for announcements, guidance and reporting deadlines. The eSTR portal itself is a login-only reporting tool with no public data.
estr.aml-authority.gov.gr.error_reason: estr subdomain returns only a JS 'Node' shell (login-gated reporting portal)
estr.aml-authority.gov.gr.next_action: Monitor www.aml-authority.gov.gr announcements for A3 regulation/deadlines
estr.aml-authority.gov.gr.notes: A3 regulation. eSTR = submission portal only (not a collectible dataset). Use parent authority site.

lexology.com.recommended_method: Cloudflare blocks automated fetches (403); full articles need free Lexology registration. Use authenticated browser session or licensed feed. Individual Greece banking/fintech articles at /library/detail.aspx?g=<guid>.
lexology.com.error_reason: HTTP 404 on /index/report/banking-fintech via curl and 403 (Cloudflare) on homepage/WebFetch
lexology.com.next_action: Access via registered browser session; collect specific Greece banking/fintech article GUIDs
lexology.com.notes: A3. Aggregator content is Cloudflare-protected and registration-gated; the exact sample /index/report/banking-fintech returns 404 to bots. Article-level GUID URLs are the real content.

euromoney.com.resource_type: HTML page (article index + per-country winner articles)
euromoney.com.recommended_method: Scrape HTML. Start from all-results index and country-award archive (https://www.euromoney.com/awards-articles/country-award/), follow the yearly 'national winners ... Greece' article URLs. Server-rendered content is retrievable without JS/login. Full award-entry portal (euromoney.awardsplatform.com) requires submission login and is not needed for winner lists.
euromoney.com.next_action: Enumerate yearly national-winners Greece article URLs and scrape winner tables; optionally also Transaction Banking / Cash Management award pages.
euromoney.com.notes: Public winner pages are readable; the separate awardsplatform.com entry portal is login-only but not required for collection. Sample URLs all reachable.

thefoundation.gr.recommended_method: Download the annual XLSX/PDF from the publications page. Direct PDF returns HTTP 200 application/pdf (content-length ~3.88 MB). Scrape the /our-publications/startups-in-greece/ page each December for the new year's PDF link (WordPress /wp-content/uploads/ path).
thefoundation.gr.next_action: Collect all historical PDFs (2017-2025) from the page; monitor page for next annual edition.
thefoundation.gr.notes: High-value A2/A6 source: VC funding stats, deal counts, investor lists. FWD Greece Innovation Pulse is an interactive ecosystem map on the same publications hub.

gfmag.com.recommended_method: Scrape HTML. Paginate the awards-ranking hub (52 pages) and winner-announcements list; filter articles mentioning Greece / Best Bank in Greece. Server-rendered, no auth.
gfmag.com.next_action: Search within gfmag.com for 'Greece' award articles and scrape winner tables per award cycle.
gfmag.com.notes: No Greece-only landing page; Greek winners are inside global/regional/country award articles reachable via the winner-announcements feed.

fintechhub.gr.recommended_method: Scrape HTML. Events page is server-side rendered with full event details (name, date, description); parse the listing and per-event pages (e.g. /events/fintech-athens-40).
fintechhub.gr.next_action: Scrape events list on a schedule for new Fintech Athens / Fintech Talks entries (A5 early-intent, A3 regulation topics).

greekreporter.com.resource_type: HTML page / news tag archive (RSS expected but blocked)
greekreporter.com.recommended_method: Browser session / headless browser with real user-agent needed. Cloudflare bot protection blocks plain HTTP. Alternatively harvest article URLs via WebSearch/site: queries then fetch through a rendering fetcher. RSS (/feed/, /tag/greek-banks/feed/) is also 403.

greekreporter.com.notes: Site is a WordPress news site (feeds normally exist) but WAF returns 403 to automated clients. Content itself is public; only bot-blocking prevents reproduction.

withplum.com.recommended_method: Scrape HTML press page for media-kit/contact; for actual news, rely on external press-release trackers/WebSearch since the page has no dated release list or RSS. Note /press and /press/ redirect to localized /gr-gr/press.
withplum.com.next_action: Monitor external outlets for Plum announcements; use press-kit page only for assets/contact. Consider checking withplum.com/en or blog for news posts.

bpcbt.com.recommended_method: Scrape HTML blog listing at /blog (tag-based) plus /en/press and /case-studies; HubSpot CMS so pages are server-rendered and curl-reachable. Try /blog/rss for a feed.
bpcbt.com.next_action: Set up periodic scrape of /blog and /en/press; filter for Greece/DIAS/SmartVista keywords
bpcbt.com.notes: Sample URL is a single 2020 blog post about DIAS Greece; still live. Vendor (A2/A6) content.

bde.es.recommended_method: GET the .csv sibling of the .html page, no auth. Tested: HTTP 200, text/csv, 57KB, header row EUROPEAN CODE,LEI,NAME,ADDRESS,OPERATOR,PROVIDER,SMALL PSP,GEOGRAPHIC SCOPE,DEROGATION,TYPE OF LICENCE. Data timestamped (2026/07/16) so poll periodically.

bde.es.notes: Directly relevant A2/A4 source. Swap 'en' for 'es' in path for Spanish version; same CSV.

digital-finance.gr.recommended_method: Poll RSS at https://digital-finance.gr/feed; also scrape category pages (PayTech, BankTech, FinTech). WordPress site so /wp-json/wp/v2/posts REST API likely also available for structured pulls.
digital-finance.gr.next_action: Subscribe to /feed and verify WordPress REST /wp-json/wp/v2/posts for filtering by category
digital-finance.gr.notes: Greek-language early-intent/market news (A5/A6). Newsletter and quarterly magazine also exist.

epco.lu.recommended_method: Scrape the 'Joint Procurements / Procurement & Contract Opportunities' page for active joint tenders and lead-central-bank info; download conference PDFs. Actual tender notices are published on lead central banks' portals and TED, not hosted here.
epco.lu.next_action: Monitor the Joint Procurements page; cross-reference joint tenders on TED for full notices
epco.lu.notes: A2. Coordinating body only; real notices flow to TED/lead-bank sites.

kathimerini.gr.recommended_method: Scrape the /economy/ HTML listing for article links/titles/dates; use English mirror ekathimerini.com/economy for EN. Check for /feed or category RSS. Some articles may be metered/paywalled for full text.
kathimerini.gr.next_action: Set up scrape/RSS of economy section filtered for banking/payments keywords; confirm any subscription wall on full articles
kathimerini.gr.notes: General economic news (A2/A5 signal). Homepage/section reachable; individual article paywalling not fully tested.

developer.ted.europa.eu.recommended_method: POST JSON to https://api.ted.europa.eu/v3/notices/search with expert query filtering buyer-country=GRC plus CPV/keyword for payments; paginate via page + paginationMode=PAGE_NUMBER. No auth. Tested: returned notices array with publication-number and XML/PDF links. Docs at docs.ted.europa.eu/api/latest, Swagger at api.ted.europa.eu/swagger-ui.

api.params: JSON body: query (expert query e.g. buyer-country=GRC), fields[] (e.g. publication-number, notice-title), limit, page/paginationMode (PAGE_NUMBER), scope, checkQuerySyntax
api.format: JSON (per-notice links to XML and multilingual PDF)
api.auth_needed: No (open to reusers; no API key required)

developer.ted.europa.eu.next_action: Build expert-query filters (country=GR, relevant CPV codes) and schedule daily pulls
developer.ted.europa.eu.notes: Primary A2 tender source EU-wide. Landing developer.ted.europa.eu is the portal; live API is api.ted.europa.eu.

vivawallet.com.recommended_method: Scrape https://www.viva.com/en-eu/blog (200) for corporate news; no dedicated /newsroom (404). Supplement with PRNewswire and medium.com/vivawalletblog/tagged/press-release. Verify JS rendering; use browser session if listing is client-rendered.
vivawallet.com.error_reason: vivawallet.com HEAD returned empty; /en-eu/newsroom and /newsroom/press-releases = HTTP 404
vivawallet.com.next_action: Confirm blog listing structure (static vs JS) and set up scrape; add PRNewswire/Medium feeds as backup
vivawallet.com.notes: Corporate rebranded to viva.com. No single newsroom page; blog is the closest official listing. A2/A6.

dieboldnixdorf.com.recommended_method: Scrape investors.dieboldnixdorf.com/news-and-events/press-releases (IR platform, year-indexed URLs .../press-releases/news-details/2026/...) or news.dieboldnixdorf.com/press-releases. IR sites usually expose an RSS feed - check for one.
dieboldnixdorf.com.error_reason: Original www.dieboldnixdorf.com/en-us/about-us/newsroom/ returns a soft-404 (curl 200 but WebFetch rendered 'Page Not Found'); press-releases subpath also 404
dieboldnixdorf.com.next_action: Use IR press-releases page; verify/subscribe to its RSS; filter for Europe/Greece/payments/ATM POS items
dieboldnixdorf.com.notes: Sample newsroom URL is dead/soft-404. IR domain is the working replacement. A2/A6 vendor.

emvco.com.recommended_method: Simplest reliable path: scrape server-rendered pagination at /approved-products/page/N/ (tested page/2 = HTTP 200; ~342 pages at default page size) and parse the product table; each row has a Download PDF (LoA). Alternatively reverse-engineer the admin-ajax.php action for JSON. Guessed custom REST /wp-json/emvco/v1/approved-products returned 404.

api.params: WordPress admin-ajax action=<approved-products handler>, with per_page and pagination (data-direction next/prev) params; exact action name not confirmed

emvco.com.error_reason: Custom REST route guess 404; admin-ajax action name not captured (would need browser network inspection)
emvco.com.next_action: Inspect XHR on the page in a browser to capture the exact admin-ajax action+params; otherwise scrape /page/N/ HTML
emvco.com.notes: A6 vendor/competitor intel. Data is accessible without login; only the precise AJAX contract is unconfirmed. HTML pagination scrape is a solid fallback.

eyath.gr.recommended_method: Scrape https://www.eyath.gr/diagonismoi/ HTML list (each tender = title link, deadline, CPV, KIMDIS/ESIDIS refs, PDF links). Note the sample URL /tender-procedures/ 301-redirects to /diagonismoi/. Year/month sidebar archives allow historical crawl.
eyath.gr.next_action: Scrape /diagonismoi/ periodically; also mirror same notices via TED for structured data
eyath.gr.notes: Sample URL /tender-procedures/ redirects (use /diagonismoi/). A2 tender source, single utility.

linkedin.com.recommended_method: Authenticated browser session required. HEAD on company URLs returns HTTP 200 but the GET body is an auth wall (Sign in / Join now); profile URLs (/in/*) return HTTP 405 to non-browser clients. For later collection: use a logged-in LinkedIn account via a real browser session (human-in-the-loop / manual) to read Jobs tabs and company posts, OR apply for official LinkedIn Marketing Developer Platform / Community Management API (OAuth + partner approval). Automated unauthenticated scraping is blocked by anti-bot and violates LinkedIn ToS — do not attempt.
linkedin.com.error_reason: Auth wall / login required (company pages GET body = Sign in/Join now; /in/ profiles HTTP 405 to non-browser). Anti-bot enforcement.
linkedin.com.next_action: Route to manual/authenticated-session workflow: maintain a logged-in LinkedIn session (or approved API partner credentials) and collect Jobs-tab postings and company updates for the tracked GR banking/payments entities. Do not queue for unauthenticated automated fetch.
linkedin.com.notes: Single-domain batch (n=23 across many GR banking/payments company pages + executive profiles). All sample company URLs reachable but auth-walled; profile URLs return 405 to non-browser clients. Login/ToS/anti-bot blocks reproducible automated collection. No dead URLs — all resolve, just gated.

athens.euronext.com.resource_type: HTML page (server-rendered listing) + JSON AJAX endpoint (Drupal views/ajax)
athens.euronext.com.recommended_method: Primary: scrape the server-rendered HTML listing at /en/market-data/announcements (and /el/... for Greek-only items, and /en/market-data/issuers/<id>/announcements for issuer-specific, e.g. 63=Piraeus). Announcement rows (node links, titles, dates, categories) are present in the initial HTML — no JS execution needed. For deeper pagination, POST to https://athens.euronext.com/en/views/ajax with view_name=issuer_announcements_solr, view_display_id=block_1, page=N and a browser User-Agent; parse the JSON AJAX 'insert' command HTML. Individual announcement detail pages at /en/more-options/announcements/announcement-<id> return full HTML. Always send a real browser UA.

api.params: view_name=issuer_announcements_solr; view_display_id=block_1; view_path=%2Fmarket-data%2Fannouncements; view_dom_id=<hash from page drupalSettings>; pager_element=0; page=<0-based page index>; _drupal_ajax=1; ajax_page_state[theme]=euronext. For per-issuer feed use the issuer's page (view_display_id/view_dom_id differ per page; scrape drupalSettings JSON from that page first).
api.format: JSON (Drupal AJAX command array: 'settings' + 'insert' commands whose 'data' field contains the HTML fragment of announcement rows with node/<id> links)
api.headers: X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest; Accept: application/json, text/javascript, */*; User-Agent required (default curl/WebFetch model-fetch is 403-blocked; a normal browser UA returns 200)
api.auth_needed: No (no login/cookies required; tested reproducibly outside a browser with curl)

athens.euronext.com.next_action: Build a collector that scrapes the HTML listing rows (title/date/issuer/category/node-url) and follows node links for detail; optionally use /views/ajax POST for pagination. Enumerate issuer IDs (63=Piraeus, 858, 50, 278, 1498, 57) for issuer-scoped feeds. Note that many Greek-only announcements have EN placeholder titles ('no English translation available') so also collect from /el/. Separately, the Daily Price Bulletin (Ημερήσιο Δελτίο Τιμών) is a distinct resource worth a dedicated lookup if price data is needed.
athens.euronext.com.notes: Site is Drupal 10 on the Euronext platform. All 15 sample URLs (incl. HERMES tech page, per-issuer announcement feeds, market-data root, trading-issuers) returned HTTP 200 — none dead. Key gotcha: the default WebFetch/model fetch is 403-blocked; a standard browser User-Agent is required for both HTML scraping and the AJAX API, but NO authentication/cookies are needed. HERMES (H.E.R.ME.S) is the regulated-disclosure dissemination system; its announcements surface through the same announcements feed. Sample_names referenced a Daily Price Bulletin archive not directly in the URL list — recommend a follow-up lookup for that market-statistics (A4) resource.
athens.euronext.com.worked_example: POST https://athens.euronext.com/en/views/ajax with a real browser User-Agent header (Drupal views AJAX) → announcement rows; issuer id in params. UA REQUIRED.

hellenicparliament.gr.recommended_method: Poll the RSS feeds via plain GET (no auth, no cookies, no JS): RssSubmittedBills.aspx and RssLegislativeWork.aspx for bill tracking, RssCommission.aspx / RssReportsFindings.aspx for committee work, RssNews.aspx?catid=... for reports/press. Parse RSS XML, follow item link law_id to the bill page, and scrape the linked PDF document URLs for full text. Feeds carry latest items; for historical/full backfill use the HTML search page /Nomothetiko-Ergo/Anazitisi-Nomothetikou-Ergou (paginated HTML tables, scrapeable).

api.params: RssNews.aspx takes catid=<GUID> category id; the legislative feeds take no params (latest items only)
api.format: RSS 2.0 XML (UTF-8, Greek). Item link points to per-bill page e.g. /Nomothetiko-Ergo/Katatethenta-Nomosxedia/?law_id=<guid>

download.type: PDF (per-bill: explanatory report, bill text, General Accounting Office report)

hellenicparliament.gr.next_action: For collection: schedule periodic pulls of the legislative RSS feeds, dedupe on item link/law_id GUID, and fetch per-bill PDFs. For historical coverage build an HTML scraper for the paginated Anazitisi-Nomothetikou-Ergou search.
hellenicparliament.gr.notes: All 12 sample URLs reachable (HTTP 200). The /rss sample URL is a hub page listing the real feed endpoints under /rssfeed/*.aspx. Feeds are the cleanest structured source; bill pages expose PDFs but there is no bulk export. Content is Greek only.

hdb.gr.recommended_method: GET RSS feed https://hdb.gr/category/prokyrikseis/feed/ (tenders) and https://hdb.gr/category/theseis-ergasias/feed/ (jobs), no auth; parse XML items. For full HTML detail scrape the category HTML pages (paginated /page/N/). WP REST API is disabled (rest_disabled 403), use feeds instead.

api.params: paged=N appended to category feed for older items

hdb.gr.next_action: Set up periodic pull of the two category RSS feeds; scrape detail pages for attached PDFs
hdb.gr.notes: WordPress site. WebFetch and WP REST API are blocked/disabled but plain curl (200) and RSS feeds work fine. English site at /en/ also live.

eopyy.gov.gr.recommended_method: Scrape HTML list at https://eopyy.gov.gr/el/articles/competitions paginating via the page-size/page parameters; follow each item's 'Διαβάστε περισσότερα' detail page for attached PDFs.

Response fields: total, results[] (id, shortcode, title, location{country,city,region,display}, department[], type, remote, workplace, published, state). Account slug is the path segment from the board URL (e.g. piraeus-bank, viva, mellongroup, withplum, natech, printec, snappibank, aegean-baltic-bank, cardlink-sa, manpowergroup-greece-1, epay). The visible board is JS-rendered but the underlying POST api/v3 JSON API is fully reproducible without a browser, so no JS/session needed for collection. cardlink-sa returns total:0 (valid, currently no open roles). The 'euronet-eft' board page loads (200) but POST api/v3/accounts/euronet-eft/jobs returned 'Not Found' — the API account slug differs from the URL path segment for this employer; resolve the real slug from the board's network calls or use snapshot fallback. ec.europa.eu.resource_type: JSON API (JSON-stat) / SDMX 2.1 statistics API; plus JSON search API for tenders; statistics portal
ec.europa.eu.recommended_method: A4 statistics: GET Eurostat dissemination API per dataset code, format=JSON (JSON-stat) or format=SDMX-CSV, no auth, filter geo=EL for Greece; enumerate datasets via SDMX 2.1 dataflow catalog. A2 tenders: POST SEDIA search-api (apiKey=SEDIA) with ES bool query filtering tender/call types, paginate pageNumber; per-item detail via /screen/opportunities links. A3 regulation: scrape Have-Your-Say (better-regulation) and FISMA Newsroom HTML/RSS. RRF scoreboard is a JS dashboard — inspect its backend JSON if RRF data needed.

api.endpoint: Statistics (A4): https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/api/dissemination/statistics/1.0/data/{dataset_code}  (e.g. isoc_ci_ac_i, isoc_r_iuse_i, isoc_ec_ibuy, isoc_ec_eseln2, isoc_ci_ifp_iu, nasa_10_f_bs). SDMX 2.1 catalog: https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/api/dissemination/sdmx/2.1/dataflow/all/all/latest . Tenders (A2): https://api.tech.ec.europa.eu/search-api/prod/rest/search?apiKey=SEDIA
api.method: GET (Eurostat statistics API); POST form-urlencoded body 'query=<ES DSL JSON>' (SEDIA search API)
api.params: Eurostat: format=JSON|SDMX-CSV|TSV, lang=EN, plus dimension filters e.g. geo=EL, time=2023, unit=, indic_is=; firstNObservations/lastNObservations, startPeriod/endPeriod. SEDIA: apiKey=SEDIA, text=***, pageSize, pageNumber, and query= Elasticsearch bool DSL (filter type[]=1 calls,2 tenders)
api.format: JSON (JSON-stat 2.0) for Eurostat; also SDMX-CSV/SDMX-ML/TSV. JSON for SEDIA search
api.headers: Eurostat: none required (open). SEDIA: Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
api.auth_needed: No — both open. Eurostat fully anonymous; SEDIA uses fixed public apiKey=SEDIA (no login/cookie)

download.type: CSV/TSV/SDMX (per-dataset bulk export via API format param); also full bulk download facility

ec.europa.eu.next_action: For collection: build dataset-code list for Greek banking/payments/e-commerce ISOC + national-accounts series and pull via Eurostat API; wire SEDIA search for Greek-relevant tenders; add Have-Your-Say + FISMA scrapers. Optionally inspect RRF scoreboard XHR for structured RRF data.
ec.europa.eu.notes: Single very high-value domain covering three workstreams. Statistics and tenders both have tested, reproducible open JSON APIs (no browser needed). Data Browser view pages (databrowser/view/...) are JS-rendered UIs — do NOT scrape them; use the dissemination API with the dataset code instead. Funding & Tenders /screen/... pages are an Angular SPA backed by the SEDIA search-api (tested). RRF country_overview.html and Have-Your-Say are JS-heavy dashboards; HTML reachable but data is dynamic. No dead sample URLs — all returned HTTP 200.

bankofgreece.gr.resource_type: XML (DCAT/RDF data catalog) + linked XLSX/XLS downloads; supplementary statistics portal, PDF reports and .xls registers
bankofgreece.gr.recommended_method: Primary: GET the DCAT catalog https://www.bankofgreece.gr/OpenDataSetsCatalog/catalog.xml (8.4MB, no auth), parse dcat:Distribution nodes for downloadURL + dcterms:format + dcterms:modified, then GET the direct XLSX/XLS files under https://www.bankofgreece.gr/OpenDataSetFilesALL/... — filter by dcterms:modified for incremental collection. Supplementary: scrape HTML publication pages and download the supervised-institutions .xls registers and Financial Stability Review / Governor's Annual Report PDFs directly (stable /Publications/*.pdf and /RelatedDocuments/*.xls paths). All reproducible via plain HTTP; no browser session needed.

api.params: none (single full catalog document; per-dataset landing pages at https://opendata.bankofgreece.gr/en/dataset/<id> and /el/dataset/<id>)
api.format: XML (RDF/DCAT: dcat:Catalog > dcat:dataset > dcat:Distribution with dcat:downloadURL, dcterms:format, dcterms:issued, dcterms:modified, dcterms:language)
api.headers: User-Agent recommended; no auth headers. content-type text/xml

download.type: XLSX (5,544 distributions total; also XLS registers e.g. https://www.bankofgreece.gr/RelatedDocuments/6_PaymentInstitutions.xls (2.4MB) and .../13_LIST_OF_EEA__E-MONEY_INSTITUTIONS.xls (156KB))

Separately map the ~6-8 specific tracked HTML/PDF/.xls source pages (payments, supervision registers, FSR, Governor's report, FinTech hub) to their current stable URLs and scrape/download on a schedule.

Two sample URLs are dead: the Greek instant-payments URL 404s (current EN replacement: https://www.bankofgreece.gr/en/main-tasks/payment-systems-and-settlements/retail-payment-strategy/instant-payments, 200); the EN financial-stability-review sample URL used path 'publications-research' and 404s — correct path is 'publications-and-research' (https://www.bankofgreece.gr/en/publications-and-research/publications/financial-stability-review, 200; latest PDF e.g. https://www.bankofgreece.gr/Publications/FINANCIAL_STABILITY_REVIEW_EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY_OCT_2025.pdf). download.url: https://registers.esma.europa.eu/solr/esma_registers_firds_files/select?q=*:*&wt=json (index of FULINS/DLTINS/FULCAN reference-data ZIP files; each doc gives file_name + download link for FIRDS full/delta files)

eur-lex.europa.eu.resource_type: JSON/RDF SPARQL API + REST content API (XHTML/PDF/XML)
eur-lex.europa.eu.recommended_method: Use SPARQL at https://publications.europa.eu/webapi/rdf/sparql (Accept: application/sparql-results+json) to discover/filter acts (e.g. by subject, date, NIM transposition), then GET https://publications.europa.eu/resource/celex/{CELEX} with headers Accept: application/xhtml+xml and Accept-Language: eng (or ell for Greek) to pull full text; no auth. For OJ monitoring use OJ direct-access pages or SPARQL date filters. Legal-content HTML pages themselves are behind an async bot-mitigation layer (curl HEAD returns 202) so prefer the CELLAR API over scraping the website.

api.params: SPARQL: query=<SPARQL 1.1>. REST: path is the CELEX id (e.g. 32015R0751); WORK-level resource requires an Accept-Language header (e.g. eng) plus Accept content-type for negotiation.
api.format: SPARQL: application/sparql-results+json (or XML/CSV). REST content: application/xhtml+xml, application/pdf, Formex XML
api.headers: SPARQL: Accept: application/sparql-results+json. REST: Accept: application/xhtml+xml AND Accept-Language: eng (language mandatory or returns 400 'WORK without language')
api.auth_needed: No (public; SOAP webservice variant needs free registration but not required for CELLAR REST/SPARQL)

download.type: XHTML (also PDF/Formex via Accept header); bulk via CELLAR data dumps

eur-lex.europa.eu.error_reason: eur-lex.europa.eu legal-content/procedure/oj pages return HTTP 202 Accepted (async anti-bot rendering) to simple curl; content retrievable instead via CELLAR API which needs no browser
eur-lex.europa.eu.next_action: Build SPARQL queries for A3 regulatory monitoring (IFR/SEPA/PSR CELEX ids, NIM transposition measures, OJ L-series by date) and fetch full texts via CELLAR REST; register for SOAP webservice only if expert-search-style queries are later needed
eur-lex.europa.eu.notes: All sample URLs are live (202 = async render, not an error). For Greek text use Accept-Language: ell or the EL legal-content URL. Procedure files (2023_210 PSR) and NIM collection also queryable via SPARQL/CELLAR metadata.

edps.gr.recommended_method: Scrape WooCommerce product-category HTML at /product-category/pos/ for model list/vendors. Optionally try the WooCommerce Store REST API (GET https://edps.gr/wp-json/wc/store/products) if enabled for structured JSON. No auth for public catalog.

diavgeia.gov.gr.recommended_method: GET JSON API https://diavgeia.gov.gr/luminapi/opendata/search.json — no auth, no browser. Paginate with size=&page=. Scope per buyer with organizationId=<uid> (resolve UIDs via organizations.json) or use the /luminapi/api/search/export?q=organizationUid:"<uid>"&wt=json export for bulk pulls. Filter tenders/awards via decisionType (e.g. ΚΑΤΑΚΥΡΩΣΗ) and thematicCategory. Individual doc PDFs at https://diavgeia.gov.gr/doc/<ADA>. HCAP/HFSF, BoG (BOGGR), AEPP/EADISY, ELTA, Elegktiko Synedrio all reachable as org-scoped feeds via /f/<CODE> (HTML) or by organizationId in the API.

api.params: q (free text), organizationId=<uid> (e.g. 99221150), decisionType, thematicCategory, issueDate/from_date/to_date, size, page, sort=recent, wt=json|xml. Export endpoint: q supports Solr-style field queries e.g. q=organizationUid:"50280" or q=decisionType:"ΚΑΤΑΚΥΡΩΣΗ"
api.format: JSON (and XML via wt=xml or .xml). Each decision includes ada, protocolNumber, subject, issueDate (epoch ms), organizationId, decisionTypeId, thematicCategoryIds, documentUrl (https://diavgeia.gov.gr/doc/<ADA>), status, publishTimestamp
api.headers: None required (plain GET works via curl). No cookies/session needed.

diavgeia.gov.gr.next_action: Build collector against opendata/search.json with pagination; pre-resolve target buyer organizationId UIDs (HCAP, BoG/BOGGR, AEPP/EADISY, ELTA, banks) via organizations.json; schedule incremental pulls by issueDate. Optionally fetch per-ADA document PDFs for full text.
diavgeia.gov.gr.notes: Official Greek government transparency portal — fully open, no auth/CAPTCHA. All 15 sample URLs' patterns validated (homepage, /f/<org> HTML pages, /luminapi/opendata/search(.json), /luminapi/opendata/types.json, /luminapi/api/search/export with wt=json and wt=xml). Highest-value single source in the tracker (n=21, critical). Response text is UTF-8 Greek.
diavgeia.gov.gr.worked_example: GET https://diavgeia.gov.gr/luminapi/opendata/search.json?subject=<Greek term e.g. καταμέτρησης χαρτονομισμάτων>&size=20  — PILOT LESSON: 'subject' is the WORKING free-text param; 'q'/'query' are IGNORED. Resolve buyer via /luminapi/opendata/organizations/{orgId}.json ; doc PDF at /doc/{ADA}.

For A1 company facts: GET each gr.linkedin.com/company/<slug> guest page and scrape name/employees/followers/about from the HTML (metadata also in embedded <code>/JSON-LD blocks). Company post feeds and deeper data require an authenticated browser session — flag those for manual validation.

api.headers: Standard browser User-Agent recommended; no Authorization needed; cookies not required for this guest endpoint
api.auth_needed: No (guest endpoint) — but LinkedIn applies IP-based rate limiting / anti-bot (429/999) at volume

gr.linkedin.com.next_action: Build a rate-limited guest-jobs-API collector (paginate start=, filter by keyword/company f_C id) for A5, and a guest company-page HTML scraper for A1 facts. Resolve each sample_name company to its numeric company id for f_C filtering. Manually validate any need for post-level/engagement data via an authenticated session.

LinkedIn ToS prohibits automated scraping and enforces anti-bot (999/429) at scale — collection is technically reproducible for guest jobs + basic company facts but should be low-volume and throttled. Post-level A1 disclosures and full A2 content are not available logged-out.

data.ecb.europa.eu.recommended_method: GET the SDMX REST API at https://data-api.ecb.europa.eu/service/data/{DATASET}/{KEY}?format=csvdata (no auth). For Greek payments: iterate datasets PST (DIAS), PAY (payment transactions incl. fraud), PCP (card payments/cash withdrawals incl. fraud), PTN/PTT (terminals), PDD; filter REF_AREA=GR in the series key. Use startPeriod/endPeriod for history or lastNObservations for latest. Parse CSV (KEY, TIME_PERIOD, OBS_VALUE, TITLE columns) or format=jsondata. Discover valid keys/dimensions via the SUP/PCP/PTN dataset structure pages on data.ecb.europa.eu or the /service/datastructure endpoint.

api.params: DATASET e.g. PST, PAY, PCP, PTN, PTT, PDD, SUP; SERIES_KEY is dot-separated dimensions with GR as REF_AREA (empty positions = wildcard, must match dataset dimension count); filters: startPeriod=YYYY, endPeriod=YYYY, lastNObservations=N, detail=dataonly|full; format=csvdata|jsondata|genericdata|structurespecificdata
api.headers: Optional Accept header (text/csv, application/json, application/vnd.sdmx.data+json). None required when using format= query param. No API key/cookie/session needed.

data.ecb.europa.eu.next_action: Build a per-dataset key list for Greece (from dataset structure/dimension pages) and schedule periodic GET pulls via format=csvdata; validate PCP/PTN exact series keys since wildcard queries can error.
data.ecb.europa.eu.notes: data.ecb.europa.eu is the successor to the old Statistical Data Warehouse (sdw-wsrest.ecb.europa.eu). Portal HTML is React/JS but data does NOT require a browser — reproducible via the data-api host. All sample URLs are live. Only caveat: series keys must match each dataset's exact dimension count or the API returns an HTML error page rather than JSON/CSV.
data.ecb.europa.eu.worked_example: GET https://data-api.ecb.europa.eu/service/data/PTN/H.{CC}.W0.2221._T.PN?format=csvdata  (ATMs; 2222=POS terminals). minfin.gov.gr.resource_type: JSON API (WordPress REST) + HTML pages with PDF downloads + RSS
minfin.gov.gr.recommended_method: GET JSON API https://minfin.gov.gr/wp-json/wp/v2/posts?per_page=100&page=N (no auth) to harvest all press releases/announcements incrementally with after= date filter for A1/A3; for A4 budget PDFs and A2/A3 legislative texts, scrape the HTML archive pages (kratikos-proypologismos/, ypourgeio/nomothetiko-ergo/) for per-year PDF links. RSS feeds (/feed/, /en/press-releases/feed/) available for lightweight new-item polling.

api.params: per_page (max 100), page, after/before (ISO date), search, _fields; EN posts filterable by link path /en/. Pagination via page= up to X-WP-TotalPages.
api.headers: none required; response exposes X-WP-Total (13109) and X-WP-TotalPages headers plus Link rel=next

download.type: PDF (state budget, introductory reports, tax-expenditure reports per year 2016-2026 via 'Περισσότερα' sub-pages)

minfin.gov.gr.next_action: Set up paginated WP REST harvest with date-incremental polling; enumerate budget/legislative sub-pages for PDF links.
minfin.gov.gr.notes: All 10 sample URLs reachable (HTTP 200). Bilingual: Greek posts under root, English under /en/ path (same API, filter by link). Budget archive is index->per-year subpage->PDF. No dead URLs.

growthfund.gr.resource_type: JSON API (WordPress REST, standard + custom post types) + HTML + RSS
growthfund.gr.recommended_method: GET JSON API (no auth): https://growthfund.gr/wp-json/wp/v2/procurement?per_page=100&page=N for tenders (A2), .../report?per_page=100 for reports (A1), .../posts?per_page=100 for newsroom (A1). Paginate via page= up to X-WP-TotalPages; use after= for incremental. Follow content/link fields to attached PDF report files.

api.params: per_page (max 100), page, after/before, search, _fields. rest_base: posts (newsroom A1), procurement (tenders A2, X-WP-Total=910), report (reports A1, X-WP-Total=51). EN content under /en/ link path.
api.headers: none required; X-WP-Total / X-WP-TotalPages headers exposed

download.type: PDF (report post type entries link to downloadable annual/quarterly report PDFs, incl. successor host of former HFSF archive)

growthfund.gr.next_action: Harvest procurement + report + posts endpoints paginated; parse report entries for PDF asset URLs.
growthfund.gr.notes: All 8 sample URLs reachable (HTTP 200). Custom REST post types procurement & report are the key A2/A1 resources. Bilingual EN under /en/. Root /feed/ 301-redirects to homepage (not usable); rely on REST API instead. No dead URLs.

digiwhist.docs.apiary.io.resource_type: statistics portal / JSON API + bulk data download

digiwhist.docs.apiary.io.error_reason: Apiary docs return HTTP 502 / connection timeout; opentender.eu returns HTTP 403 (Cloudflare); govtransparency.eu SSL certificate expired

digiwhist.docs.apiary.io.notes: The sample Apiary API-docs URL is effectively dead (502/timeout). Opentender is the live successor data resource but is Cloudflare-protected against automated fetching.

supplier.coupahost.com.notes: Generic Coupa supplier sign-in host shared across many buyers; no public data exposed without login.

moneyonline.gr.recommended_method: Scrape the HTML category pages (/news/trapezika/ and /news/trapezika/nea/trapezika) with pagination, sending a browser User-Agent (Cloudflare blocks default bot UAs - WebFetch got 403 while browser-UA curl got 200). No RSS or sitemap available.

e-efka.gov.gr.recommended_method: Scrape the paginated tenders listing at https://www.e-efka.gov.gr/el/diagonismoi (886 items, ~89 pages, date-range filter available); follow each item link to its detail page for attached tender documents/PDFs. Also cover /el/ilektronikes-ypiresies for e-services.
e-efka.gov.gr.next_action: Scrape diagonismoi listing on a schedule and pull detail-page documents for A2 (tenders) plus position announcements for A5.

cerpp.eprocurement.gov.gr.recommended_method: POST JSON search API. Example: POST https://cerpp.eprocurement.gov.gr/khmdhs-opendata/notice?page=0 with header Content-Type: application/json and body {"dateFrom":"YYYY-MM-DD","dateTo":"YYYY-MM-DD"}; no auth. Iterate page=0..totalPages-1 (50 records/page). Use the same pattern against /contract, /auction, /payment, /request with their criteria bodies. Retrieve source PDFs via GET /{type}/attachment/{referenceNumber}. Read spec at /khmdhs-opendata/v3/api-docs.

api.endpoint: https://cerpp.eprocurement.gov.gr/khmdhs-opendata (POST /notice, POST /contract, POST /auction, POST /payment, POST /request; GET /pde; GET /adamChain/{referenceNumber}; GET /{type}/attachment/{referenceNumber} for PDFs)
api.method: POST for searches (with GET attachment/pde/adamChain endpoints)
api.params: Query: page (int, 0-based, size fixed 50, response gives totalPages/totalElements). JSON body = search criteria, e.g. NoticeSearchCriteria {title, cpvItems[], organizations[], signer, contractType, dateFrom, dateTo, totalCostFrom/To, referenceNumber, procedureType, finalDateFrom/To, aaht, publicFundingRefNum, isModified}. Similar criteria objects for contract/auction/payment/request.
api.format: JSON (Spring-style paginated: content[], totalElements, totalPages, number, size, last, first)
api.auth_needed: No - no securitySchemes in OpenAPI spec; tested anonymously with success

download.type: PDF (per-record attachment via GET by ADAM referenceNumber)

cerpp.eprocurement.gov.gr.next_action: Build collectors around the POST search endpoints (notice/contract/auction/payment) with date-window + CPV/organization filters and page iteration; schedule incremental pulls by signedDate/submissionDate. Use ADAM referenceNumber to fetch PDFs where the full text is needed.
cerpp.eprocurement.gov.gr.notes: Legacy kimds2 search UI (searchNotice.htm, searchContracts.htm, protectedSearch.htm) now returns HTTP 503 and is superseded. Homepage 302-redirects to /upgkimdis/unprotected/home.xhtml (JSF/XHTML human search portal, session/JS-based - use only if a field is missing from the API). /cpv/main/ is the CPV (Common Procurement Vocabulary) lookup tool - useful reference for cpvItems filter values. /deliberation/ and /khmdhs-opendata/help both 200. Prefer the OpenData REST API for all automated collection (workstreams A1 corporate disclosures, A2 tenders/procurement, A4 market statistics).
cerpp.eprocurement.gov.gr.worked_example: KIMDIS OpenData: POST https://cerpp.eprocurement.gov.gr/khmdhs-opendata/notice with JSON keyword/CPV filters; GET /pde ; GET /adamChain/{referenceNumber}; GET /{type}/attachment/{referenceNumber} for PDFs. No auth.

al.linkedin.com.resource_type: JSON/HTML API (guest jobs endpoint returns HTML job-card fragments) + HTML company pages
al.linkedin.com.recommended_method: For A5 (hiring/early-intent): poll the guest jobs endpoint per keyword (banking/fintech/payments/POS/kartela) with location=Albania, paginate via start=0,10,20..., parse HTML job cards; filter by employer with f_C or by matching company URL. Use f_TPR=r86400/r604800 for freshness. Throttle heavily (a few requests/min, randomized) to avoid 429. For A1/A6 firmographics + posts: fetch guest company pages /company/{slug} (raiffeisen-bank-albania, bkt, credins-bank, intesa-sanpaolo-bank-albania, american-bank-of-investments, easypay-sh-p-k, paylink-albania, pok-pay, albanian-association-of-banks..., agjencia-e-sigurimit-te-depozitave) and scrape the public og/JSON-LD + about block. Note LinkedIn ToS prohibits scraping; the official LinkedIn Talent/Marketing APIs require an approved partner app for compliant collection at scale.

api.params: keywords (e.g. banking, fintech, payments, pagese), location (Albania), start (pagination offset in steps of 10), optional: geoId, f_TPR (time posted, e.g. r86400 = last 24h), f_C (company numeric id to filter one employer), f_E (experience)
api.format: HTML fragment (list of <li> base-search-card blocks: title, company, company URL, location, posting date, job view URL). No JSON wrapper; parse HTML.
api.headers: Standard browser User-Agent recommended; no auth token or cookie required for guest endpoint. Referer/Accept-Language optional.
api.auth_needed: No auth for guest jobs endpoint; however aggressive rate limiting (HTTP 429 / auth-wall after a burst of requests) - needs slow pacing and/or rotating egress IPs

al.linkedin.com.next_action: Build a paced guest-jobs poller + company-page scraper with rotating User-Agent/IP and 429 backoff; OR pursue official LinkedIn API partner access for ToS-compliant collection. Confirm each company slug resolves (all sample slugs returned 200).

Guest data is genuinely useful for A1 (public firmographics/posts of AL banks & fintechs), A5 (banking/payments job openings = hiring/early-intent), and A6 (vendor/competitor company pages). otpgroup.info.resource_type: HTML page (IR hub) + PDF/Excel report downloads
otpgroup.info.recommended_method: Scrape the JS-rendered IR listing pages (reports, announcements, events/presentations, news) with a headless browser to enumerate document links, then direct-download the PDFs/Excel via the /static/sw/file/<name> path. Files are served without auth (tested: Integrated Annual Report 2025 PDF = HTTP 200, application/pdf, 16 MB). Listing pages are Drupal-based and load content dynamically, so a plain HTTP GET returns the shell — render JS to harvest links, or maintain known file-name patterns (e.g. YYMMDD_Integrated_report_e_final, OTP_YYYYnQ_e_final for quarterly results).
otpgroup.info.next_action: Build a headless-browser link harvester for the IR reports/announcements/presentations/news pages; store discovered /static/sw/file/ document URLs and download PDFs/Excel directly. No API or RSS found; monitor announcements page (by year) for new regulated disclosures.
otpgroup.info.notes: Parent OTP Group corporate/IR site (Hungary), referenced by Albania, Bulgaria and Croatia trackers for group-level A1 disclosures, A4 financial data (analyst tables .xlsm), and A5. All 11 sample URLs are on reachable paths (reports/announcements/news/presentations/investor-relations) and returned HTTP 200. Documents hosted under https://www.otpgroup.info/static/sw/file/. Listing pages are JS-rendered (Drupal) so raw GET yields limited HTML; downloads themselves need no auth. No sample URL was dead.

dimensionhr.al.notes: Albania (A5). HR agency; postings are early-intent hiring signals for banking clients. Use browser UA to avoid 403.

api.endpoint: https://web.dzs.hr/PxWeb/api/v1/{lang}/ (lang=hr or en); table data at .../{lang}/<db>/<path>/<table>.px
api.method: GET for metadata (levels/tables/variables), POST with JSON query for data extraction
api.params: GET returns db/level listing; POST body = {"query":[{"code":<var>,"selection":{"filter":"item","values":[...]}}],"response":{"format":"json-stat2|csv|px|xlsx"}}
api.format: JSON (metadata); JSON-stat2 / CSV / PX / XLSX (data responses)
api.headers: None required (public); Content-Type: application/json for POST

For A1/A3 disclosures: fetch /en/about/reports (or /bg/about/reports) and harvest href links matching /attachments/Tab/{id}/download_(en|bg)/*.pdf (197 PDF links present). For A1/A5 news & product intel: paginate /en/news?page=N (~210 pages) or use the year/category filters; each item has a date, category tag and link. For A5 jobs: scrape /en/careers/positions. No API, login, or JS execution needed.
ubb.bg.next_action: Build a scraper that follows redirects and parses the reports page for PDF links and the news pages for dated announcements; schedule periodic re-crawl of /news for new items.
ubb.bg.notes: Bulgaria — United Bulgarian Bank (Обединена българска банка, UBB), part of KBC Group. All sample URLs live (HTTP 200). Note: bare curl WITHOUT -L returns a 162-byte nginx 301 (www.ubb.bg -> ubb.bg); must follow redirects. No dead sample URLs. Direct PDF pattern: https://ubb.bg/attachments/Tab/{tabId}/download_{en|bg}/{filename}.pdf
