api.headers: Authorization: Bearer <token> (token obtained from client_id/client_secret issued after free registration)
api.auth_needed: Yes — OAuth2 client-credentials; free self-registration at sudreg-data.gov.hr yields Client ID/Client Secret + token URL. No paywall.

sudreg.pravosudje.hr.error_reason: OpenAPIJavni root path without a resource returns Oracle {code:NotFound} — expected; concrete method paths require the OAuth token.
sudreg.pravosudje.hr.next_action: Complete free API registration to obtain client credentials, then script token + endpoint pulls; confirm exact method names from OpenAPI spec after auth.
sudreg.pravosudje.hr.notes: Croatia. Two surfaces: (1) public interactive search sudreg.pravosudje.hr (Oracle APEX/ORDS, JS-rendered) — sample URL /registar/f?p=150:1 302-redirects to /ords/r/esudreg/public/1 (live, not dead, just moved to ORDS); (2) developer API on sudreg-data.gov.hr (best for automation). Highest-priority domain in batch (A1 corporate disclosures, A5).

paylink.al.recommended_method: Periodic HTML scrape of the English (/en/...) and Albanian sections — About Us, Products & Services, Activities, Job Vacancies, Contact — for corporate profile (A1), vendor/competitor intel (A6) and early-intent signals (A5). Content is fully static; simple GET + HTML parse works, no JS/API needed.
paylink.al.error_reason: www.paylink.al returned no response headers (bare-host quirk); non-www https://paylink.al/en/... serves HTTP/2 200 fine.
paylink.al.next_action: Scrape /en/ (and Albanian) pages on a low-frequency schedule; watch Job Vacancies + Activities/News for hiring or product-launch signals. Use https://paylink.al (non-www) as base.
paylink.al.notes: Albania. Small static corporate site; workstreams A1/A3/A5/A6. Note www.paylink.al is unreliable — use non-www host. No structured data feed; monitoring value is qualitative (jobs, product/partner announcements).

coe.int.resource_type: HTML jurisdiction pages linking to PDF reports (rm.coe.int); news articles
coe.int.recommended_method: Collect via a real browser session (Chrome MCP / headless with proper TLS+JS+cookies). Both www.coe.int and rm.coe.int sit behind Cloudflare bot protection that returns HTTP 403 to curl and WebFetch even with a browser User-Agent, so plain scraping is not reproducible. Workflow: browser-render the jurisdiction page, extract rm.coe.int PDF links, then fetch PDFs through the same authenticated browser context. Direct rm.coe.int PDF URLs (discoverable via WebSearch) are the underlying data objects.
coe.int.error_reason: HTTP 403 (Cloudflare/bot protection) on www.coe.int and rm.coe.int for curl and WebFetch, with and without a browser User-Agent header.
coe.int.next_action: Use the Chrome/browser MCP tool to render jurisdiction pages and harvest rm.coe.int PDF links, or rely on WebSearch to locate specific report PDFs; schedule periodic checks of the three jurisdiction pages for new reports/press releases.
coe.int.notes: Shared source for Albania, Bosnia and Bulgaria (workstream A3 regulation/AML deadlines). Sample URLs are valid pages but all blocked to automated fetch by Cloudflare 403. The Bulgaria sample is a news-article permalink under /web/moneyval/-/... ; the BiH Sarajevo sample is /web/sarajevo/economic-crime-hf. None are dead — access is the only obstacle. Report PDFs live on rm.coe.int (also Cloudflare-protected).

profit.bg.recommended_method: HTML scraping of the /banki category with pagination (/banki?page=N or similar); parse article headline/summary/date/link. No RSS feed exists.
profit.bg.next_action: Build paginated HTML scraper for /banki; monitor for A1 corporate/A5 early-intent signals in Bulgarian banking articles
profit.bg.notes: Serves Bulgaria. Static-server HTML (no WordPress feed). No RSS despite being a news site. Both sample URLs live.

teximbank.bg.recommended_method: HTML scraping of the investor-information sub-tree (crawl /documentation/ and /information-for-investors/ for PDF financial reports/disclosures) and /teksim-bank/karieri/ for jobs. Texim Bank is BSE-listed, so the Bulgarian Stock Exchange (x3news.com) is a reliable secondary source for regulated disclosures.
teximbank.bg.next_action: Crawl investor sub-pages to locate report PDFs; cross-check BSE x3news for Texim Bank (Тексим Банк) disclosures
teximbank.bg.notes: Serves Bulgaria. Public BSE-listed bank. Both sample URLs live. Financial-report PDFs not surfaced by inline grep; deeper crawl needed. WebFetch intermittently 404s where curl succeeds.

trendingtopics.eu.recommended_method: Poll the RSS feed at /feed/ (WordPress). For Bulgaria-specific fintech/payments articles, use site search or category feeds; the general feed is Austria/CEE-centric and only loosely Bulgaria-relevant.
trendingtopics.eu.next_action: Subscribe to /feed/ and filter for Bulgaria/payments/fintech keywords; low relevance to Bulgaria banking specifically
trendingtopics.eu.notes: Referenced for Bulgaria (A1/A6) but feed is pan-CEE/Austria; low direct relevance. Homepage redirects to /de/. Sample article slug (startups-visa-innovation-fintech) is thematic.

finansi.bg.recommended_method: HTML scraping of per-company slug pages (finansi.bg/<company-slug>-<id>). Basic financials (revenue, ownership, contacts) are visible without login; full/historical data gated behind subscription. Company slug = name + numeric ID.
finansi.bg.next_action: Scrape free tier for company financial snapshots; evaluate whether subscription is needed for A4 market-stats depth
finansi.bg.notes: Serves Bulgaria. Freemium: basic company financials free, deeper data requires subscription. Both sample URLs live. Underlying data from BG commercial register.

techtrends.bg.recommended_method: Poll WordPress RSS at /feed/ (also supports category feeds /category/<slug>/feed/ and ?s= search). Parse for payments/fintech/vendor-deal keywords. Full-content available via content:encoded in RSS.
techtrends.bg.next_action: Subscribe to /feed/ and relevant category feeds; good A1/A2/A6 vendor-deal pointer source for Bulgaria
techtrends.bg.notes: Serves Bulgaria. WordPress site with full RSS. Both sample URLs live. Relevant to Bulgarian payments/vendor coverage.

lobbyfacts.eu.recommended_method: For each org, use the CSV export at /csv_export/<rid> (rid = Transparency Register id, e.g. 527814542136-79 for BG Fintech Assoc, 635043818530-97 for Croatian Banking Assoc). GET, no auth, returns application/csv (~7KB) with lobbying costs, FTEs, members, goals, financials. Datacard HTML page carries the CSV link.
lobbyfacts.eu.next_action: Enumerate relevant Balkan banking/fintech orgs' rids and pull CSV exports; also consider EU Transparency Register bulk data as upstream source
lobbyfacts.eu.notes: Serves Bulgaria AND Croatia. CSV export confirmed working and reproducible outside browser. Data ultimately from EU Transparency Register (BG Fintech Assoc no longer registered as of Dec 2023).

mediapool.bg.recommended_method: Use RSS at /rss/ (or /rss) for latest 15 items site-wide; for topical depth scrape the business category HTML /biznes-cat3.html with pagination (2900+ pages). RSS is general (not business-only), so combine with category HTML scraping for A2/A5 signals.
mediapool.bg.next_action: Poll /rss/ plus scrape /biznes-cat3.html pages for procurement/state-bank governance news
mediapool.bg.notes: Serves Bulgaria. Site-wide RSS only (last 15, not category-filtered). Business section is HTML with deep pagination. Both sample URLs live.

musala.com.recommended_method: Redirect target: scrape avenga.com (industries: Banking & Financial Services; case studies) for A2 references, and career.avenga.com for jobs/early-intent. musala.com/* 301-redirects site-wide to avenga.com.
musala.com.next_action: Update tracker domain musala.com -> avenga.com; scrape avenga.com FS references and career.avenga.com job listings
musala.com.notes: Serves Bulgaria (Musala Soft was Sofia-based). Domain moved: musala.com now redirects to avenga.com. Careers URL is career.avenga.com (not avenga.com/careers/). Both original sample URLs redirect (effectively dead as-is).

nabavke.com.recommended_method: HTTP GET + HTML parse of pretraga.htm search-results pages (server-rendered Bootstrap/jQuery, no JS needed). Note: full tender detail/monitoring is a paid subscription service; for free/official BiH procurement use ejn.gov.ba or javnenabavke.gov.ba as complement.
nabavke.com.next_action: Confirm which country/category filter params pretraga.htm accepts (form fields) and whether full tender bodies require login/subscription.
nabavke.com.notes: Serves Bosnia (plus wider SEE region). Commercial tender aggregator; homepage redirects to /sr/index.htm; search page pretraga.htm works. Full data likely behind paid subscription.

uino.gov.ba.recommended_method: Periodic HTTP GET + HTML parse of the /portal/en/tenders/ (or /bs/ which 301s to /en/) section; individual tender announcements are server-rendered pages, PDFs linked per-item. Also /portal/en/taxpayer-database/ for A1/A6.
uino.gov.ba.next_action: Enumerate the tenders listing pagination/category URLs and confirm PDF document link pattern for individual tenders.
uino.gov.ba.notes: Serves Bosnia (state-level Indirect Taxation Authority). bs-language tenders URL 301-redirects to the en version. WordPress-style CMS; no API/RSS found, plain HTML scrape.

fmf.gov.ba.recommended_method: HTTP GET + HTML parse of homepage (Novosti feed replaces old aktuelno.php) plus /Content/Read/zakoni for laws and the Javni pozivi/obavijesti section for bank-selection public calls; documents linked as PDFs. IIS/.NET routes use GET only (HEAD returns 405).
fmf.gov.ba.error_reason: Old sample URL http://www.fmf.gov.ba/v2/aktuelno.php 301-redirects to homepage (v2 site retired); /Content/Read/zakoni returns 405 to HEAD but 200 to GET.
fmf.gov.ba.next_action: Confirm URL of the Javni pozivi i obavijesti listing and whether Novosti has a paginated archive for monitoring bank-selection calls.
fmf.gov.ba.notes: Serves Bosnia (Federation of BiH ministry). Old v2 'Aktuelno' feed (aktuelno.php) is dead — replaced by 'Novosti' on new site. No RSS. Use GET (not HEAD) on Content/Read/* routes.

bizreg.pravosudje.ba.recommended_method: Browser automation (Selenium/Playwright) driving the APEX app: it uses session state and per-request p_flow/session tokens in f?p=183:PAGE:SESSION... URLs (e.g. page 3 advanced search, page 13/30 detail), so requests are not cleanly reproducible with plain curl. Alternative: the related public portal bizreg.ba (e-Registar Javni portal) exposes a cleaner /Public/PublicPortal/CompaniesList search (HTTP 200) that may be easier to scrape.
bizreg.pravosudje.ba.error_reason: JS/session-bound Oracle APEX; f?p=183:20: returns empty body to curl (needs APEX session). Root domain bizreg.pravosudje.ba/ serves a static stub/redirect page (meta-refresh to the APEX app).
bizreg.pravosudje.ba.next_action: Use a headless browser to establish an APEX session and capture the internal AJAX/interactive-report endpoints, OR evaluate bizreg.ba public portal as a cleaner scraping target.
bizreg.pravosudje.ba.notes: Serves Bosnia (state VSTV/HJPC court registry). App is LIVE (data updated today) despite root-domain stub message. No public REST API; APEX session tokens block plain HTTP reproduction. bizreg.ba is a viable alternative public register portal.

sirma.com.recommended_method: HTTP GET + HTML parse of stories.html (case studies), news.html and insights.html for banking/fintech client wins; industries/fintech.html and services pages for solution/competitor intel. Server-rendered, no JS/API.
sirma.com.error_reason: Sample URL https://sirma.com/stories/ (trailing-slash directory) returns HTTP 403 even with browser User-Agent; canonical page is stories.html.
sirma.com.next_action: Scrape stories.html and news.html, filter for banking/fintech case studies and client names for A6 vendor/competitor intel.
sirma.com.notes: Serves Bulgaria (vendor/competitor A6, also A2). The tracker's /stories/ path is dead (403) — use stories.html instead. Static HTML site, easy to scrape.

profilnakupuvacha.com.recommended_method: Requires a real browser session to pass the Cloudflare challenge (chlray managed challenge). Use headless browser automation with JS/cookies; then inspect for a search/list endpoint. Alternatively rely on the authoritative source (ЦАИС ЕОП / AOP open data) which this site merely aggregates.
profilnakupuvacha.com.error_reason: HTTP 403 (Cloudflare managed challenge / bot protection) on HEAD/GET even with browser User-Agent
profilnakupuvacha.com.next_action: Open in a real browser (or headless Chrome solving the JS challenge) to confirm structure; otherwise substitute the official EOP/AOP source.
profilnakupuvacha.com.notes: Serves Bulgaria (A2 procurement). Cloudflare-protected private aggregator of buyer profiles; blocked to automated fetchers. Underlying procurement data is authoritatively available from eop.bg / AOP open data.

customs.bg.recommended_method: HTTP GET + HTML parse of the buyer-profile hub and its year/category sub-pages (IBM WebSphere Portal, /wps/portal paths). For post-2020 procurement notices the authoritative structured source is ЦАИС ЕОП (eop.bg) / AOP open data, to which the agency publishes.
customs.bg.next_action: Crawl the buyer-profile sub-pages, or query eop.bg for this contracting authority's notices.
customs.bg.notes: Serves Bulgaria (A2). Page is a hub, not a structured/exportable list; no direct eop.bg links but notices are filed in ЦАИС ЕОП. Only external link is https://onlinefrontoffice.ecustoms.bg/ (e-customs services).

reg.cpc.bg.recommended_method: ASP.NET WebForms site (default.aspx with __VIEWSTATE / __EVENTTARGET postbacks and treeview controls). Navigation and search are driven by server postbacks, so use a browser-driven scraper or replay the ASP.NET postback POSTs (carry __VIEWSTATE, __EVENTVALIDATION, __EVENTTARGET). There is a search page (по номер/дата/страни) more suitable than the tree.
reg.cpc.bg.error_reason: WebFetch 403 (WAF/Cloudflare blocks the fetch model); direct curl returns 200
reg.cpc.bg.next_action: Locate the search/results endpoint (default.aspx?...) and script the ASP.NET postback, or use headless browser to page through ЗОП decisions.
reg.cpc.bg.notes: Serves Bulgaria (A2/A3 — procurement-appeal decisions). Classic ASP.NET postback register; reproducible outside a browser only by carrying VIEWSTATE tokens. No CSV/JSON export observed.

namrb.org.recommended_method: HTTP GET + HTML parse of the 'Актуално' / 'Общините днес' news sections and 'Становища' (positions) for early-intent/regulatory signals; scrape the buyer-profile section for the association's own tenders. Apache-served server-rendered HTML — straightforward to crawl. Check for an e-newsletter/RSS.
namrb.org.next_action: Enumerate news/positions listing pages and pagination; look for a hidden RSS or newsletter feed.
namrb.org.notes: Serves Bulgaria (A2/A3). Membership org for all Bulgarian municipalities; good for municipal policy positions and news. Server-rendered, easily scrapable.

evro.egov.bg.recommended_method: Scrape the 'Актуално' news section for changeover deadlines/announcements (A3 regulation/deadlines) and download the National Plan / Law PDFs and the Excel progress-report exports from the public reports section. Server-rendered egov.bg page.
evro.egov.bg.next_action: Capture the direct PDF and Excel export URLs from the reports/documents pages and test a small download.
evro.egov.bg.notes: Serves Bulgaria (A3 — euro adoption 2026, deadlines & official plan). Highly relevant for regulatory/changeover intelligence. Excel export and PDF plan/law available.

bulnao.government.bg.recommended_method: HTTP GET (homepage 302 -> /bg/). Scrape the audit-reports listing and download report PDFs; subscribe to the site's RSS feeds for new reports/press releases. Public procurement-control section is relevant for A2/A3.
bulnao.government.bg.next_action: Capture the RSS feed URL(s) and the audit-reports listing pagination; test a sample PDF download.
bulnao.government.bg.notes: Serves Bulgaria (A2/A3 — public-fund audits incl. public procurement control). Server-rendered gov site with PDFs and RSS; easy to automate.

tenderbg.com.recommended_method: Not usable as an open data source — data sits behind Telegram-bot login and a paid subscription; also it merely re-aggregates ЕОП (eop.bg), TED and ИСУН. Collect the underlying tenders directly from those official sources instead. Treat this domain as a competitor/vendor reference (A6) rather than a data feed.
tenderbg.com.error_reason: Login/subscription required (Telegram /start); no public tender listing or API exposed
tenderbg.com.next_action: Optionally track its marketing pages for competitor intel; otherwise ignore and use eop.bg / TED / ISUN.
tenderbg.com.notes: Serves Bulgaria (A2). Paywalled private SaaS aggregator; not an authoritative/open source. Real data = ЦАИС ЕОП + TED + ИСУН.

eop.bg.recommended_method: Do NOT scrape the app.eop.bg SPA (Negometrix-based, JS-rendered, requires session). Instead pull structured procurement data from the AOP open-data page (www2.aop.bg/e-uslugi/otvoreni-danni-ot-rop/) and the Public Procurement Agency datasets on data.egov.bg via its REST API (free api_key). The public register itself is browsable without login for spot checks.

api.params: api_key (free, from data.egov.bg profile) + resource/dataset URI; AOP org profile e9a95e08-7759-497a-a478-55f331d59447
api.auth_needed: Free API key (register on data.egov.bg); no paywall

eop.bg.error_reason: app.eop.bg and data.egov.bg both JS/WAF-guarded for raw fetch (WebFetch saw only a loading shell / 403); data.egov.bg /api returns 403 without api_key
eop.bg.next_action: Register a free data.egov.bg API key, enumerate the AOP org's datasets (getOrganisationDatasets), and test getResourceData on a procurement dataset.
eop.bg.notes: Serves Bulgaria (A2 — THE national e-procurement system, incl. state-owned banks & BNB tenders). Highest-value A2 source. Best accessed via AOP/RОП open data + data.egov.bg API rather than the JS app.

boyanov.com.recommended_method: Poll the category RSS feed https://www.boyanov.com/category/news-and-deals/feed/ (HTTP 200, application/rss+xml) for new legal/deal posts; fall back to HTML parsing of the category listing. Standard WordPress site.
boyanov.com.error_reason: WebFetch returned 403 (Cloudflare blocks the fetch model), but direct curl with browser UA works
boyanov.com.next_action: Ingest the RSS feed on a schedule; optionally also the site-wide feed /feed/.
boyanov.com.notes: Serves Bulgaria (A3 — legal/regulatory & deals intelligence). Cloudflare fronts the site (blocks WebFetch) but curl/RSS work fine. RSS feed confirmed tested.

blinkpay.bg.recommended_method: Periodic HTTP GET + HTML parse of the single-page site to track the participating-bank list and fee/scheme changes (A3/A6 — instant-payments scheme & member banks). Static Apache-served HTML; no news/RSS, so change-detection on the page is the right approach.
blinkpay.bg.next_action: Set up change-detection on the participating-banks section and fee terms.
blinkpay.bg.notes: Serves Bulgaria (A3/A6 — Bulgarian instant payment scheme by BORICA). Static page; value is the member-bank roster and fee/scheme terms. No dynamic API.

finovateadria.com.recommended_method: Static HTML scrape of homepage + /blog and /speakers for early-intent/regulation signals; low frequency (annual invitation-only event, next date 3 Dec 2026)
finovateadria.com.next_action: Periodically scrape blog and agenda pages for fintech/regulatory topics
finovateadria.com.notes: Serves Bosnia. Static HTML, no JS needed. A3 signal source (fintech/regulation event content).

revik.ba.recommended_method: Use the moved domain hlbrevik.com; scrape English/BS pages and download the client reference list + transparency report for A1 corporate/audit intelligence
revik.ba.next_action: Update tracker to hlbrevik.com; locate exact download URLs for client list/transparency report
revik.ba.notes: Serves Bosnia. revik.ba permanently redirects (301) to hlbrevik.com - domain moved. Same firm.

ecjn.gov.ba.recommended_method: Homepage is public but tender data sits behind tenant login (/tenants Prijava). For public BiH procurement notices use the national portal ejn.gov.ba instead; ecjn is centralized-purchasing internal system. Requires credentials for full data.
ecjn.gov.ba.next_action: Confirm whether any public tender listing exists without login; otherwise pivot A1/A2 collection to ejn.gov.ba national procurement portal
ecjn.gov.ba.notes: Serves Bosnia. Centralized-procurement info system, data behind authentication. Not a public open-data source.

itkarijera.ba.recommended_method: Call the JSON API directly (no browser/login): GET https://api.itkarijera.ba/api/industry/CompanyJob/GetListByQuery. Reproducible via curl. Ideal A5/A2 early-intent IT jobs feed for Bosnia.

api.params: supports paging/query params (GetListByQuery pattern: page/pageSize/search); related endpoints /api/Industry/Company/GetByJob, /api/Global/City; swagger at /swagger/v1/swagger.json
api.headers: none required (no Authorization needed for read)

itkarijera.ba.next_action: Read swagger for pagination params to page through all ~302 jobs; schedule periodic pulls
itkarijera.ba.notes: Serves Bosnia. Page is JS-only but data fully reproducible via public API. Tested live.

eki.ba.recommended_method: Scrape site 'About/Reports' (Izvjestaji/Godisnji izvjestaj) section for annual reports (PDF). Homepage confirmed live; exact reports page not yet located.
eki.ba.next_action: Navigate site menu to find Godisnji izvjestaj / financial statements page and confirm PDF downloads
eki.ba.notes: Serves Bosnia. A1 corporate disclosure. Homepage validated; reports subsection needs locating.

partner.ba.recommended_method: Scrape homepage/footer for terms & pricing PDFs; search site for 'Godisnji izvjestaj / Finansijski izvjestaji' page for annual reports (A1).
partner.ba.next_action: Locate annual/financial report subsection; confirm PDF URLs
partner.ba.notes: Serves Bosnia. A1. Homepage validated; formal financial disclosures not surfaced on homepage.

kfbih.com.recommended_method: Scrape NOVOSTI (news) section for A1/A3 signals; parse associations/sectors pages; English version available for cross-check. Static HTML.
kfbih.com.next_action: Scrape news feed regularly; locate member directory if needed
kfbih.com.notes: Serves Bosnia (FBiH). Static HTML, English available. A1 source.

komorars.ba.recommended_method: Primary value is the InfoBiz Poslovni registar (company directory) linked from homepage - use for A1 company data; scrape news + Ekonomski indikatori. Note robots.txt disallows ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai/GPTBot etc., but plain curl (200) works - respect robots or use neutral UA.
komorars.ba.next_action: Open InfoBiz register subportal, inspect its search/API for structured company data
komorars.ba.notes: Serves Bosnia (Republika Srpska). robots.txt explicitly Disallows ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai - collection should honor this or use compliant scraping.

support.apple.com.recommended_method: Fetch page via curl and parse HTML by country heading; confirmed contains Albania, Bosnia, Bulgaria, Croatia. Static, no JS/auth. Ideal A6 vendor/competitor (bank issuer coverage) source.
support.apple.com.next_action: Parse country sections for issuer bank names per market; monitor for updates
support.apple.com.notes: Referenced by Bosnia entry but page covers all 4 target countries. Static HTML, list embedded in page (not JS-loaded).

fzmiopio.ba.recommended_method: Scrape the listing page for dated PDF hyperlinks (tenders + Odluka o dodjeli ugovora); static HTML, ?lang=hr switches language. A2 procurement source for Bosnia (FBiH pension fund).

download.type: PDF (tender announcements, procurement plans, contract award decisions)

fzmiopio.ba.next_action: Enumerate and fetch PDF links; monitor page for new tender notices
fzmiopio.ba.notes: Serves Bosnia (FBiH). Static HTML index of downloadable procurement PDFs. Sample URL live.

eho.zse.hr.resource_type: JSON API (also XML and RSS available)
eho.zse.hr.recommended_method: Poll the JSON feeds directly with a plain HTTP GET (curl/requests), no browser or auth. Iterate over all five variants for both HR (/feed/json) and EN (/en/feed/json) to capture full coverage (A1 corporate disclosures, A4 market/trading news). Parse item.link (/obavijesti-izdavatelja/view/{id} or /en/issuer-announcements/view/{id}) and item.document (direct PDF) to fetch full announcements. RSS ttl=15 min; JSON/XML refresh daily. For per-issuer history, hit the HTML filter pages by ticker/ISIN. Deduplicate on numeric item id.

api.endpoint: https://eho.zse.hr/feed/json (HR) and https://eho.zse.hr/en/feed/json (EN); also /feed/xml and /feed/rss with same params
api.params: variant=issuerNews|tradingNews|financialReports|observationSegment|suspensions (default issuerNews). Feed page documents additional filtering by ticker symbol and date. Per-issuer/per-security HTML views exist at /en/issuer-announcements/issuer/{TICKER} and /security/{ISIN}.
api.format: JSON (application/json;charset=utf-8); XML and RSS (text/xml) also available
api.headers: None required. Accept: application/json optional. No cookies/session needed.

download.type: JSON (per-announcement PDF documents linked in each item's 'document' field, e.g. https://eho.zse.hr//fileadmin/issuers/INGR/ZPI-INGR-...pdf)

eho.zse.hr.next_action: Set up a scheduled JSON-feed poller across the five variants (HR+EN). Optionally map issuerCode/ISIN to the watchlist of Croatian issuers (HPB, ZABA, KBZ, IKB, ADRS, etc.) for targeted per-issuer filtering.
eho.zse.hr.notes: Serves Croatia (Zagreb Stock Exchange, XZAG). Fully open, no login/paywall/CAPTCHA/JS blocking for data - feeds are the clean machine-readable path and cover the JS-rendered announcement UI. All 15 sample URLs (homepage, EN/HR announcement hubs, per-security ISIN pages, per-issuer ticker pages, and RSS variants) reachable HTTP 200. No dead URLs.

money.bg.recommended_method: HTML scraping. Crawl section pages (/finance/, /business, /economics, /company) and tag/company pages (/about/{tag}) which contain article links directly in static HTML (content-type text/html). Paginate with ?page=N (tested ?page=2 -> HTTP 200). Article pages follow /{category}/{slug}.html and are also static HTML. Respect robots.txt crawl-delay: 10s. No auth/cookies/JS needed.
money.bg.next_action: Build an HTML scraper over the relevant section/tag pages with ?page pagination and 10s delay; parse article .html pages for title/date/body. Optionally focus tag pages like /about/banki, /about/prokredit-bank, /about/paynetics for entity-specific coverage.
money.bg.notes: Bulgaria. All 9 sample URLs reachable (HTTP 200). No RSS/Atom feed and no XML sitemap - every unknown/feed/sitemap path 301-redirects to the homepage. Site is fully static-HTML scrapeable, no JS rendering required. Tag pages under /about/ are per-topic/per-company listings (banki=banks, prokredit-bank, paynetics). No dead sample URLs.

unicredit.ba.resource_type: HTML index page linking PDF reports/disclosures
unicredit.ba.recommended_method: HTTP GET with a real browser User-Agent header (default UAs are 403'd by Akamai bot protection). Fetch the index HTML pages (izvjestaji.html, tarife_naknada.html, obavijesti.html, press.html, karijere.html), regex-extract href to /content/dam/...*.pdf and /ba/popupeditpages/.../press/*.html, then GET each asset (URL-encode paths — many contain spaces/diacritics). No login, no cookies, no CAPTCHA, no JS needed.
unicredit.ba.error_reason: HTTP 403 (Akamai bot filter) on default/WebFetch User-Agent; resolved by sending a browser UA which returns 200
unicredit.ba.next_action: Automate crawl of the index pages with a spoofed browser UA on a scheduled basis; parse PDF links per workstream (A1 annual reports/Objava podataka, A3 material-event notices, A6/pricing Tarife naknada, A5 karijere, press for news). Optionally OCR/parse annual-report PDFs for financials.
unicredit.ba.notes: Serves Bosnia (UniCredit Bank d.d. Mostar, FBiH). All 5 tested sample URLs are LIVE (return 200 with browser UA) — none dead; the only obstacle is UA-based bot filtering, fully reproducible outside a browser. bg.linkedin.com.resource_type: JSON/HTML API (guest jobs endpoint returning HTML card fragments)
bg.linkedin.com.recommended_method: For A5 (jobs/early-intent): poll the jobs-guest seeMoreJobPostings/search endpoint per keyword (payment, fintech, card, POS, acquiring, банка) and per target employer (Payhawk, Paysafe, SumUp, myPOS, tbi bank, UniCredit Bulbank, DSK, Fibank, UBB, ePay.bg) with location=Bulgaria/Sofia, paginating via start until empty. Parse job cards from the HTML (data-entity-urn / job title / company / posted date), then fetch individual /jobs/view/<id> pages for detail. Throttle aggressively (LinkedIn returns HTTP 429 under load) and rotate; no auth needed. Company-specific job facets can be obtained by resolving each company to its LinkedIn numeric id and using f_C. Company/profile-level data (A1/A6) requires the official LinkedIn API or manual/logged-in review — treat as manual.

api.params: keywords (e.g. payment, fintech, banking, payment specialist), location (e.g. Sofia, Bulgaria), start (offset, increments of 10/25 for pagination); optional f_C (company id facet), geoId, f_TPR (date-posted filter)
api.format: HTML fragment (<li> job cards with data-entity-urn=urn:li:jobPosting:<id>, title, company, location, posted date, and job-view link)
api.headers: Plain User-Agent sufficient (tested with Mozilla/5.0); no cookie/login required for this endpoint
api.auth_needed: No for the jobs-guest search endpoint; YES for full company pages, individual profiles, applicant counts and most other LinkedIn data

bg.linkedin.com.next_action: Build a throttled collector against the jobs-guest search endpoint with per-employer and per-keyword queries for Bulgaria; handle 429 with backoff. For company disclosures/headcount, use official LinkedIn API access or manual review.
bg.linkedin.com.notes: Serves Bulgaria. The /jobs/<slug> vanity URLs (payment-card-jobs-sofia, fintech-jobs, payhawk-jobs, banking-jobs, etc.) are guest landing pages that return 200 but load job lists via the jobs-guest API — that API is the true reproducible collection path and works without login. Company pages (/company/epay.bg) return 200 but are largely sign-in-gated. Main risk is LinkedIn rate-limiting (429) and ToS on automated access, not reachability. No sample URLs were dead.

Filter act titles for banking/payment keywords (banka, platni promet, osiguranje depozita, Centralna banka) and for A1 corporate disclosures target AOD annual work reports.

api.params: godina=<year e.g. 2026>; nivoIzdavanja_FK=<publication level: 1=Sluzbeni glasnik BiH state gazette, 2=Sluzbene novine Federacije BiH, 5=Sluzbene novine Kantona Sarajevo, 7=BiH medjunarodni ugovori/international treaties>. Procurement equivalent: GET /Oglasi/Oglasi with same params.
api.format: HTML partial (list of issue buttons, each with an obfuscated /page/i/<id> issue link). Issue pages contain acts as /page/akt/<id>, each rendered as full-text HTML.
api.headers: None special; standard GET, X-Requested-With not required. No cookies/login needed (verified via curl outside browser).

sluzbenilist.ba.next_action: Build the year x level enumeration crawler over /Docs/Izdanja and /Oglasi/Oglasi as described; no auth or JS engine needed. Optionally map the obfuscated /page/i/ and /page/akt/ ID scheme for stable deep-linking.

Single-domain batch, n=11, high value: covers A1 (AOD & bank annual reports/disclosures), A2 (Oglasi/javne nabavke procurement), A3 (payment-system/regulatory acts), A4 (banking-sector deposit statistics inside acts/reports), A6. www and non-www both work; http redirects to https. data.gov.hr.resource_type: JSON API (CKAN Action API) over statistics/open-data portal
data.gov.hr.recommended_method: Harvest via CKAN Action API: page through package_search (rows=1000,start=...) to enumerate all datasets, or filter by organization (fq=organization=hrvatska-narodna-banka / hrvatska-agencija-za-nadzor-financijskih-usluga / financijska-agencija). For each relevant dataset call package_show to read resource download URLs, then fetch the resource files directly. Pure HTTP/curl, no browser or JS engine needed. Note: some resource URLs point OUT to external portals (e.g. FINA RGFI at rgfi.fina.hr/JavnaObjava-web which requires its own login) — the CKAN entry gives metadata but the bulk data on those external portals may need separate/manual access.

api.params: package_search: q, rows, start (paging), fq (facet filter e.g. organization=hrvatska-narodna-banka), sort. package_show: id=<dataset-slug>. organization_show: id=<org-slug>&include_datasets=true
api.auth_needed: No (public read API; no key/cookie/session needed)

download.url: Per-dataset resource URLs obtained from package_show (each resource has a 'url' field, e.g. CSV/XLSX/PDF/JSON). Example dataset: https://data.gov.hr/ckan/api/3/action/package_show?id=registar-godisnjih-financijskih-izvjestaja-javna-objava
download.type: Mixed per dataset (CSV, XLSX, PDF, JSON, XML); resource formats exposed in API

Registers (leasing/factoring) render as HTML tables, not file downloads. SRPI is a searchable register with per-filing PDFs and no bulk export/API.
