api.params: multipart/form-data fields: json_type (e.g. 'ticker', and other types for indexes/companies/financials), code (ticker symbol or empty), lang ('en'|'bg'), page (pagination, may be empty)
api.headers: None required; standard browser User-Agent sufficient; no cookie/session needed

x3analytics.com.next_action: Map remaining json_type values (indexes, company profile, financial statements) from js.min.js for full A1 coverage
x3analytics.com.notes: Serves Bulgaria. A1 corporate disclosures / A5. WebFetch failed on TLS cert (unable to verify first certificate) but curl works fine. Data returned in EUR.

easypay.bg.recommended_method: Static HTML scrape of easypay.bg/site/ pages (?p=documents, ?p=atm) with query-param routing; EN and BG versions available (/site/en/). No JS needed.
easypay.bg.next_action: For A1 financial disclosures note none published here (regulatory/compliance PDFs only); financials likely via Commercial Register instead
easypay.bg.notes: Serves Bulgaria (Izipey AD). A1/A3/A4. Documents page has compliance PDFs but NO financial statements/annual reports.

evroto.bg.recommended_method: Static HTML scrape of the news section (EN /en and BG /) for euro-adoption announcements and deadlines; no JS or API required.
evroto.bg.next_action: Locate news-listing URL path for A3 deadline tracking; check for RSS by testing /feed or /rss
evroto.bg.notes: Serves Bulgaria. A1/A3. Official euro-adoption site (ABB-run). Content-driven news; no downloads/API surfaced.

karieri.bg.recommended_method: Requires a real browser session to pass Cloudflare bot challenge; use headless browser with JS/cookie support (e.g. Playwright) rather than plain HTTP. Then scrape /jobs and /company/<id> pages.
karieri.bg.next_action: Validate via browser automation that solves/passes the Cloudflare JS challenge; confirm job-listing and company-profile URL patterns
karieri.bg.notes: Serves Bulgaria. A1/A3/A5. Cloudflare challenge blocks plain HTTP fetch for both homepage and /jobs; not a paywall/CAPTCHA login but a bot-detection interstitial.

tbibank.bg.resource_type: HTML page + developer API portal + PDF
tbibank.bg.recommended_method: For A1/A6 monitoring: static HTML scrape of news page (note /en/about-tbi-bank/news 301-redirects to /news-test/) and PSD2 stats PDFs. The PSD2 API is for banking transactions, not market-intel collection, and needs TPP licensing.

api.params: Berlin Group / Bulgarian BISTRA standard PSD2 endpoints (AIS/PIS); sandbox base tbibank-sb, production separate
api.headers: PSD2 standard headers; production requires eIDAS QWAC/QSEAL certificate and TPP authorisation
api.auth_needed: Yes for production (licensed TPP + eIDAS certs); sandbox open for testing

download.type: PDF (PSD2 reporting statistics, monthly, incl. Jan-May 2026)

tbibank.bg.next_action: Confirm the current canonical news URL (/news-test/ looks like a staging slug) and monitor it for A2/A5/A6 signals
tbibank.bg.notes: Serves Bulgaria. A2/A5/A6. News EN page redirects to /news-test/ (verify intended). PSD2 dev portal exists but is transactional banking API, not a data-collection source.

sabor.hr.recommended_method: Scrape the server-rendered list pages (sjednice, dnevni-red, novi-akti, kronologija/rasporedi-rasprava, radna-tijela committees) directly with HTTP GET. For monitoring, poll the per-view RSS feed (content-type text/xml) — pattern /sabor-rss-feed/<section>/<view>?v=..&d=..&t=.. — or hit the XLSX export link on each list. No JS, cookies, or auth needed.

download.type: RSS/XML (also XLSX and PDF export via Views export buttons)

sabor.hr.next_action: Set up scraping/RSS polling of the relevant Sabor views (novi-akti, dnevni-red, sjednice, finance committee) for A3 regulation/deadline tracking; map each view's RSS/XLSX export URL.
sabor.hr.notes: Croatia. Croatian Parliament official site, fully public server-rendered HTML on Apache/AlmaLinux. All 8 sample URLs returned HTTP 200. RSS feeds and XLSX/PDF exports available per list view (Drupal). Workstreams A3 (regulation/deadlines) and A5. No dead URLs.

opencorporates.al.resource_type: HTML register (per-NIPT) + per-company XLSX/PDF financial-statement downloads
opencorporates.al.recommended_method: Scrape server-rendered company pages via NIPT URL pattern https://opencorporates.al/{sq|en}/nipt/{NIPT} (HTTP GET, Cloudflare-fronted but 200 for normal requests, no JS/auth). Enumerate via category listing pages (e.g. /sq/concession, banking category) then follow NIPT links. Harvest attached financial-statement files under /documents/bilanci/ and /documents/dokumenta/. Also cross-reference AIS sibling portals (opendata.al, openprocurement.al) for CSV/JSON.

download.type: XLSX (bank financial statements) + PDF/TIF/JPEG scanned documents under /documents/

opencorporates.al.next_action: Build NIPT-based scraper over company + category pages for A2/A5/A6; validate one XLSX financial-statement download; check AIS opendata.al/openprocurement.al APIs for bulk JSON/CSV as a cleaner source.
opencorporates.al.notes: Albania. Run by AIS (Instituti Shqiptar i Shkencave). All 7 sample URLs HTTP 200. Rich server-rendered per-company data incl. bank board/administrator records and financial statements — good for A2 (tenders/concessions), A5, A6. /api exists but returns 500 with no params (not a confirmed public API). Cloudflare-fronted; heavy scraping may trigger rate limits. No dead URLs.

cbonds.com.recommended_method: Cannot reproduce without a paid Cbonds commercial agreement + API token. Web pages return HTTP 403 (Cloudflare anti-bot). For automated collection, procure a Cbonds API subscription and use the JSON datafeed with the issued token; otherwise treat as manual/licensed source.

api.endpoint: https://cbonds.com/api/ (catalog at https://cbonds.com/api/catalog/, bonds https://cbonds.com/api/bonds/, stocks https://cbonds.com/api/stocks/)
api.params: endpoint-specific filters (issuer, ISIN, country, dates); documented in API_documentation_eng.pdf
api.format: JSON (also file samples in other formats)
api.headers: API key / token from bilateral agreement
api.auth_needed: Yes - paid subscription; access only to legal entities via signed bilateral agreement; individuals not eligible

cbonds.com.error_reason: 403 (Cloudflare anti-bot on all web URLs); API behind paid subscription/legal-entity agreement
cbonds.com.next_action: Business decision: procure Cbonds API subscription/agreement, then automate via JSON datafeed with token. No unauthenticated scraping possible.
cbonds.com.notes: Commercial financial-data aggregator serving all 4 countries (Albania, Bosnia, Bulgaria, Croatia). Every web URL (homepage, country/Albania-bond, company/43757, country/Croatia-bond, stocks/HRHPB0RA0002) returns 403 to non-browser clients; content is paywalled. Data exists but is licensed.

www2.deloitte.com.recommended_method: Deloitte has migrated www2.deloitte.com to www.deloitte.com. The old article/tax-alert URLs 301 to generic www.deloitte.com/ce landing pages. For automated collection, crawl the new www.deloitte.com/ce/en (services/insights/research) and country pages (/al, /bg) for banking outlook + tax/legal alert articles, and download linked PDFs from the /content/dam/ DAM. Publicly accessible HTML/PDF, no auth. Refresh saved URLs to the new domain.
www2.deloitte.com.error_reason: Sample article URLs 301-redirect to generic pages (specific pages retired in site migration); old DAM PDF path returns 404
www2.deloitte.com.next_action: Re-map tracker URLs to www.deloitte.com/ce/en and country subsites; identify current banking-outlook/tax-alert article + PDF URLs via site nav/search and schedule periodic crawl.
www2.deloitte.com.notes: Global professional-services publisher; covers all 4 countries via CE hub (/ce) and country subsites (/al Albania, /bg Bulgaria) plus Croatia within CE. Sample URLs functionally dead: the specific Albania legal/tax-alert and CE banking-outlook article paths now redirect to generic landing pages. Content still public, just relocated.

ndiqparate.al.recommended_method: ndiqparate.al is a reachable WordPress site (bilingual: ?lang=en for English). Scrape article pages by ?p=<id>, ?cat=<id>, ?tag=<slug>. For structured/bulk data follow to the AIS open-data portals (spending.data.al, openprocurement.al, opencorporates.al) which host the actual datasets and are also HTTP-200; check those for CSV/JSON exports/APIs during the collection phase.
ndiqparate.al.next_action: Crawl ndiqparate.al article feed for A1/A2/A4/A5 analyses; separately profile the linked spending/procurement/corporates portals for dataset exports or APIs.
ndiqparate.al.notes: Serves Albania. AIS (Albanian Institute of Science) investigative/transparency project 'Follow the Money'. Fully reachable, bilingual (add ?lang=en). Sample URLs all live; the real structured datasets live on sister portals (spending.data.al etc.), not on ndiqparate.al itself.

devbusiness.un.org.recommended_method: Do not rely on this source: the homepage returns a 'Human Verification' bot-challenge page to scripted clients and the service title is 'UN Development Business Phase Down' (being discontinued). For live UN/UNDP tender notices use ungm.org (also in this batch), which is open and machine-queryable.
devbusiness.un.org.error_reason: Bot challenge / 'Human Verification' interstitial (title returned = 'Human Verification'); homepage is a 2 KB JS SPA shell with no server-rendered content
devbusiness.un.org.next_action: Treat as deprecated; redirect collection to UNGM. If UNDB content is still specifically needed, use a real browser session to pass the human-verification page and confirm whether notice search still works.
devbusiness.un.org.notes: Serves Albania and Bosnia (A2/A3). Service is being phased down and is gated by a human-verification wall for scripted access. Overlaps heavily with UNGM which is fully accessible.

ungm.org.resource_type: HTML page + XHR search endpoint (returns HTML result rows)
ungm.org.recommended_method: POST to https://www.ungm.org/Public/Notice/Search with a JSON body (set PageSize and PageIndex to page; filter Countries[] for Albania/Bosnia). Parse returned HTML rows for data-noticeid, then fetch notice detail at /Public/Notice/{id}. No auth needed; reproducible outside a browser (tested via curl).

api.params: JSON body: PageIndex, PageSize, Title, Description, Reference, PublishedFrom/To, DeadlineFrom/To, Countries[], Agencies[], UNSPSCs[], NoticeTypes[], SortField (e.g. DatePublished), SortAscending
api.format: HTML fragment (table rows with data-noticeid attributes), not JSON
api.headers: Content-Type: application/json; Accept: application/json (works with default UA)
api.auth_needed: No - public search works without login/cookies

ungm.org.next_action: Build collector around the POST /Public/Notice/Search endpoint with country filters and pagination.
ungm.org.notes: Serves Albania and Bosnia (A2). Both sample URLs (/public/notice and /Public/Notice) reachable. Search returns HTML fragments, so parse HTML rather than expect JSON.

top-channel.tv.resource_type: HTML page (WordPress category, paginated) + WordPress RSS (Cloudflare-gated)
top-channel.tv.recommended_method: Scrape the WordPress category page https://top-channel.tv/artikuj/vendi/ekonomi/ and follow /page/2/, /page/3/ pagination for headlines/articles. Use a realistic browser User-Agent because Cloudflare blocks generic scripted requests. RSS at /feed/ and /artikuj/vendi/ekonomi/feed/ exists (WordPress) but returns HTTP 403 to scripted clients via Cloudflare.
top-channel.tv.error_reason: Cloudflare returns HTTP 403 on /feed/ endpoints for non-browser clients
top-channel.tv.next_action: Scrape ekonomi category HTML with a browser-like UA; consider headless rendering if Cloudflare escalates.
top-channel.tv.notes: Serves Albania (A3 regulation/press, A6). WordPress site behind Cloudflare. Recent economy headlines confirmed relevant (inflation, digital lek, bank real-estate exposure). RSS exists but is Cloudflare-blocked; HTML category scraping with browser UA is the reliable path.

openknowledge.worldbank.org.resource_type: JSON REST API (DSpace) + PDF/Excel bitstream downloads
openknowledge.worldbank.org.recommended_method: Use the DSpace 7.6 REST API: GET /server/api/discover/search/objects?query=... with country/date filters to enumerate publications, then /server/api/core/items/{uuid} for metadata and item bundles/bitstreams for PDF/Excel downloads. Fully reproducible without a browser (tested).

api.endpoint: https://openknowledge.worldbank.org/server/api/discover/search/objects (search); /server/api/core/items/{uuid} (item metadata); /server/api/core/items/{uuid}/bundles then bitstreams for file downloads
api.params: query=<terms> (e.g. 'Albania financial sector'), size, page, sort, f.* filters (e.g. dateIssued, country)
api.format: JSON (HAL/_embedded); files served as PDF/XLSX bitstreams

openknowledge.worldbank.org.next_action: Build DSpace REST collector with country/topic queries and bitstream download.
openknowledge.worldbank.org.notes: Serves Albania and Bosnia (A1/A3). Sample entity UUID resolves to a live 2025 Albania public finance report - relevant. Standard DSpace REST API is the clean collection method.

webalkans.eu.resource_type: HTML page (paginated news listing with country filter)
webalkans.eu.recommended_method: Scrape https://webalkans.eu/en/news/ with numbered pagination (1..101) and the Country filter (Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, etc.). Note the old news URL path redirects (301): /en/news/<slug>/ now resolves to /en/<slug>/.
webalkans.eu.next_action: Scrape /en/news/ listing with country filter + pagination; follow redirects.
webalkans.eu.notes: Serves Albania and Bosnia (A3). Reform-agenda/accession news relevant. Sample deep URL still works via 301 redirect; recommend using the canonical /en/<slug>/ form and the /en/news/ listing.

nexicentraleurope.com.recommended_method: Static HTML scrape of the About/company pages for footprint and service description. No structured statistics or downloads on this site - for market/volume figures use Nexi Group investor relations (nexigroup.com) instead.
nexicentraleurope.com.next_action: Use for qualitative footprint (Croatia) only; source quantitative payment stats from Nexi Group IR or the Croatian National Bank.
nexicentraleurope.com.notes: Batch lists Albania and Croatia (A4), but Nexi Central Europe's stated footprint is SK/CZ/HR/HU/RS - relevant to Croatia, NOT Albania. Marketing/qualitative content only; no market-statistics dataset here.

openpay.al.recommended_method: Static HTML scrape of the WordPress pages (Home, About us, Merchants) for company/product profile. No data portal or downloads. LinkedIn (linkedin.com/company/openpayal) and parent Symmetric Group (symmetric.al) are useful for jobs/early-intent (A5).
openpay.al.next_action: Scrape company/product pages; monitor LinkedIn for A5 hiring signals.
openpay.al.notes: Serves Albania (A4/A5). Vendor/competitor marketing site (WordPress). Limited structured data; value is company profile + social/LinkedIn for hiring signals.

ausschreibungen.giz.de.resource_type: HTML page (paginated tender table) + per-tender detail pages
ausschreibungen.giz.de.recommended_method: Scrape the public project table at /Satellite/company/welcome.do?method=showTable (supports pagination selectedTablePagePROJECT_RESULT and sorting tableSortAttributePROJECT_RESULT=publicationDate/title). Each row links to a tender via /Satellite/public/company/projectForwarding.do?pid=<id>. Publicly readable without login (login only needed to bid). Reproducible with a browser UA.
ausschreibungen.giz.de.next_action: Build scraper on welcome.do showTable + projectForwarding.do detail pages; parse country/location per tender to filter Albania/Bosnia.
ausschreibungen.giz.de.notes: Serves Albania and Bosnia (A4/A2 tenders). German-language cosinex portal; the welcome.do table is the live public tender listing. Tender detail pages are public via projectForwarding.do?pid=.

akep.al.recommended_method: Static HTTP scraping. Crawl the statistics page https://akep.al/publikime/statistika/ (SQ) and English mirror https://akep.al/en/publications/statistics/, plus the regulatory-acts and consultations index pages, and harvest links matching /wp-content/uploads/.*\.(pdf|docx). Files download directly via curl/GET with no auth, cookies, or JS. For A3 regulation/consultation monitoring, periodically diff the Steering Council decisions and consultation index pages.
akep.al.next_action: Set up scheduled link-harvest crawler over statistics + decisions + consultations pages; parse the PDFs/DOCX for market-share and subscriber figures. Prefer EN pages where available, fall back to SQ.
akep.al.notes: Serves Albania. AKEP is the national telecom/postal regulator (A3 regulation/deadlines, A6 vendors/competitors via operator market shares, plus A4 market statistics). All 9 sample URLs reachable; only note is /statistika/ now 301-redirects to /publikime/statistika/ (old path still works). No dead URLs. Reports dated to 2024/06 are current; older 2021/2016 versions still hosted.

ccbank.bg.recommended_method: Scrape the annual-reports and financial-statements listing pages (both /en/ and /bg/ paths) for /en/files/{id}-*.pdf and /bg/files/... links; download PDFs directly by URL (no auth, no JS). Poll /bg/za-ckb/novini and /en/about-ccb/news for A1 disclosures and /bg/za-ckb/karieri for A5 jobs. File IDs increment (~1374=2020 ... 2367=2024) so new-year reports are predictable.
ccbank.bg.next_action: Set up periodic scrape of reports + news + careers pages; capture new annual/financial PDFs each year.
ccbank.bg.notes: Bulgaria. Central Cooperative Bank (ЦКБ/CCB). Bilingual site (EN /en/, BG /bg/), no login/JS needed for reports. All sample URLs reachable. Workstreams A1 (reports/news), A5 (careers) well covered; A4/A6 via report contents.

procreditbank.com.al.recommended_method: Scrape the annual-reports and financial-reports listing pages (eng/ and shq/ paths) for /Uploads/Data/Files/*.pdf links and download directly (no auth/JS; PDF confirmed 11.3MB, application/pdf). The financial-reports (raportet-financiare) page 302-redirects to a year subpath — follow redirects and iterate year subpaths. Poll /shq/lajme/ and /shq/njoftime/ for A1/A3 news and product/payments pages for A6.
procreditbank.com.al.next_action: Periodic scrape of annual + financial report listings (both languages) and news/njoftime pages; PDF filenames have random suffixes so must be harvested from listing pages, not guessed.
procreditbank.com.al.notes: Albania. ProCredit Bank Albania. Bilingual (eng/, shq/). No login/JS needed. Financial-reports URL redirects to a year subfolder (year-partitioned). All sample URLs reachable. A1 (reports), A3/A6 (news, payments/product pages), A5 (careers) covered.

nasa-banka.com.recommended_method: Plain HTTP scrape of the WordPress site. All 4 sample URLs return 200 with plain curl (no JS). Crawl /finansijski-izvjestaji/ and its child pages plus /vijesti/ (konkurs = job postings appear as news items) and /zaposlenje-u-banci/; harvest PDF links under /wp-content/uploads/. English mirror at /en/... , German at /de/... . Optional: WP REST API at /wp-json/wp/v2/ may be available.
nasa-banka.com.next_action: Enumerate financial-reports child pages / yearly folders to list annual-report PDFs; monitor /vijesti/ for 'Konkurs' job postings (A5).
nasa-banka.com.notes: Serves Bosnia (Republika Srpska, Banja Luka/Bijeljina). All sample URLs live. Individual annual-report PDFs are on child pages, not directly on the parent page grep. Sample name references a 'BLSE issuer page' (Banja Luka Stock Exchange, blberza.com) which is a SEPARATE domain, not nasa-banka.com.

king-ict.com.recommended_method: Scrape with a real browser User-Agent. Plain curl (default UA) returns HTTP 403 (WAF/bot protection) on the homepage and all sample paths, but WebFetch (browser-like UA) retrieves full content. Set a normal browser User-Agent header, or use a headless browser, then crawl /projects/, /ict-projects/, newshub and /careers/. Careers page has no live vacancy list, it routes to an 'Open Application' talent-platform link; watch the newshub for reference/project announcements.
king-ict.com.error_reason: HTTP 403 to default curl UA (WAF); bypassed by browser User-Agent
king-ict.com.next_action: Confirm the /ict-projects/ vs /projects/ canonical URL; locate the talent-platform ATS URL for actual job listings; crawl newshub for banking-infrastructure references.
king-ict.com.notes: Serves Bosnia (Sarajevo office) and Croatia (HQ, Zagreb). All content reachable via browser UA; only the default curl UA is blocked (403). Careers page lists no explicit vacancies, only open-application intake.

nra.bg.recommended_method: Fetch the clean-path WebSphere Portal URLs (e.g. /wps/portal/nra/registers-i-spisuci, .../registers, and .../fiskalni-ustroystva-supto-i-e-magazini/... ) with curl -k (or a full CA bundle): the server presents an INCOMPLETE TLS chain, so strict validation fails ('unable to verify the first certificate') - this is why WebFetch errored. Use -k / supply the intermediate cert. Pages are server-rendered HTML (no JS). Ignore the volatile '!ut/p/z1/...' session-token variants and use the readable clean paths. Register detail pages link to downloadable model lists; note approved-model registers are legally maintained by BIM (Bulgarian Institute of Metrology).
nra.bg.error_reason: TLS chain incomplete: 'unable to verify the first certificate' (WebFetch failed; curl needs -k). Homepage 302-redirects to /wps/portal/
nra.bg.next_action: Open specific register subpages (SUPTO declared-software list; EKAFP/ESFP model registers) to capture the actual downloadable list files/formats; fix TLS by adding the missing intermediate CA.
nra.bg.notes: Serves Bulgaria. Site is IBM WebSphere Portal (/wps/portal/). Main caveat is the incomplete TLS chain - automated collectors must use -k or bundle the intermediate cert. All sample URLs resolve; the deep taxes/oblagane.prodajbi.internet and profil-na-kupovacha paths sit under the same portal and follow the same access pattern.

forbesbulgaria.com.recommended_method: Use the public WordPress REST API /wp-json/wp/v2/posts (tested: returns full post JSON incl. slug, link, dates, content) with search=/categories=/after= params for topic and date filtering - most reliable for automated collection. Fallback: on-site search https://forbesbulgaria.com/?s=<term> (HTTP 200) and category pages. All plain HTTP, no JS needed for the API.

api.params: per_page, page, search, categories, after, before, orderby (standard WP REST params)

forbesbulgaria.com.error_reason: Sample article URL /forbes-society/mypos/ 302-redirects to the homepage (article moved/removed)
forbesbulgaria.com.next_action: Query the REST API with search='myPOS'/'fintech' and category filters to recover the myPOS coverage that the dead slug pointed to; map category IDs for money/startups/technology.
forbesbulgaria.com.notes: Serves Bulgaria. Site fully live; only the specific sample article /forbes-society/mypos/ is dead (redirects home). WP REST API is the best collection route. /fba/ awards listing currently shows 'no products' (WooCommerce), so use posts/events instead.

apif.net.resource_type: register (Joomla portal: HTML pages + search forms + PDF financial reports)
apif.net.recommended_method: HTTP GET the Joomla pages with a real browser User-Agent header (mandatory: default/curl UA is rejected with HTTP 403; Mozilla UA returns 200). Parse register/publication HTML pages directly. For company-level financial reports use the public search pages (Registar finansijskih izvjestaja / Registar poslovnih subjekata); full financial-report PDF downloads require a client contract/login and must be validated manually. Business-subject cross-search is delegated to external portal bizreg.esrpska.com.

download.type: PDF (financial reports); public 'Javno dostupni podaci' for 2012-2014, full via 'Preuzimanje finansijskih izvjestaja' contract section

apif.net.error_reason: curl default User-Agent blocked with HTTP 403 (bot filter); external business-register portal bizreg.esrpska.com timed out (HTTP 000) from this environment
apif.net.next_action: For automated collection, fetch APIF register/publication pages with a spoofed browser UA and scrape the public search results; separately obtain APIF client credentials/contract to reach full financial-report PDF downloads, and confirm bizreg.esrpska.com reachability (may be geo/IP restricted).
apif.net.notes: Serves Bosnia (Republika Srpska entity) - APIF a.d. Banja Luka, key A1 corporate-disclosure source (business register + financial statements register + unified account register JRR). Site is a Joomla install that 403s non-browser User-Agents; all sample article/category URLs return 200 with a browser UA (none confirmed dead). Full financial-report downloads and register logins are behind contract/authentication (paywall). External bizreg.esrpska.com business-register search timed out and needs manual reachability check.

posta.hr.recommended_method: Scrape hrvatska.posta.hr/hr/javna-nabava for the Registar ugovora and tender listings; individual tender/contract docs are PDFs under /UserDocsImages/. For legally-binding tender data also cross-reference EOJN (Elektronicki oglasnik javne nabave).
posta.hr.error_reason: HTTP 302: legacy sample URL /registar-ugovora-o-javnoj-nabavi-i-okvirnih-sporazuma-299/299 now redirects to homepage (dead deep link)
posta.hr.next_action: Point collector at hrvatska.posta.hr/hr/javna-nabava (procurement register + tenders); homepage posta.hr OK for newsroom
posta.hr.notes: Croatia. Sample deep URL for the contract register is dead (302 to home); register migrated to the hrvatska.posta.hr subdomain. Homepage posta.hr returns 200. Workstreams A2 (tenders) + A5 (newsroom).

azop.hr.recommended_method: Scrape azop.hr/rjesenja/ (categorised list, no pagination/search); follow per-decision PDF links, filtering the 'Obrada osobnih podataka od strane banaka' (bank) and monetary-penalty sections. Also monitor azop.hr homepage news feed for enforcement announcements.
azop.hr.next_action: Scrape rjesenja page + PDFs; add news feed for A3 regulatory alerts
azop.hr.notes: Croatia. National DPA. Directly relevant to A3 (regulation/enforcement); explicit banking-enforcement decisions present. Static HTML, no auth.

kartice.hr.recommended_method: Light periodic scrape of product/category pages for competitor/vendor intelligence (A6). No structured data or statistics; this is a marketing catalog, so treat as low-value monitoring only.
kartice.hr.next_action: Optional low-frequency scrape for vendor/product changes
kartice.hr.notes: Croatia. Commercial POS/card vendor (ETRANET Grupa, Ingenico distributor). Relevant only as A6 vendor/competitor signal, not a data source. A4 'market statistics' tag is not really supported - only self-reported marketing figures.

nn.hr.recommended_method: For legislation/regulatory monitoring (A3) use the e-Narodne novine gazette portal narodne-novine.nn.hr (per-issue browse + full-text search; acts have stable ELI URLs and PDF versions). nn.hr/hr/trazi is the corporate-site search; the actual acts live on the narodne-novine subdomain.
nn.hr.next_action: Point collector at narodne-novine.nn.hr full-text search / ELI act URLs for A3 legislation
nn.hr.notes: Croatia. nn.hr is the publisher corporate portal; the substantive regulatory data (official gazette) is on the narodne-novine.nn.hr subdomain. ELI-based act addressing supports stable deep links.

hr.jooble.org.recommended_method: Preferred: Jooble official Jobs API (POST jooble.org/api/{apikey}, JSON) which requires a free API key and reliably returns structured listings. Direct scraping of hr.jooble.org is bot-blocked (HTTP 403) so should be avoided.

api.params: JSON body {keywords, location, page}
api.auth_needed: Yes - free API key on request

hr.jooble.org.error_reason: HTTP 403 - Cloudflare/bot protection blocks curl and WebFetch (both plain and browser User-Agent)
hr.jooble.org.next_action: Register for a Jooble API key and use the JSON API filtered by banking keywords/location=Hrvatska; do not scrape the HTML directly
hr.jooble.org.notes: Croatia. A5 early-intent (banking jobs). Website is bot-protected (403). The compliant/reproducible path is the Jooble partner API (needs key). Manual step: obtain API key.

vlada.gov.hr.recommended_method: Scrape vlada.gov.hr/sjednice/{id} listing pages (numeric section IDs, e.g. 9 and 13) for session agendas and adopted measures; follow through to individual session/news pages for bill proposals relevant to banking/payments regulation (A3) and appointments (A5).
vlada.gov.hr.next_action: Enumerate session-list pages and parse agenda items; consider RSS/news feed if present
vlada.gov.hr.notes: Croatia. Government sessions portal. Both sample URLs (/sjednice/13, /sjednice/9) return 200. WebFetch surfaced limited body text (heavy nav template) but pages are static/server-rendered - a targeted scrape will get agenda content.

dzs.gov.hr.recommended_method: Use the DZS PxWeb API at web.dzs.hr/PXWeb/api/v1/hr/ for automated statistics collection (GET to walk the DB tree, POST px-query for specific tables, request CSV/JSON). Human-facing portal is podaci.dzs.hr; DZS datasets are also mirrored on data.gov.hr (CKAN). For the Household Budget Survey (APK) use the APK release pages under podaci.dzs.hr.

api.params: GET returns db list [{dbid,text}]; drill down /{db}/... to a px table then POST JSON px-query {query:[{code,selection:{filter,values}}],response:{format:'json'|'csv'|'px'}}

dzs.gov.hr.next_action: Implement PxWeb API client (walk tree -> POST table queries) for A4 statistics; scrape podaci.dzs.hr release pages for narrative PDFs
dzs.gov.hr.notes: Croatia. National statistics office. dzs.gov.hr is the institutional site; data lives on podaci.dzs.hr (portal) and web.dzs.hr/PXWeb (PC-Axis API, tested working, no auth). Strongest A4 source in this batch. Also on data.gov.hr CKAN.

hac.hr.recommended_method: Scrape hac.hr/hr/javna-nabava categories (Plan nabave, Registar ugovora, tender listings across ~31 pages) and follow PDF/EOJN links; filter for toll/ENC/payment-acceptance procurement (A4/A2). Cross-reference EOJN for authoritative tender records.
hac.hr.next_action: Scrape javna-nabava register + tender pages; parse EOJN references
hac.hr.notes: Croatia. Toll-road operator; procurement of payment/ENC systems relevant to payments intel. Static HTML, paginated tender list, PDF docs. Homepage and javna-nabava both 200.

skdd.hr.recommended_method: Scrape the public portal (f?p=100:1) section for 'Mjesecna statistika'; individual reports are served via SDAWEB.pkg_public.show_lob_hr?p_id=<id> (increment/enumerate p_id). No login needed for statistics; e-Ulagatelj investor data requires authentication and is out of scope.

download.type: PDF/document (monthly statistics via show_lob_hr endpoint, p_id param)

skdd.hr.next_action: Enumerate show_lob_hr p_id values or parse the statistics listing page in the APEX portal to collect monthly statistics PDFs
skdd.hr.notes: Croatia (A1 corporate disclosures). Central Securities Depository. Homepage is an Oracle APEX portal; public monthly statistics available without login. e-Ulagatelj = investor login only.

sredisnjikatalogrh.gov.hr.recommended_method: Use the site's document search UI; for automated collection inspect the search/XHR endpoint that backs the results (JS-rendered). Individual official documents (PDF) are linked from result pages. Manual/browser inspection recommended to capture the search API.
sredisnjikatalogrh.gov.hr.next_action: Open in a browser and capture the XHR/search endpoint powering document results, then reproduce for keyword queries (bank/payments/HNB deadlines)
sredisnjikatalogrh.gov.hr.notes: Croatia (A1). Government central catalog of official documents; JS-rendered SPA so structure needs browser inspection to find the backing search API.

telegram.hr.recommended_method: Poll the RSS feed https://www.telegram.hr/feed/ (application/rss+xml, 200) and/or scrape the /biznis-tech/ section HTML for banking/payments/fintech news (A3 regulation/deadlines).
telegram.hr.next_action: Filter RSS/section items for banking/fintech/regulatory keywords
telegram.hr.notes: Croatia (A3). Croatian news outlet; WordPress-style /feed/ RSS confirmed working.

ubik.hr.recommended_method: Scrape blog.ubik.hr for crypto/blockchain regulatory awareness posts and the members directory for vendor/competitor signals (A3). No RSS advertised on landing page; check blog for /feed.
ubik.hr.next_action: Scrape blog.ubik.hr and members list; test blog.ubik.hr/feed for RSS
ubik.hr.notes: Croatia (A3). Association site, mostly educational/community content; limited structured data. Low data density.

vecernji.hr.recommended_method: Poll RSS https://www.vecernji.hr/feeds/latest (200, application/rss+xml) and scrape the /biznis section; filter for banking/payments/regulatory items. Note per-topic /rss/biznis path is 404 — use /feeds/latest.
vecernji.hr.next_action: Use /feeds/latest RSS + section scrape with keyword filtering
vecernji.hr.notes: Croatia (A3). Major Croatian daily. Working RSS is /feeds/latest (topic-specific /rss/biznis is dead - 404).

bdo.hr.recommended_method: Scrape this static service page for competitor/vendor advisory positioning (A2/A6). For thought-leadership, crawl bdo.hr insights/publications section separately. Low update frequency.
bdo.hr.next_action: Optionally crawl bdo.hr/en-gb insights/publications for reports
bdo.hr.notes: Croatia (A2). Professional-services firm page; static, mainly firmographic context rather than a dataset.

cordis.europa.eu.recommended_method: Download full CORDIS project+organisation datasets from data.europa.eu (Horizon Europe / H2020 / FP7), filter organisations by country=HR and payments/fintech/banking keywords. Bulk files are the reliable source rather than scraping the JS search UI.
cordis.europa.eu.next_action: Fetch the CORDIS Horizon Europe ZIP and filter for Croatian participants
cordis.europa.eu.notes: Croatia (A2 tenders/EU projects). EU-wide source; stable open-data bulk downloads. High reliability.

conference.ecommerce.hr.recommended_method: Scrape the single-page site for sponsor/partner and speaker lists to surface payments-gateway vendors and ecommerce players (A2/A6). Sponsorship deck is behind a form (email-gated). Refresh near event date.
conference.ecommerce.hr.next_action: Extract sponsor/speaker directory for vendor mapping
conference.ecommerce.hr.notes: Croatia (A2/vendors). Good vendor/competitor signal (payment gateways as sponsors). Sponsorship PDF is form-gated.

cohesiondata.ec.europa.eu.recommended_method: Use the Socrata Discovery API (api/catalog/v1?domains=cohesiondata.ec.europa.eu) to list datasets, then pull each dataset via /resource/<id>.json or .csv with SODA $where filters (e.g. country HR) for cohesion/ESIF finance data (A2/A4). No auth needed.

api.params: domains, limit, offset, q (catalog); $where,$select,$limit,$offset (SODA dataset queries)
api.headers: None required for public data; optional X-App-Token for higher rate limits

cohesiondata.ec.europa.eu.next_action: Enumerate cohesiondata datasets via catalog API and pull Croatia-relevant ESIF finance datasets
cohesiondata.ec.europa.eu.notes: Croatia (A2). EU-wide open data (Socrata). API fully reproducible outside browser; note unfiltered catalog federates other Socrata domains, so always pass domains=cohesiondata.ec.europa.eu.

competitio.hr.recommended_method: Low value as a data source — B2B consulting site with no public tender data. For actual Croatian procurement data use the national EOJN portal instead. Optionally scrape for firmographic/competitor context (A2/A6).
competitio.hr.next_action: Deprioritise; redirect procurement collection to Croatia's EOJN (Elektronicki oglasnik javne nabave)
competitio.hr.notes: Croatia (A2). Consulting firm, not a data publisher. Recommend using official EOJN for tenders instead.

mft.gov.ba.resource_type: HTML page (.NET CMS) with PDF attachment downloads
mft.gov.ba.recommended_method: Server-rendered HTML — collect with plain HTTP GET, but a browser User-Agent header is REQUIRED (default curl/python UA is blocked and returns HTTP 404). Crawl the /Content/Read/<slug> section pages (e.g. informacije-o-javnom-dugu, izvrsenje-izvjestaji, tenderi, tenderska-dokumentacija, zakoni-i-podzakonski-akti), extract links matching /Content/OpenAttachment?id=<GUID>&lang=bs and download the PDFs. Use ?lang=bs|hr|sr|en to switch language. No JS/login/API needed.
mft.gov.ba.next_action: Automate section-page crawl with a browser User-Agent; enumerate OpenAttachment GUID links per section and store PDFs. Optionally map slugs per workstream: A1/A3 -> zakoni-i-podzakonski-akti, informacije-o-javnom-dugu, izvrsenje-izvjestaji; A2 -> tenderi/tenderska-dokumentacija/plan-javnih-nabavki/odluke; A4 -> javni-dug/budzet reports.
mft.gov.ba.notes: State-level Bosnia & Herzegovina Ministry of Finance and Treasury. All 13 sample URLs are LIVE when fetched with a browser User-Agent; the only gotcha is UA-based 404 blocking of default HTTP clients (not a real dead link). Homepage 302-redirects to a language landing. Both www and apex (mft.gov.ba) hosts work. Languages bs/hr/sr/en via ?lang= param. No JSON/REST API; pure CMS with PDF attachments.

daxy.com.recommended_method: Requires a paid DAXY subscription/prepaid access card; queries run through cgi-bin form endpoints (page.py, glob/daxyglobal_www1.html) after login. Not reproducible without credentials.
daxy.com.next_action: Acquire a subscription account/prepaid card if this source is needed; then map the search form endpoints under a logged-in session
daxy.com.notes: Serves Bulgaria (A6 vendors/competitors + company disclosures). Homepage loads but is a cp1251 frameset; real data is paywalled behind prepaid subscription cards. Highly relevant but not openly collectable.

app.dealroom.co.resource_type: dashboard (login-gated SaaS SPA) / JSON API for subscribers
app.dealroom.co.recommended_method: Use a Dealroom subscription with export or the official Dealroom API (key-based) to pull Bulgaria company records; the /dashboard SPA cannot be scraped without an authenticated session.

api.endpoint: Dealroom internal REST/GraphQL backend behind app.dealroom.co (not public); enterprise Dealroom API is separate and key-based
api.auth_needed: Yes - Dealroom account login; API access requires paid API key

app.dealroom.co.error_reason: HTTP 403 (Cloudflare) to unauthenticated clients; login required
app.dealroom.co.next_action: Provision a Dealroom account or API key; confirm Bulgaria filter export path under login
app.dealroom.co.notes: Serves Bulgaria (A6). Login-gated commercial platform; not collectable without a subscription/API key.

pitchbook.com.resource_type: HTML profile pages / commercial platform (login + paywall)
pitchbook.com.recommended_method: Requires a PitchBook subscription (platform export or contracted data feed/API); public profile pages are SEO teasers behind Cloudflare and yield little structured data.
pitchbook.com.next_action: Use a PitchBook subscription/data feed if this source is required; otherwise deprioritise for automated collection
pitchbook.com.notes: Referenced for Bulgaria (A6 vendors/competitors). Global commercial database, not Bulgaria-specific; paywalled.

pdf.dkom.hr.resource_type: PDF repository + registry search (HTML entry points)
pdf.dkom.hr.recommended_method: Crawl HTML listings at www.dkom.hr/odluke/10 (Javna objava odluka) and the Upisnik search (www.dkom.hr/upisnik/9, filter by year/type), then follow the pdf.dkom.hr/dokumentit/<timestamp>.pdf links. Individual PDFs are directly downloadable (tested: 200, application/pdf, 549KB).
pdf.dkom.hr.error_reason: The bare directory https://pdf.dkom.hr/dokumentit/ returns 403 (no directory listing), but individual PDFs and the root pdf.dkom.hr are 200
pdf.dkom.hr.next_action: Set collector to walk www.dkom.hr/odluke and /upisnik pages and harvest linked pdf.dkom.hr PDF URLs; do not hit the 403 directory index
pdf.dkom.hr.notes: Serves Croatia (A2 tenders/procurement). Sample URL https://pdf.dkom.hr/dokumentit/ (directory index) returns 403 - use the www.dkom.hr listing pages as the crawl entry point instead. Individual decision PDFs fully accessible.

karijera.pbz.hr.recommended_method: karijera.pbz.hr is NXDOMAIN (decommissioned). PBZ job openings have migrated to the Intesa Sanpaolo group careers portal (PBZ is part of Intesa Sanpaolo): https://jobs.intesasanpaolo.com/go/Jobs-Privredna-Banka-Zagreb_EN/9382601/ (verified 200) - an Avature-style board supporting keyword/location filtering, ideal for A1 hiring/early-intent signals. Fallback: the stable www.pbz.hr careers landing page (resolves via Akamai). The corp.pbz.hr job-postings page is referenced by search but did not resolve from this sandbox.
karijera.pbz.hr.error_reason: DNS NXDOMAIN for karijera.pbz.hr (and corp.pbz.hr) from public resolvers; www.pbz.hr resolves normally
karijera.pbz.hr.next_action: Manually confirm whether karijera.pbz.hr still resolves (may be geo/split-horizon DNS or decommissioned); if not, use www.pbz.hr careers page for A1 hiring/early-intent signals
karijera.pbz.hr.notes: Serves Croatia (A1). The scoped subdomain karijera.pbz.hr does not resolve in this environment (NXDOMAIN) though Google has it indexed - likely DNS/geo restriction or recent decommission. Main PBZ site is fully reachable.

arhivanalitika.hr.recommended_method: Crawl the month-by-month archive and section pages for articles; optionally monitor the weekly newsletter/'Pregledi' pages for new banking/finance commentary. Some premium content sits behind 'Lab Club' membership.
arhivanalitika.hr.next_action: Configure HTML crawl of category + monthly archive pages; check for a WordPress /feed/ RSS endpoint for incremental collection
arhivanalitika.hr.notes: Serves Croatia (A6 market/competitor commentary). Openly readable analysis site; premium 'Lab Club' items may be gated. No explicit downloads/RSS surfaced but standard archive structure.

cerp.hr.recommended_method: Download the majority/minority portfolio .xlsx files from the /portfelj-cerp-a/dionice-i-poslovni-udjeli/114 page (links are rendered dynamically, dated path e.g. 'Portfelj 2026/0907/...'); crawl /natjecaji/11 for tenders and /vijesti/8 for news. Resolve the exact dated file URL from the rendered page (JS) before fetching.
cerp.hr.next_action: Render the portfolio page (headless) to capture the current dated .xlsx URLs, then fetch and parse; set up tender-page crawl
cerp.hr.notes: Serves Croatia (A1 corporate/state-ownership disclosures). Portfolio Excel files exist but their URLs are dynamically dated and injected via JS - needs a render step to grab the exact link.

revizija.hr.resource_type: PDF reports (HTML listing with year filter)
revizija.hr.recommended_method: Crawl the /izvjesca listing (paginated, year filter 2007-2026), enumerate report entries and download the linked PDFs; filter titles for target entities (HBOR, HPB, banks) for A1 compliance/financial audit signals.
revizija.hr.next_action: Set up paginated HTML crawl of /izvjesca with year filters and harvest PDF links
revizija.hr.notes: Serves Croatia (A1). Fully open audit-report portal with downloadable PDFs and a year filter; strong source for state-bank compliance/financial audits.

globalpayments.hr.recommended_method: Content is a corporate marketing site with limited structured data; Cloudflare returns 403 to plain curl/WebFetch, so use a real browser/headless session to read 'O nama' and news pages. Low A2 data value - track mainly for vendor/competitor context and press.
globalpayments.hr.next_action: Validate via headless browser; decide whether the marketing content justifies collection or whether company data is better taken from registries (poslovna.hr, court register)
globalpayments.hr.notes: Serves Croatia (A2 tenders / A6 vendor). Real corporate site but Cloudflare-blocked to bots and thin on structured data; primarily a payments vendor profile. Relevant as competitor/vendor context.

digitalnakomora.hr.recommended_method: Reverse-engineer the SPA's XHR/fetch calls via a headless browser (open /pretraga/poslovni-subjekti/napredna, run a search, capture the JSON API endpoint + params). Informational-level data is available without login; full financials/blockade status need an HGK account. Alternatively use the classic HGK registers at web.hgk.hr/registri-i-imenici.

api.endpoint: SPA backed by an HGK JSON API (endpoints not exposed in static HTML; also powers the 'Digitalna Komora' mobile app, implying a documented REST backend)
api.params: search by naziv/OIB/responsible person/NKD
api.headers: session/token likely required for full data
api.auth_needed: Partial - unregistered users get informational-level access; full company data/financials require login (username+password)

digitalnakomora.hr.error_reason: JS-only SPA; API endpoints not visible in static HTML
digitalnakomora.hr.next_action: Use browser network capture to identify the search JSON endpoint and auth requirements; test an informational-level query without login
digitalnakomora.hr.notes: Serves Croatia (A1 corporate disclosures). Live SPA company registry from HGK; core search works at informational level without login but full data is gated. Needs XHR capture to automate. Fallback: web.hgk.hr/registri-i-imenici.

procreditbank.ba.recommended_method: Scrape sitemap.xml to enumerate URLs, then crawl https://www.procreditbank.ba/blog and /blog/arhiva for client announcements (A3) and https://www.procreditbank.ba/karijera/pozicije for jobs. Content is in server-rendered HTML (no JS needed). For formal corporate/financial disclosures (A1), use the FBiH Banking Agency (fba.ba) and FBiH Securities Commission (komvp.gov.ba) issuer pages, not this marketing site.
procreditbank.ba.next_action: Confirm /blog/arhiva paginates and carries client announcements; set up HTML crawl of blog archive + career positions; add FBA/KOMVP for financial statements.
procreditbank.ba.notes: Bosnia. Site was migrated to a new Next.js/Vercel build; the old /en/announcement-for-clients-* WordPress pages are dead. No dedicated 'obavjestenja' page anymore — announcements are under /blog. All 3 sample URLs (/, /en, /karijera) return 200.

faktor.ba.recommended_method: HTML scrape of https://faktor.ba/ekonomija (Najnovije/Najcitanije listings) and follow article links. No RSS available — /rss, /feed, /rss.xml, /ekonomija/feed, /sitemap.xml all return the Next.js SPA HTML shell (soft-200), not a real feed. Parse listing HTML for headlines/links/dates.
faktor.ba.next_action: Build HTML scraper for /ekonomija listing + article pages; optionally the sub-route /ekonomija/ekonomija (200) as a narrower economy feed.
faktor.ba.notes: Bosnia. General news portal; Ekonomija is the relevant vertical (A1/A3/A6). No RSS/JSON feed despite common paths returning 200 (they are catch-all SPA responses). All 3 sample URLs live.

careerjet.ba.resource_type: HTML page (paginated search results) + JSON/XML public API
careerjet.ba.recommended_method: Preferred: Careerjet Public Search API at public.api.careerjet.net/search with locale_code=bs_BA plus a free affid, returning structured JSON (title, company, locations, url, date, salary). Fallback: scrape the HTML search results and paginate via ?p=N (verified ?p=2 returns 200). Filter by region via /posao/<Region> paths (Kanton-Sarajevo, Republika-Srpska, Bosna-i-Hercegovina).

api.params: locale_code (e.g. bs_BA for BiH), keywords, location, sort, page, pagesize, affid (affiliate id), contracttype, user_ip, user_agent
api.headers: none special; user_ip and user_agent must be passed as params identifying the end user
api.auth_needed: Free affiliate id (affid) required via careerjet.com/partners/publishers; no login/OAuth

careerjet.ba.error_reason: public.api.careerjet.net did not resolve from this sandbox (DNS/network block) so the API call could not be executed here; the API is documented and live per Careerjet partner docs.
careerjet.ba.next_action: Register a free Careerjet affiliate id and test public.api.careerjet.net/search?locale_code=bs_BA from an unrestricted network; otherwise deploy the HTML+pagination scraper.
careerjet.ba.notes: Bosnia. Job aggregator (A2/A3/A5). Region paths work as facets. API is the cleaner path but needs a free affiliate key and was not reachable from this sandbox; HTML scraping fully works today.

tender-monitor.com.recommended_method: The actual tender data sits behind the paid login at /tm/prijava.php and cannot be reproduced without a subscription. For automated procurement collection (A2), go to the underlying official source instead: BiH public procurement portal e-Nabavke (ejn.gov.bih.gov.ba / javnenabavke.gov.ba). Treat tender-monitor.com itself as a competitor-mapping (A6) reference to inspect manually.
tender-monitor.com.error_reason: Data behind subscription login (prijava.php); no public API/exports. Not a paywall bypass candidate.
tender-monitor.com.next_action: Manually assess subscription value vs. scraping the official BiH e-Nabavke portal directly; do not attempt to bypass the login.
tender-monitor.com.notes: Bosnia (regional). Paid B2B procurement-monitoring vendor. Public site is only marketing; the monitoring feed requires an account. Sample login URL /tm/prijava.php is reachable (200) but gated.

kekspay.hr.recommended_method: Scrape the homepage and business pages (e.g. /poslovni-korisnici/keks-pay-za-webshop/) for product/merchant/market signals and headline user counts. There is no press/news/investor/API section on this domain — for corporate disclosures, tenders and payment-market statistics (A1/A2/A4), use Erste&Steiermarkische Bank Croatia's corporate/press site and the Croatian National Bank (HNB) payments statistics.
kekspay.hr.next_action: Scrape homepage/business pages for periodic marketing-stat changes; add Erste Croatia press + HNB payment stats for real market data.
kekspay.hr.notes: Croatia (also referenced by Bosnia). Product marketing site only; limited quantitative data (user/merchant counts). No API, downloads, or press section on-domain.

digitalk.bg.recommended_method: Site blocks automated agents (HTTP 403 to curl and WebFetch, including with a real browser User-Agent) — anti-bot/JS challenge. Collect via a full headless browser with a persistent real browser session (cookies + JS execution), throttled; some Economedia content is also paywalled. Check for a public RSS feed once a browser session is established (footer/nav) as feeds like on sister sites capital.bg/dnevnik.bg may exist.
digitalk.bg.error_reason: HTTP 403 Forbidden (anti-bot protection) on homepage and all sample/RSS URLs, via curl (default and browser UA) and WebFetch
digitalk.bg.next_action: Validate manually in a real browser; capture session cookies and test whether an RSS/JSON feed or section pages render for a logged/anti-bot-passed session; assess paywall on full articles.
digitalk.bg.notes: Bulgaria. Live and relevant IT/banking-tech trade press (Economedia/Capital group). No sample URL is dead per se — all return 403 due to anti-bot, not missing content, so they are functionally blocked to automation rather than truly dead.

pbzcard.hr.recommended_method: Scrape the media-centar listing page (HTTP 200, static server-rendered HTML) with plain HTTP GET; parse dated items and follow individual article links. Filter via on-page categories: Sve novosti / Vijesti / Priopcenja. Poll periodically for new-dated items.
pbzcard.hr.next_action: Set up scraper on media-centar-i-novosti listing; follow article URLs for full text. No RSS feed observed — HTML parsing is the method.
pbzcard.hr.notes: Croatia. Homepage redirects to /naslovnica/; the /priopcenja/ sample URL redirects (302) to the unified /media-centar-i-novosti/ listing (use that as the canonical entry). No RSS feed found. Other sample pages (prihvacanje-kartica, menadzment, sigurnost) are standard static corporate pages.

ibank.bg.recommended_method: Scrape the news list at https://ibank.bg/bg/novini (BG) or https://ibank.bg/en/news (EN) on a schedule; no RSS available (/bg/novini/feed and /bg/feed both 404). For A6 PSD2/open-banking, monitor https://ibank.bg/bg/za-nas/psd-2-open-banking; live API access is via BORICA Iris hub, not a self-hosted developer portal.
ibank.bg.next_action: Set up HTML scraper for /bg/novini (or /en/news) news list; confirm PSD2 sandbox is BORICA Iris.
ibank.bg.notes: Bulgaria. Both sample URLs live. No RSS; static HTML news page. PSD2 page is informational only.

apis.bg.recommended_method: Product/marketing pages (sanctions-bg, apis-register) are freely scrapable for competitor/vendor monitoring. The actual registry/sanctions DATA is a licensed subscription product (page references 'абонамент'/subscription) — no free API or open download; obtaining data requires a commercial contract and login, so mark for manual/commercial validation.
apis.bg.next_action: Scrape product pages for A6 competitor tracking; for data, evaluate commercial subscription separately (manual).
apis.bg.notes: Bulgaria. Both sample URLs live. Commercial legal-info vendor; datasets paywalled/subscription. Marketing pages themselves are accessible.

akd.hr.recommended_method: Scrape solution pages under /hr/rjesenja (fintech: /hr/rjesenja/financijsko-tehnoloska-rjesenja-fintech, /emv-usluge) and news at /hr/o-nama/novosti. Note the old /hr/usluge path now 301-redirects to /hr/rjesenja (site restructured usluge->rjesenja).
akd.hr.next_action: Update tracker: replace /hr/usluge with /hr/rjesenja; scrape fintech solution + novosti pages.
akd.hr.notes: Croatia. A4 vendor. Sample /hr/usluge silently redirects to /hr/rjesenja (not truly dead, but stale). Static HTML.

diners.hr.recommended_method: Poll the WordPress RSS at https://diners.hr/feed/ for updates; scrape /o-nama/ and card pages (/privatni/kartice/, /poslovni/kartice/, /pogodnosti/) for A1/A5. No dedicated press/novosti section exists.
diners.hr.next_action: Add /feed/ RSS poller plus product-page scraper.
diners.hr.notes: Croatia. Both sample URLs live. Marketing/product site (WordPress); limited disclosure content but RSS feed available.

financije.hr.recommended_method: Poll https://financije.hr/feed/ (200, application/rss+xml) for A1/A3 news; fall back to article-page scraping for full text.
financije.hr.notes: Croatia. Both sample URLs live. Financial media portal; RSS available.

jutarnji.hr.recommended_method: Poll section RSS https://www.jutarnji.hr/novac/feed (200, rss+xml) for A1/A3 business/finance items; site-wide feed at /feed also works. Note some articles are behind a 'premium'/pretplata paywall for full text.
jutarnji.hr.next_action: Replace dead /biznis with /novac (+ /novac/feed RSS) in tracker.
jutarnji.hr.notes: Croatia. Sample /biznis is DEAD (404); business content moved to /novac. Some full articles paywalled (premium/pretplata).

wspay.info.recommended_method: Scrape blog list at https://www.wspay.info/cl/131/blog and product pages; no RSS (/feed 404). Server-rendered HTML, no JS/login needed.
wspay.info.notes: Croatia. Both sample URLs live. Vendor/gateway brand (Monri). No RSS; static HTML.

zimo.dnevnik.hr.recommended_method: Retire the ZIMO subdomain source (content merged/removed). For Croatian fintech/crypto coverage, scrape https://dnevnik.hr/vijesti/gospodarstvo; dnevnik.hr has no /tehnologija section (404).
