Use https://www.bug.hr/rss for all posts, https://www.bug.hr/rss/biznis for business/IT, and https://www.bug.hr/rss/fintech for fintech/payments/crypto/regulation. Feeds are RSS 2.0 with <title>, <link>, <category>, <description>, <pubDate>. Pattern is https://www.bug.hr/rss/<section-or-tag>. For deeper article text, follow each item <link> and scrape the static HTML. ttl=30 min, so poll ~30-60 min.
bug.hr.next_action: Wire up RSS polling for /rss, /rss/biznis, /rss/fintech; add tag-based feeds (/rss/<tag>) for targeted topics like mobilno-placanje/aircash if those tag-feed variants resolve. No manual validation needed.
bug.hr.notes: Croatian IT/business/consumer tech media portal (serves Croatia; also cited for Bosnia coverage). Fully static, publicly accessible, no login/paywall/CAPTCHA. Workstreams A1/A3/A6 well served (corporate news, fintech regulation, vendors/competitors); A2 tenders weak. All sample URLs are live section/tag index pages (HTML). No dead URLs.

bbr.bg.resource_type: PDF report (via HTML landing/year pages); plus HTML register table and news pages
bbr.bg.recommended_method: Crawl the annual-reports landing page (EN: /en/public-information-bbr/annual-reports/, BG: /bg/publichna-informaciya/otcheti/), follow year-specific pages (…/annual-reports-YYYY/) and harvest direct PDF links under /media/documents/ (e.g. BDB_Annual_Report_Standalone_YYYY_ENG.pdf, BDB_Group_AFS_YYYY_ENG.pdf). For the register of signed financing contracts, scrape the paginated HTML table (~199 pages) or capture its backing XHR/JSON via browser network inspection. Scrape /news-bbr/ for press releases. All served over plain HTTPS, no login needed for public pages.
bbr.bg.next_action: Automate PDF harvesting from year pages and add a scraper for the financing-contracts register (paginated table or its XHR). Optionally inspect register XHR endpoint via browser for a cleaner JSON feed.
bbr.bg.notes: Bulgaria — Bulgarian Development Bank (Българска банка за развитие). All 6 tested sample URLs returned 200; none dead. Annual reports are direct downloadable PDFs under /media/documents/. Register of signed financing contracts is a paginated HTML table (no CSV/Excel export button; data likely XHR-backed). The developer.bbr.bg 'API portal' is a PSD2/open-banking test environment for payment-service providers (requires onboarding) and is NOT a market-data API — not needed for intelligence collection. Buyer-profile/procurement (A2) referenced but check the public-information section for the current procurement page.

rctrend.bg.recommended_method: Periodic HTML scrape of the news/press section for released poll/survey results; no downloadable datasets are published. Bilingual (EN/BG) site.
rctrend.bg.next_action: Monitor news/press pages for published survey summaries; treat as low-value A4 source (no raw data)
rctrend.bg.notes: Bulgaria. Commercial market-research vendor; sells bespoke studies, does not publish downloadable data. Marginal A4 relevance.

vadim-sod.com.recommended_method: Static HTML scrape of company/services pages if vendor profiling needed; no data feeds or downloads.
vadim-sod.com.next_action: Low priority; use only as vendor/company reference (A6-style) — little A4 statistical value
vadim-sod.com.notes: Bulgaria. Cash-in-transit / collections (инкасо) vendor. Static WordPress-style corporate site, no public datasets.

science.uard.bg.recommended_method: Harvest article metadata via OAI-PMH (verb=ListRecords&metadataPrefix=oai_dc); follow issue/galley pages for PDF full-text. Standard OJS, reproducible outside browser.

api.params: verb=Identify | verb=ListRecords&metadataPrefix=oai_dc | verb=ListSets

science.uard.bg.next_action: Use OAI-PMH harvester for academic articles touching Bulgarian banking/finance/market topics
science.uard.bg.notes: Bulgaria. Academic journal (ISSN 2367-4598). OAI-PMH working; also has RSS feeds. Low priority A4 (research articles, not market stats).

infobusiness.bcci.bg.recommended_method: HTML scrape of event/forum listing pages for early-intent signals (upcoming financial forums, conference agendas). Static server-rendered pages.
infobusiness.bcci.bg.next_action: Scrape events index for financial-sector forums; check parent bcci.bg for broader event calendar
infobusiness.bcci.bg.notes: Bulgaria. A5 events/early-intent. Part of BCCI (bcci.bg). Static HTML.

businessnovinite.bg.recommended_method: Scrape category/article pages for business & finance news; try WordPress feed variants (feed redirected 302 — resolve final target) or REST /wp-json/wp/v2/posts as a candidate ingestion endpoint.
businessnovinite.bg.next_action: Test https://businessnovinite.bg/wp-json/wp/v2/posts and follow /feed/ redirect target; otherwise HTML scrape
businessnovinite.bg.notes: Bulgaria. A5 business news. Cloudflare-fronted but not blocking. WordPress; likely REST/RSS available on resolution.

kaderabotim.bg.recommended_method: Scrape employer profile/review pages on wherewework.bg (301/302 chain from kaderabotim.bg). Use the new domain www.wherewework.bg/bg/... paths.
kaderabotim.bg.next_action: Update tracker to wherewework.bg; scrape employer review pages (e.g. myPOS) for workforce/early-intent signals
kaderabotim.bg.notes: Bulgaria. A5 employer-review (glassdoor-like). Old domain kaderabotim.bg permanently redirects to wherewework.bg.

fexopay.com.recommended_method: Static HTML scrape of about/services/news pages for competitor/vendor profiling; no data feeds.
fexopay.com.next_action: Use as competitor/vendor reference (A5/A6); monitor for product/news pages
fexopay.com.notes: Bulgaria. Payment-services competitor. Static corporate site.

krib.bg.recommended_method: Cloudflare bot-protection blocks server-side requests (403 on member-news and /feed/). Requires a real browser session / headless browser with JS challenge solving, or an allow-listed IP/User-Agent.
krib.bg.error_reason: HTTP 403 (Cloudflare challenge) on both /member-news/ and /feed/ with multiple User-Agents
krib.bg.next_action: Collect via headless browser (Chrome MCP) to pass Cloudflare JS challenge; then scrape member-news list. Consider RSS after challenge.
krib.bg.notes: Bulgaria. A5 member/early-intent. Cloudflare-blocked to non-browser clients — needs browser-based collection.

newpay.bg.recommended_method: Static HTML scrape of homepage/product/news pages for competitor/product-intent signals; no data feeds.
newpay.bg.next_action: Use as fintech competitor reference (A5/A6); monitor product & news pages

olx.bg.recommended_method: Jobs section returns 200 but OLX is a JS-rendered SPA with anti-bot protection; use headless browser or investigate the OLX internal listing API (api/v1/offers style used by OLX Group). Filter jobs by keyword (e.g. bank/payments employers) to capture hiring/early-intent.
olx.bg.next_action: Inspect OLX internal offers API via browser network tab (Chrome MCP) or use headless rendering; identify listing JSON endpoint and params
olx.bg.notes: Bulgaria. A5 jobs/early-intent. Large classifieds SPA; likely undocumented internal JSON API + bot mitigation. Needs browser-based discovery to reproduce cleanly.

javnarasprava.ba.recommended_method: Server-rendered HTML — scrape law detail pages at /fbih/Zakon/{id}, /bih/Zakon/{id}, /rs/Zakon/{id} for title, institution, posted date, deadline/status; download draft-law PDFs from the javnarasprava.blob.core.windows.net Azure blob 'Preuzmite tekst zakona' links. Crawl homepage/entity listings to enumerate active consultations. No login/JS needed.
javnarasprava.ba.next_action: Build crawler over entity law-listing pages; poll periodically for new consultations and their deadlines.
javnarasprava.ba.notes: Serves Bosnia (BiH state, FBiH, RS entity governments). All 4 sample URLs live; /fbih/ redirects (302) to homepage which is the entity landing. PDFs hosted on javnarasprava.blob.core.windows.net. High value for tracking e-money/payment-services/deposit-insurance legislation deadlines.

bhtelecom.ba.recommended_method: Scrape server-rendered HTML of /nabavke-i-pozivi/ and /obavjestenja/; follow 'Vidi arhivu' archive links to enumerate dated notices; fetch linked PDF tender documents. Dropdown filters (value/region/work-type) are light JS enhancement over server content — not required for scraping.
bhtelecom.ba.next_action: Locate exact archive URL via on-page 'Vidi arhivu' link and set up periodic scrape of active + archived calls.
bhtelecom.ba.notes: Serves Bosnia (BH Telecom d.d. Sarajevo). Bosnian only, no English on this section. Guessed archive path 404s but archive is reachable via on-page link, not a dead sample URL. All sample URLs live.

halcom.com.recommended_method: Scrape the Serbian/English regional site under /sr_en/ (relevant for Bosnia + Croatia) for solutions, references and any news; Slovenian /sl/ and Slovenian-English /sl_en/ locales also exist. Static HTML, no JS/login. Watch solutions + careers + cybersecurity pages for product/market signals.
halcom.com.next_action: Enumerate /sr_en/ solution + reference pages; check for a news/blog and LinkedIn for release/reference intelligence.
halcom.com.notes: Referenced by Bosnia and Croatia. Homepage redirects to Slovenian /sl/; use /sr_en/ (Serbian-English) as the regional English entry. All sample URLs (/sr_en/, /, corporate-banking) live. No downloads/API; pure marketing/vendor site.

ictbusiness.info.recommended_method: Site is Nuxt.js but SSR — article HTML contains full content (WebFetch rendered the TOP-100 revenue table). Scrape article/category pages directly via HTTP (/vijesti/{slug}, /poslovanje). A JSON API under /api/ exists but requires undocumented params; reverse-engineer via browser network capture only if HTML scraping proves insufficient. RSS (/rss,/feed) and /sitemap.xml return 500 — not usable.

api.params: requires article/section identifier params (not documented; catch-all returns 500 'Cannot read properties of null (reading contents)' without correct params)

ictbusiness.info.next_action: Set up HTML scraper on category pages; capture the /api/ endpoint params via browser devtools if a structured feed is desired.
ictbusiness.info.notes: Serves Croatia (Croatian ICT trade press); referenced by Bosnia + Croatia. Nuxt.js SPA with SSR — content is in the HTML so no JS execution needed for scraping. RSS/feed/sitemap endpoints are broken (500).

caa.gov.al.recommended_method: Hybrid: (a) Poll https://caa.gov.al/wp-json/wp/v2/posts?per_page=100&page=N (and filter by news/merger-notifications category) for A1/A3/A5 news, press releases and merger notifications - JSON, no auth, X-WP-Total=1136. (b) For decisions/mergers/bulletins/laws (custom post types, NOT in REST), crawl the XML sitemaps (decisions-sitemap.xml + decisions-sitemap2.xml, publications-sitemap.xml, cases-sitemap.xml, laws-sitemap.xml) to enumerate all item URLs, then fetch each HTML page and extract the linked PDF under /wp-content/uploads/. Bulletins list at /en/publications-category/decisions-bulletins/ (paginated). Both EN (/en/...) and Albanian versions exist via Polylang.

api.endpoint: https://caa.gov.al/wp-json/wp/v2/posts (also /wp-json/ root discovery; custom types decisions/publications/cases/laws are NOT REST-enabled -> use sitemaps instead: https://caa.gov.al/decisions-sitemap.xml, decisions-sitemap2.xml, publications-sitemap.xml, cases-sitemap.xml, laws-sitemap.xml)
api.params: per_page (max 100), page, categories, search, after, before, _fields, orderby; for merger notifications filter posts by the 'merger-notifications' news category (slug under /category/news/merger-notifications/)
api.headers: None required; standard User-Agent. X-WP-Total / X-WP-TotalPages headers give counts for pagination.

download.type: PDF (quarterly Official Decision Bulletin; individual decisions also attached as PDFs under /wp-content/uploads/)

caa.gov.al.next_action: Build two collectors: WP REST poller for posts/news/merger-notifications, and a sitemap-driven crawler for decisions/bulletins/cases/laws PDFs. Determine the exact merger-notifications category ID via /wp-json/wp/v2/categories?slug=merger-notifications for precise filtering.
caa.gov.al.notes: Country: Albania. Domain = Albanian Competition Authority (Autoriteti i Konkurrencës), workstreams A1/A2/A3/A5. Fully accessible, no auth/paywall/CAPTCHA/JS-block. WordPress (Elementor, Yoast, Polylang). All 15 sample URLs reachable; the three trailing-slash-less ones (/en/decisions, /en/cases, /decisions) just 301 to the slash version. Note: 'caa' here is Competition Authority, not civil aviation.

freelance.bg.recommended_method: Poll the RSS feed https://freelance.bg/freelance-projects-en.xml via HTTP GET; fall back to scraping category/job HTML pages for company/context detail.

api.params: none (static feed); also localized feed for BG version

freelance.bg.next_action: Ingest RSS feed; low relevance to A1 corporate disclosures (this is a freelance/project job board, early-intent signal at best).
freelance.bg.notes: Bulgaria. Freelance/project job board (55k+ freelancers). Marginal for A1 — useful only as A5-style early-intent hiring signal. RSS feed works.

oxygen.x3news.com.recommended_method: Not collectible automatically: this is a reporting tool where companies self-submit ESG declarations, not a public disclosure register. Verify manually whether any generated declarations are ever published publicly (likely not). Fetching requires -k/insecure due to broken TLS chain.
oxygen.x3news.com.error_reason: TLS: unable to verify the first certificate (incomplete/mis-configured cert chain, ssl_verify_result=0); WebFetch failed on cert; content only reachable with curl -k
oxygen.x3news.com.next_action: Manual review: confirm no public report repository exists; the platform gates disclosures behind login, so treat as not a viable public source for A1.
oxygen.x3news.com.notes: Bulgaria. ESG/non-financial reporting SaaS (x3news/FMS). Broken TLS chain forces insecure fetch. Report data is login-gated, not a public disclosure feed.

tuk-tam.bg.recommended_method: HTTP GET + HTML parse of /companies/<slug> profile pages and the jobs listings; jobs themselves often link out to the employer's careers site.
tuk-tam.bg.next_action: Scrape company profiles + jobs board for early-intent hiring signals; low A1 value (profiles are static, not disclosures).
tuk-tam.bg.notes: Bulgaria. Diaspora community jobs & company profiles. Static HTML, no API/RSS found. Job postings redirect to employers' own careers portals.

econ.bg.recommended_method: HTTP GET with a real browser User-Agent (server 403s default/bot UAs) and parse category/article HTML. The /_l.Rss.html path is NOT a real RSS feed (returns an HTML 'Иновации' category page).
econ.bg.error_reason: HTTP 403 to WebFetch/default UA (bot filtering); succeeds with browser UA via curl
econ.bg.next_action: Collect via browser-UA HTTP GET + HTML scrape of relevant category pages; watch for a genuine feed, otherwise scrape.
econ.bg.notes: Bulgaria. Business news portal (A6 press-release/competitor coverage). Blocks non-browser UAs (403). No genuine RSS confirmed.

kaldata.com.recommended_method: Poll the per-tag WordPress RSS feed https://www.kaldata.com/tag/epay-bg/feed (and other payment/vendor tag feeds) via HTTP GET; parse RSS items.

api.params: tag slug in path (e.g. epay-bg); WordPress feed

kaldata.com.next_action: Ingest tag RSS feeds for payment-vendor coverage; extend to other relevant tags.
kaldata.com.notes: Bulgaria. Tech press-release feed. WordPress site; generic WebFetch UA gets 403 but tag RSS feed works. Feed tested OK.

ecc.bg.recommended_method: HTTP GET + HTML scrape of the Documents and News sections; harvest linked PDF reports/brochures. Use the EN toggle for English content.
ecc.bg.next_action: Scrape documents + news pages; identify exact PDF report URLs on next pass.
ecc.bg.notes: Bulgaria. ECC-Net consumer centre. Relevant to consumer/payments dispute topics (marginal A1/A3). Static HTML with PDF resources; no API.

comarch.com.recommended_method: HTTP GET + HTML parse of the case-studies index (first ~25 cards are server-rendered); follow card links to individual case-study pages. A 'Show more' button loads additional items via JS/XHR — capture that endpoint if full coverage is needed.
comarch.com.next_action: Scrape SSR cards + detail pages; on next pass capture the Show-more XHR endpoint for the full list.
comarch.com.notes: Bulgaria-tagged (A6 vendor/competitor). Global vendor site, English. Core content SSR; pagination is JS 'Show more'.

topzop.bg.resource_type: HTML page (consultancy marketing) / redirect to official procurement portal
topzop.bg.recommended_method: Do NOT rely on topzop.bg for tenders — it hosts no tender database. Collect Bulgarian tenders from the official CAIS EOP portal (app.eop.bg) instead; validate that portal separately.
topzop.bg.next_action: Reassign this A2/A6 need to the official CAIS EOP portal (app.eop.bg); mark topzop.bg as not a data source.
topzop.bg.notes: Bulgaria. Sample labelled it a 'tender aggregator' but it is actually a consultancy; no tender listings. Real source = CAIS EOP (app.eop.bg).

blog.fibank.bg.recommended_method: HTTP GET + HTML scrape of the paginated category grids (e.g. Банкови карти for card/ATM news). No usable RSS: /feed/ returns HTTP 400.
blog.fibank.bg.next_action: Scrape category pages for A2 signals (new ATMs, contactless launches); monitor for dated announcements.
blog.fibank.bg.notes: Bulgaria. Fibank blog. Custom CMS, no working RSS feed. HTML scraping required.

conference.financeacademy.bg.recommended_method: One-off HTTP GET + HTML parse of the event page (program/speakers). Low ongoing value: page reflects a past (2023) conference; monitor for a new edition rather than automated recurring scrape.
conference.financeacademy.bg.next_action: Periodically re-check for a new conference edition; treat as A2 event-intent signal only.
conference.financeacademy.bg.notes: Bulgaria. Static event microsite, content appears stale (Sept 2023). No feed/API/downloads.

softwaregroup.com.recommended_method: Scrape the /about-us/news HTML listing with pagination (numbered pages 1-10+), plus /solutions/* product pages. Static server-rendered HTML (IIS), no JS needed. No RSS feed exists (feed/, rss, news/feed all 404).
softwaregroup.com.next_action: Set up periodic HTML scrape of /about-us/news with pagination; monitor for partnership/client/tender announcements (A6/A2/A3).
softwaregroup.com.notes: Static corporate site, fully reachable. Good for A6 vendor tracking. No RSS/API; scrape HTML. Serves Albania & Bulgaria (vendor HQ Sofia).

ak-invest.com.recommended_method: Scrape static HTML pages (Cloudflare-fronted, PHP). Root ak-invest.com 301-redirects to www.ak-invest.com; use www. Target the Careers page (under company info) for A5/early-intent and About/governance for A1. No API detected.
ak-invest.com.next_action: Identify exact Careers and news/notices URLs under www.ak-invest.com and scrape periodically; static HTML, no JS.
ak-invest.com.notes: Albania. Corporate site of AK-Invest payment institution. Use canonical www host. HTML scrape only; no downloadable datasets or API.

alreg.com.al.recommended_method: Scrape /reports/ and /statistics/ HTML for the 'Click here' download links (data as of 2020 only). WordPress REST API (wp-json/wp/v2) is available if content is later published as posts/pages. Site is low-update; check periodically for newer annual reports.

api.params: standard WP REST (posts, pages)

alreg.com.al.next_action: Locate the actual 2020 report/statistics file targets (relative/JS 'Click here' links) and check whether ALREG has published 2021+ data; consider manual review as data is sparse.
alreg.com.al.notes: Albania - central securities depository. Reachable but content thin/outdated (2020 latest visible). Only dead-ish content is the sparse data, not broken URLs; all sample URLs load 200.

abcnews.al.recommended_method: Poll the WordPress REST API: /wp-json/wp/v2/posts?categories=15 for economy news, or /wp-json/wp/v2/posts?after=<timestamp> for incremental. Category feed https://abcnews.al/kategoria/ekonomi/feed/ (RSS, 200) also works. Both public, no auth.

api.params: categories=15 (Ekonomi), per_page, page, after=ISO8601, search

abcnews.al.next_action: Automate incremental collection via wp-json posts?categories=15&after=<lastrun>; dedupe by post id.
abcnews.al.notes: Albania. WordPress site with fully working public REST API + RSS. Best-in-class access. Economy category id=15.

paybalkan.promoney-events.com.recommended_method: Scrape the single-page HTML (nginx, static) to extract speaker names/titles/orgs, sponsors, and agenda topics. No brochure PDF or API found; content is event-cycle based (currently advertising Balkan Payment Forum, next edition dated May 2027).
paybalkan.promoney-events.com.next_action: Periodically scrape speakers/sponsors/agenda sections; snapshot per event edition to capture named executives (A1) and vendor/sponsor signals (A6).
paybalkan.promoney-events.com.notes: Event microsite for Balkan Payment Forum (Tirana). Serves Albania/Bosnia/Croatia + SEE. Static HTML scrape; content refreshes per event cycle.

abrs.ba.resource_type: Excel (xlsx) quarterly tables + HTML register pages + WordPress JSON REST API
abrs.ba.recommended_method: For market statistics (A4): scrape https://abrs.ba/en/banks-3/ and the MCO quarterly page for the *KTabeleBanke.xlsx links (predictable /wp-content/uploads/YYYY/MM/YYYYMMDD*.xlsx pattern, full history back to Q1 2021) and download directly with curl. For registers (A1/A6): parse HTML pages under /en/category/institutions/ (banks in RS, banks in FBiH, MCOs, EMIs, leasing, FX offices). For news/deadlines/early-intent (A2/A3/A5): poll the open WordPress REST API GET /wp-json/wp/v2/posts (paginate, filter by category/date) — no login or browser session needed.

api.params: per_page, page, categories, search, after/before (date filters), _fields; standard WP REST query params
api.auth_needed: No (public read; returned live post e.g. id 16225 dated 2026-07-17)

abrs.ba.next_action: Wire up collector: (1) enumerate xlsx links from /en/banks-3/ + MCO equivalent, (2) crawl institution register HTML pages, (3) consume WP REST posts endpoint for news/notices. Map old tracker /lat/ URLs to current /en/ or /sr/ category paths.
abrs.ba.notes: Serves Bosnia (Republika Srpska entity regulator). Site is WordPress, fully server-rendered (no JS needed) with English + Serbian-Cyrillic (/sr/) versions. Two tracker sample URLs are dead (site was restructured): /lat/news and /lat/mko/c12 both 404 — the old /lat/ path scheme is gone, replaced by /en/ and /sr/ plus /category/ slugs. All /en/ sample URLs return 200. Quarterly bank Excel tables available every quarter from Q1 2021 through Q1 2026.

rba.hr.resource_type: HTML page with PDF/ZIP downloads (annual & interim financial statements, ESEF)
rba.hr.recommended_method: Scrape the financial-indicators.html and investors.html pages (both EN and HR, e.g. /hr/o-nama/investitori.html) for AEM DAM download links following the predictable pattern /content/dam/rbi/retail/eu/hr/documents/financial-statements/<year>-annual-report.pdf.coredownload.inline.pdf and interim-financial-statements-qN-YYYY.pdf; fetch PDFs directly via HTTP GET (no auth, no JS). Also poll /investitori/vijesti/objave (redirects to /hr/o-nama/investitori.html) for A1 press/announcements. POS/ATM/card-acceptance and istrazivanja (research) pages are plain HTML.
rba.hr.next_action: Build a link-extractor over financial-indicators.html + investors.html (EN/HR) to harvest per-year report PDFs/ZIPs; schedule periodic re-check of investor announcements page for new objave.
rba.hr.notes: Croatia. Single-domain batch, high priority (n=13). Static Adobe AEM site — no login/paywall/CAPTCHA, no JS needed, downloads reproducible outside a browser. Old tracker paths /investitori/vijesti/objave, /press/vijesti/2023, /press/vijesti/clanci still resolve via 200 redirects to current EN/HR equivalents (not dead). Related entity Raiffeisen Invest fund reports live on separate domain rbainvest.hr if fund-level data is later needed.

strategy.bg.resource_type: statistics/register HTML list portal (server-rendered) + Atom RSS feed
strategy.bg.recommended_method: Scrape the server-rendered list at https://www.strategy.bg/bg/public-consultations with GET query params: fieldOfAction=21 (Financial policy), plus optional actType, institution, administrative-level filters, and page=N pagination (?page=1..~500). Each row links to a detail page https://www.strategy.bg/bg/public-consultations/{id} (e.g. /12514) carrying title, dates, institution and attached document links. For low-latency change detection, poll the Atom feed https://www.strategy.bg/public-consultation.rss (Content-Type application/xml). No login/JS/cookies beyond a harmless session cookie are required; plain HTTP GET reproduces everything outside a browser.
strategy.bg.next_action: Build collector against /bg/public-consultations?fieldOfAction=21&page=N and the .rss feed; update tracker to replace the dead legacy *.aspx sample URLs with the new /bg/ paths.
strategy.bg.notes: Bulgaria. Site was rewritten from ASP.NET (*.aspx) to a Laravel app; all four legacy .aspx sample URLs now 302-redirect to https://www.strategy.bg/bg/login and are dead as data sources. Working replacements are the /bg/ paths. fieldOfAction=21 = Финансова политика (Financial policy), directly relevant to A2 (tenders/legislative programmes) and A3 (regulation/deadlines). Additional useful pages: aggregated reports at /bg/public-consultations/reports/simple, /reports/institutions, /reports/field-of-actions; MoF institution profile /bg/institution-profile/public-consultations/146 (200) and legislative programmes /bg/legislative-programs/20 (200) both work.

aircash.eu.recommended_method: HTTP GET on server-rendered pages: /press (EN newsroom) and /hr-HR/novosti (Croatian news/blog), paginate via ?p=N (e.g. /press?p=1). Also /hr-HR/regulatory-info (A3 regulation) and /about (A1). Content is present in raw HTML, so plain curl/HTTP fetch works without a browser. For job openings (A5), the /careers page renders the list via a Talentlyft JS widget (talentlyftWidget) rather than server HTML, so use the Talentlyft feed/widget or a headless browser for jobs specifically.
aircash.eu.next_action: Set up periodic HTTP scrape of /press and /hr-HR/novosti (with ?p= pagination) for A1/A3/A6 signals and /hr-HR/regulatory-info for A3; for A5 careers, resolve the Talentlyft company feed (aircash.talentlyft.com root is 404 — widget uses an internal Talentlyft embed/API endpoint that needs one browser inspection to capture) or render /careers with a headless browser.
aircash.eu.notes: Single corporate domain; Aircash is an EU-licensed EMI (Aircash AC d.o.o. Banja Luka in Bosnia/RS + Croatian entity) serving Bosnia and Croatia. All 14 sample URLs reachable; locale redirects (307 to /el-GR from US IP, /hr -> /hr-HR) are geo/locale normalisation, not errors. No RSS feed and sitemap.xml returns 404. Only the careers job list is JS-rendered (Talentlyft widget); press/news/regulatory/about are all in server HTML. No downloads/press-kit files found. No dead sample URLs.

comtrade.com.recommended_method: Scrape https://www.comtrade.com/jobs/ (location dropdown includes 'Bosnia and Herzegovina') and https://www.comtrade.com/news/ as static HTML on a schedule; individual job apply links route out to comtradeintegration.oneassessment.com ATS (A5 early-intent).
comtrade.com.next_action: Set up HTML scraper for jobs and news pages; filter jobs by Bosnia location
comtrade.com.notes: Serves Bosnia (Comtrade has Sarajevo/BiH presence). Jobs are static HTML list with location filter; applications handled by OneAssessment ATS. Both sample URLs return HTTP 200.

minfin.bg.resource_type: statistics portal + document archive (HTML pages linking XLS/XLSX/PDF downloads)
minfin.bg.recommended_method: Site is fully public to human browsers but sits behind a Cloudflare 'managed challenge' (anti-bot) that returns HTTP 403 to curl/WebFetch and does not auto-clear in an automated browser session. For automated collection, use a Cloudflare-challenge-capable stack: an undetected/real-browser session (e.g. Playwright/Selenium with stealth, FlareSolverr, or a valid cf_clearance cookie harvested from a genuine browser session) to fetch pages, then follow the XLS/XLSX/PDF links from /en/613 (Statistics), /en/383 (Consolidated Fiscal Programme), /en/documents (paged ?p=N), /en/4 (Budget) and /bg/1738 (Buyer Profile). As a machine-readable alternative for a subset of budget/fiscal datasets, evaluate the national open-data portal data.egov.bg (CSV/JSON/XML) which mirrors some MoF data.

download.type: XLS/XLSX (Consolidated Fiscal Programme national methodology); PDF (budget documents, bulletins)

minfin.bg.next_action: Provision a Cloudflare-aware fetcher (real-browser/stealth session or cf_clearance cookie) and re-validate the download links; in parallel check data.egov.bg for MoF machine-readable datasets. All sample URLs are valid targets (403 is anti-bot, not 404).
minfin.bg.notes: Serves Bulgaria. High value (n=15, critical/high priority): euro-area accession plan (/en/1578, /en/1579, /bg/1570), Recovery & Resilience Plan financial execution (/bg/52), central purchasing body CPB/ЦОП and Buyer Profile procurement (/bg/1738), draft laws & legislation (/bg/legislation7,8,9,13, /bg/legislation1), news (/bg/news). No sample URL is dead — every one returned Cloudflare 403 (blocked, not missing). English mirror at /en/, Bulgarian at /bg/. cbbh.ba.resource_type: statistics portal (Panorama Necto BI) + PDF/Excel reports + HTML press releases + procurement register
cbbh.ba.recommended_method: HTTP GET with a browser User-Agent. IMPORTANT: use GET, never HEAD (HEAD requests to /, /Content/* return spurious 302->500; identical GET returns 200). Crawl publication index pages /Content/Archive/{35 Quarterly Bulletin, 36 Annual Report, 575 Financial Stability Report, 903 Monthly Economic Review} which link to /Content/Read/{id} leaf pages; document lists on leaf pages are JS-rendered, so use a headless browser (or a rendering fetcher) to extract /data/dokumenti/*.pdf|*.xlsx links, then fetch those directly via GET (static, no auth). Press releases: list at /press/AllNews plus /press/ShowNews/{id}. Public procurement: /Content/Read/953. Payment-system reports/stats: /Content/Read/1242. Interactive statistics: Panorama Necto BI portal at /Content/Read/915 -> /Content/Read/1271 needs a headless browser to pull dashboard data; for automation prefer the equivalent Excel/PDF bulletins.

download.type: PDF (publications & manuals under /data/dokumenti/; Quarterly Bulletin also offers Excel/XLSX)

cbbh.ba.error_reason: HEAD requests return 302->500 site-wide (server quirk); /procurement returns 500 on GET too (dead legacy path, replaced by /Content/Read/953). All other sample URLs return 200 on GET.
cbbh.ba.next_action: Set up collector with GET-only + browser UA; use headless rendering to harvest /data/dokumenti download links from Content/Read leaf pages and to capture Panorama Necto dashboard data; schedule against the Advanced Release Calendar (/Content/Read/29) for A3 deadline tracking.
cbbh.ba.notes: Domain serves BOSNIA (Central Bank of BiH). Fully relevant, high value across all workstreams. Both www.cbbh.ba and cbbh.ba work (cbbh.ba/Content/Read/1242 -> 200). Only genuinely dead sample URL is https://www.cbbh.ba/procurement (legacy path; current procurement page = /Content/Read/953). The site's server returns 500 to HEAD probes, which can cause false-negative 'dead link' reports; always validate with GET. Statistics is a JS Panorama Necto BI portal (interactive dashboards) - underlying data also available as downloadable Excel/PDF bulletins, which are the practical automated-collection target.

ejn.gov.ba.recommended_method: Collect via the open.ejn.gov.ba OData API. Enumerate entity sets from the service root, then page each with $top/$skip and incremental $filter=LastUpdated gt <ts> for delta pulls. Filter to financial/banking via ContractCategoryName / CPV links. No browser or auth needed. Use www.ejn.gov.ba HTML search only as fallback.

api.endpoint: https://open.ejn.gov.ba/  (service doc), entity sets e.g. https://open.ejn.gov.ba/AnnouncementProcedureNotices , /AnnouncementProcedureReports , /AnnouncementDecisions , /AnnualNotices ; metadata at https://open.ejn.gov.ba/$metadata
api.params: OData v4 query options: $top, $skip, $filter, $select, $orderby, $count, $expand. Tested https://open.ejn.gov.ba/AnnouncementProcedureNotices?$top=1
api.format: JSON (OData minimal metadata); $metadata is XML (EDMX, ~217KB). Swagger UI at https://open.ejn.gov.ba/docs/index.html
api.headers: None required; standard Accept: application/json. HTTPS.
api.auth_needed: No — public, no API key, no cookies/login needed. Reproducible via plain curl.

download.type: JSON (OData; paginate with $top/$skip, filter by date via $filter on Announced/LastUpdated)

ejn.gov.ba.next_action: Build OData ingestion job iterating relevant entity sets (ProcedureNotices, ProcedureReports, Decisions, direct-agreement reports, SupplierRegistry) with date-delta filters; map fields for A2/A1/A6.
ejn.gov.ba.notes: Serves Bosnia & Herzegovina. Legacy MVC search endpoints (/Announcement/Search, /BiddingInvitationAnnouncement/Search, /ReportAnnouncement/Search, /Resolution/ResolutionSearch, /Registry/SupplierSearch) are live (200) but are JS/form-driven; the OData API supersedes them for automated collection. No dead sample URLs.

instat.gov.al.recommended_method: Two-tier: (1) For structured time-series data use the PX-Web databank on port 8083 (databaza.instat.gov.al:8083/pxweb/en/DST/). It is classic ASP.NET PX-Web; the JSON REST API (/api/v1/) is disabled, so table data must be exported via the PX-Web query UI (px/csv/xlsx) driven by a browser/form-POST session - best done with a headless browser. (2) For releases, narrative, methodology and deadlines, scrape static HTML at www.instat.gov.al thematic pages, /en/publications/press-releases and /en/publications/calendar/ (all plain HTML, curl-friendly). Use both /en/ and /sq/ language prefixes.
instat.gov.al.error_reason: PxWeb REST API /pxweb/api/v1/en/DST/ returns a PX-Web error page (API not enabled). databaza host (134.0.63.2) is unreachable on ports 80/443 (timeout / connection reset / ECONNREFUSED); the portal is served ONLY on HTTPS port 8083. Sample URL with '/al/' language prefix returns HTTP 404.
instat.gov.al.next_action: In collector environment confirm outbound reachability to databaza.instat.gov.al on TCP 8083, then implement a headless-browser export flow for target PX-Web tables (banking statistics, statistical business register, national accounts). For text/calendar content, static HTML scraping is sufficient now.
instat.gov.al.notes: Country: Albania (national statistics office INSTAT). Main www site fully accessible over HTTPS. The real data warehouse is the PX-Web 'Databaza' on port 8083 (not the default 80/443) - REST JSON API is not enabled, so exports are UI/form-driven. GeoData Hub (geodatahub.instat.gov.al) offers CSV/GeoJSON downloads for spatial data. Dead sample: the '/al/temat/...regjistrat-e-biznesit/' URL 404s; correct language prefix is '/sq/' (verified 200) or use the /en/ business-registers page.

No login required. Iterate targets ctrl0..ctrlN to cover all months 2018-2026.

Requires a real browser session / headless browser with proper User-Agent and JS to load event listings. Investigate XHR/fetch endpoints powering the events grid via a browser dev-tools session.
entrio.hr.next_action: Use a headless browser to load the page and capture the JSON/XHR endpoint feeding the events list
entrio.hr.notes: Croatia. A5/A2 early-intent event tracking; low banking relevance. Blocked by bot protection, not reproducible via plain HTTP.

erstedigital.com.recommended_method: Static corporate site (HTTP 200). No tenders/procurement, downloads, or structured data. For A2/A6 monitoring, scrape the services and (if present) careers/news HTML pages periodically.
erstedigital.com.next_action: Periodic HTML scrape of services page; low structured-data value
erstedigital.com.notes: Croatia (Erste Group IT). Vendor/competitor context (A6) rather than tenders. No data export.

rijeka.hr.recommended_method: HTTP 200 static page. Scrape the javna-nabava HTML for procurement plans and contract-register documents (PDF/Excel). For official tender notices, follow the page's link to the national EOJN RH portal https://eojn.hr/ (as of 2024 consultations/notices published there).

download.type: PDF/Excel (procurement plans, contract registers linked on page)

rijeka.hr.next_action: Scrape page + document links; combine with EOJN portal for official notices
rijeka.hr.notes: Croatia. Official municipal procurement page. No RSS/API; documents linked as files. EOJN RH (eojn.hr) is the authoritative tender source.

The parent /natjecaji-i-oglasi (Natjecaji) section is publicly linked in the main nav and should be scraped instead. split.hr.next_action: Scrape public /natjecaji-i-oglasi listing; use EOJN for official procurement

grad-zadar.hr.recommended_method: HTTP 200 static page. Scrape javna-nabava HTML for active tenders (with deadlines) and downloadable procurement plans/rules (PDF/Excel). A site-wide news RSS exists at https://www.grad-zadar.hr/rss/vijesti-s-pocetne-stranice-0.xml (HTTP 200) though it is general news, not procurement-specific. Official notices via EOJN RH.
grad-zadar.hr.next_action: Scrape procurement HTML + document links; optionally consume news RSS
grad-zadar.hr.notes: Croatia. Official municipal procurement page with dated tenders and downloadable plans. News RSS available (not procurement-specific).

grantthornton.hr.recommended_method: Corporate advisory site (HTTP 200). No tenders. For A6/market-intel value scrape the News (https://www.grantthornton.hr/en/news), Events (https://www.grantthornton.hr/en/Events) and Transparency Report pages for insights/PDF publications.
grantthornton.hr.notes: Croatia. Professional-services vendor (A6), not a tender source. Publications are the relevant resource.

vijesti.hrt.hr.recommended_method: Poll the Gospodarstvo (economy) RSS feed https://feed.hrt.hr/vijesti/gospodarstvo.xml (tested HTTP 200, text/xml, RSS 2.0 with item GUIDs/links). No auth or JS. Use general feed https://feed.hrt.hr/vijesti/page.xml for all news. Parse items and filter for banking/payments keywords; follow item links to full articles.

api.params: none (per-rubric static feeds; general feed at https://feed.hrt.hr/vijesti/page.xml)

vijesti.hrt.hr.next_action: Set up RSS polling of gospodarstvo.xml for banking/economy news
vijesti.hrt.hr.notes: Croatia. Public broadcaster news; economy RSS validated. Good low-friction A2/A4 news signal source.

kdvik-rijeka.hr.recommended_method: The sample URL /Javna_nabava redirects to /home (dead). The working procurement page is https://www.kdvik-rijeka.hr/home/Javna_nabava (HTTP 200, no redirect) with sub-sections for prior consultation, simplified procurement and contract register. Scrape that page and its sub-pages for procurement documents.
kdvik-rijeka.hr.notes: Croatia (Rijeka water utility). Sample URL dead; corrected working URL identified. No RSS/API; navigate menu to sub-pages.

klemmsecurity.hr.recommended_method: Static corporate site (HTTP 200) for a private security company. No news, tenders, or structured data, and no evident cash-in-transit/ATM/banking angle. Low intelligence value; deprioritize. If tracked at all, occasional HTML scrape of homepage.
klemmsecurity.hr.notes: Croatia. Security vendor with no banking/payments (A2/A6) relevance and no data resources.

qkb.gov.al.resource_type: HTML page with embedded JSON (server-rendered search POST); plus JSON sub-APIs and PDF reports
qkb.gov.al.recommended_method: For company-level A1/A6 data: automate an HTTP POST to https://format.qkb.gov.al/kerko-per-subjekt/ with x-www-form-urlencoded search params (e.g. emriISubjektit or nipt), then parse the JSON array embedded in the returned HTML (List.js valueNames). For red-flag/document metadata per NIPT, POST to the .php sub-endpoints. For A4 market statistics, scrape the annual-report PDFs from qkb.gov.al/raporte-vjetore/. Rate-limit and query by name/NIPT rather than bulk-harvesting (no bulk export offered).

api.endpoint: https://format.qkb.gov.al/kerko-per-subjekt/ (main search; embedded in qkb.gov.al/kerko-per-subjekt/ via iframe). JSON sub-endpoints under https://format.qkb.gov.al/wp-content/themes/twentytwentyfive-child/modules/search/national-registry/subject/ : search-for-subject-get-red-flag.php, search-for-subject-get-documents.php, search-for-subject-get-city-list.php
api.params: Main search form fields: nipt, emriISubjektit, emriTregtar, formeLigjore, pronesia, dataNga, dataNe, administrator, aksionerOrtak, sektoriIVeprimtarise, qarku, qyteti, adresa, numriId, orderColumn, orderDir. Sub-APIs take e.g. nipt=<NIPT> or districtName=<qark>.
api.format: Main search: text/html with a JSON array embedded server-side (List.js `values`). Sub-endpoints: application/json.
api.headers: Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded. No auth header, no cookie/session required in testing.

download.type: PDF (annual commercial-register statistics report; archive 2014-2025 at https://qkb.gov.al/raporte-vjetore/)

qkb.gov.al.next_action: Build a POST-based collector against format.qkb.gov.al/kerko-per-subjekt/ and a PDF scraper for raporte-vjetore; map full JSON field schema from a sample response.
qkb.gov.al.notes: Serves Albania. QKB = Qendra Kombetare e Biznesit (National Business Center), the official commercial register. Main site qkb.gov.al is WordPress; the actual searchable data lives on the iframe app host format.qkb.gov.al. Search POST returns real, structured company records with no authentication - high value for A1 (corporate disclosures) and A6 (vendors/competitors). Dead sample: https://qkb.gov.al/kerko/kerko-ne-regjistrin-tregtar/kerko-per-subjekt/ returns 404 (use https://qkb.gov.al/kerko-per-subjekt/ instead). e-Albania (e-albania.al) offers the same extracts behind login as an alternative.

hgk.hr.recommended_method: Server-rendered CMS: fetch the HTML hub pages (analize-i-publikacije, odabrani-makroekonomski-pokazatelji, sektorski-pregledi..., aktualno, odjel-za-financijske-institucije...) with a plain HTTP GET, then regex/parse anchor hrefs pointing to /documents/*.pdf and download those PDFs. No JS, cookies or auth required. Poll /aktualno for A3 regulatory/deadline news and /dogadjanja for A5 events.
hgk.hr.next_action: Enumerate PDF download links under /documents/ from each analytical hub page on a schedule; parse macro-indicator PDF and sector-review PDFs for A1/A4 data.
hgk.hr.notes: Croatian Chamber of Economy (Hrvatska gospodarska komora); serves Croatia. All 14 sample URLs reachable. Both www.hgk.hr and hgk.hr work interchangeably. Sample paths for financijski-sektor now 302-redirect to a renamed department path (.../odjel-za-financijske-institucije-i-osiguravajuca-drustva/...) but resolve to 200 content, so not dead. Content is fully server-rendered HTML; downloadable data is PDF only (no Excel/CSV/API observed).

fba.ba.resource_type: HTML listing pages + PDF reports (register pages are HTML)
fba.ba.recommended_method: Static HTTP crawl with curl/requests (server-rendered HTML, no JS or auth needed). Scrape the publications index (publikacije-subjekti-bankarskog-sistema-...) for per-quarter detail pages, then extract the PDF href (pattern ./images/documents_archive/*.pdf -> https://www.fba.ba/images/documents_archive/*.pdf) and download. For registers scrape the HTML sub-pages under /bs/banke-4, /bs/lizing-76, /bs/mko-3, /bs/drustva-za-faktoring. Poll /bs/novosti and /bs/javne-nabavke pages for new items. Note: server presents an incomplete TLS cert chain (WebFetch failed 'unable to verify first certificate'); use a client that tolerates this or add the intermediate cert.
fba.ba.next_action: Build scraper: (1) index publications page -> follow each quarterly detail page -> download PDF; (2) scrape licensed-entity register sub-pages; (3) monitor /bs/novosti and /bs/javne-nabavke for new items. Configure HTTP client to tolerate the incomplete cert chain.
fba.ba.notes: Serves Bosnia (Banking Agency of the Federation of BiH). Fully reachable, static server-rendered HTML; no JS, no API, no login required for public content (a /auth/login exists only for staff). All 6 tested sample URLs returned 200; no dead sample URLs found. WebFetch tool itself failed due to TLS intermediate-cert issue but plain curl works, so this is a client-config detail, not a source problem.

exit.al.recommended_method: Scrape article HTML from category listing pages (e.g. /en/category/economy/, /en/category/analysis/) with pagination; server-rendered so plain HTTP GET works. WordPress REST API (wp-json) and RSS (/feed/) are disabled (404), so use HTML scraping.
exit.al.next_action: Set up HTML scraper over economy/analysis category pages; monitor for Bank of Albania/EMI regulatory articles
exit.al.notes: Albania. Independent English news watchdog; good A1/A6 qualitative intel on BoA/EMI regulation. WordPress REST API and RSS both disabled. WebFetch returns 403 due to bot UA but curl (browser-like) returns 200 fine. All sample URLs live.

indeed.com.recommended_method: Indeed enforces Cloudflare/anti-bot; all sample URLs return HTTP 403 to non-browser clients. Requires a headless real browser with anti-detection or an official/partner jobs API (legacy publisher API largely deprecated). Prefer local job boards for BiH/Albania coverage.
indeed.com.error_reason: HTTP 403 (Cloudflare anti-bot) on cmp and job-search URLs
indeed.com.next_action: Use a stealth headless browser for periodic checks, or switch to local job boards (Albania: duapune.com; Bosnia: posao.ba) for A5 signals
indeed.com.notes: Albania, Bosnia. Anti-bot blocked. Albania is not a first-class Indeed market so employer-page depth is thin; BiH job coverage limited. Manual/browser validation needed.

vodafone.al.recommended_method: Scrape public marketing/terms HTML pages (rimbushje-online, M-Pesa service/terms pages) via HTTP GET — server-rendered, 200 OK. The My Vodafone self-care portal (/my-vodafone) is a customer login area (auth required) and cannot be collected without credentials; only its public landing page is scrapable.
vodafone.al.next_action: Scrape public payments/M-Pesa terms & product pages for pricing/service changes; do not attempt login portal
vodafone.al.notes: Albania. Low-to-medium value: telco payments (M-Pesa mobile money, online recharge with card) as a payments vendor signal. Public pages fine; My Vodafone app/portal is auth-gated. All sample URLs return 200.

fondibesa.com.recommended_method: Poll the public WordPress REST API https://fondibesa.com/wp-json/wp/v2/posts?per_page=20&orderby=date for new posts; filter titles/slugs for 'njoftim-punesimi'/'vacancy-notice' (A5 hiring) and news. Fallback: scrape https://fondibesa.com/career/ HTML which lists vacancy-notice-* pages. Bilingual (sq/en).

api.params: per_page, page, search, categories, orderby, order

fondibesa.com.next_action: Automate WP REST API polling for vacancies/news; map sq vs en posts
fondibesa.com.notes: Albania. Strong A5/A2 source: active job vacancy notices and news via clean WP REST API (no auth). Management-team page also live. All sample URLs 200.

kfw-entwicklungsbank.de.recommended_method: Scrape server-rendered HTML pages (Procurement-Regulations, Local-presence/Europe, Transparency) via HTTP GET (200 OK). KfW does NOT list actual tender/consulting notices on this domain — they are published on GTAI (www.gtai.de) and the KfW e-tendering platform; project/transparency data is exposed as a JS microsite at www.kfw.de/microsites/Microsite/transparenz.kfw.de and as IATI/BMZ open project data at bmz.de. Use those for structured tender/project data.
kfw-entwicklungsbank.de.next_action: Scrape KfW country/Europe pages for BiH/Albania project news; route tender collection to GTAI portal and project data to BMZ/IATI open data; treat transparenz.kfw.de dashboard as manual/browser
kfw-entwicklungsbank.de.notes: Albania, Bosnia. Domain pages are static HTML (accessible). Actual A2 tender notices live off-domain (GTAI). Transparency portal is a JS dashboard on kfw.de; structured project data available via BMZ/IATI. Procurement guidelines PDF downloadable. All sample URLs 200.

asd.gov.al.resource_type: statistics portal (Open Data hub) with Excel + PDF + HTML register
asd.gov.al.recommended_method: Scrape the Open Data page (https://asd.gov.al/en/home/news/open-data/) and the Annual Reports page for current file links, then fetch the statistics XLSX directly via HTTP GET (no auth, no JS). WordPress /wp-content/uploads/<year>/<month>/ path pattern; re-discover the dated filename each period since it changes (2025 file lives under /2026/06/). Also harvest member-bank/SCA register HTML and annual-report PDFs.
asd.gov.al.next_action: Add the Open Data page + Annual Reports page as recurring scrape targets; parse the linked XLSX for A4 market stats and the register/PDF reports for A1/A3. No manual step needed.
asd.gov.al.notes: Serves ALBANIA. Official government WordPress site for the Deposit Insurance Agency (ADIA/ASD). Bilingual (Albanian /faqja-kryesore/ and English /en/home/). Statistics page renders charts as images, but the same data is published as a downloadable XLSX on the Open Data page (CC BY 4.0), which is tested and working. All 4 spot-checked URLs returned HTTP 200; no dead sample URLs found.

databank.worldbank.org.recommended_method: Use the free unauthenticated World Bank Indicators API with source=28. First pull the indicator catalog (indicator?source=28), then loop indicators x countries (AL;BA;BG;HR) with format=json&per_page=1000&date range. No key, no cookies, reproducible with curl. Confirmed working: Bulgaria account.t.d 2021 = 83.97%.

api.endpoint: https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/{iso}/indicator/{indicator}?source=28&format=json (e.g. https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/BG/indicator/account.t.d?source=28&format=json&date=2021). Indicator catalog: https://api.worldbank.org/v2/indicator?source=28&format=json (3313 Findex indicators, 663 pages). Source metadata: https://api.worldbank.org/v2/sources/28?format=json
api.params: source=28 (Global Findex), country=ISO codes semicolon-separated (AL;BA;BG;HR or ALB;BIH;BGR;HRV), indicator=e.g. account.t.d, format=json (or xml), date=year (e.g. 2021), per_page, page

download.type: JSON/XML bulk per-indicator; full microdata/xlsx available at globalfindex.worldbank.org

databank.worldbank.org.next_action: Enumerate needed Findex indicators (account ownership, digital payment, made/received digital payments) and loop the 4 country codes via the API on a scheduled cadence (Findex is triennial: 2011/2014/2017/2021).
databank.worldbank.org.notes: Serves all four countries (Albania, Bosnia, Bulgaria, Croatia). The interactive DataBank UI is JS-heavy but the underlying api.worldbank.org endpoint fully reproduces it outside a browser. Note the DataBank v2 API also exists at https://api.worldbank.org/v2/... The sample URL is fine but should be treated as UI only.

amcham.bg.recommended_method: Static HTML scraping (nginx, server-rendered). Poll /about-us/board/, /events-overview/ (+ past events), and the News/Member News listings. Membership directory at /membership-benefits/membership-directory/ for member org list. No API/JS needed; simple HTTP GET + HTML parse.
amcham.bg.next_action: Schedule HTML scrapes of board, events, and member-news pages; watch for Mastercard/scheme/vendor personnel and event speaker announcements.
amcham.bg.notes: Bulgaria source (also referenced by Albania collector). English-language site, fully static. Publications/AmCham Magazine section may hold PDFs if deeper reports are needed.

addiko-rs.ba.recommended_method: Static HTML scrape of /o-nama/publikacije/ and /o-nama/osnovni-podaci/finansijski-izvjestaji/ and /o-nama/pressmedia/saopstenja-za-medije/, extract PDF links under /static/uploads/, then fetch PDFs for A1 (financial statements/annual reports) and press releases. Apache, server-rendered, no JS/auth.

download.url: https://www.addiko-rs.ba/static/uploads/[filename].pdf (PDF documents linked from the Publikacije and Finansijski izvjestaji pages)

addiko-rs.ba.next_action: Scrape the three sections for new PDF filenames on a schedule; parse annual/half-yearly financial statement PDFs.
addiko-rs.ba.notes: Bosnia (Republika Srpska entity) source. No dedicated procurement/tenders (A2) page observed — homepage used as placeholder for A2; A2 likely not served here. All reports PDF format only.

business-magazine.ba.recommended_method: Consume the WordPress RSS feeds (site-wide /feed/ and category /category/ekonomija/feed/, plus /category/finansije/feed/) for incremental article intake; optionally use /wp-json/wp/v2/posts for structured JSON with date filtering. Both are unauthenticated GET, reproducible with curl. Fall back to paginated HTML listing (Stranica X of 976) for backfill.

api.params: RSS: none. REST (if enabled): per_page, page, categories, search, after (date filter)

business-magazine.ba.next_action: Poll RSS feeds on a schedule; confirm /wp-json/wp/v2/posts availability for richer JSON + keyword (MoneyGram, mikrokreditne, kartično) filtering.
business-magazine.ba.notes: Bosnia trade-media source (A1/A2 news signals). Sample article URLs from 2017 and 2023 both resolve HTTP 200. WordPress makes RSS + REST API the durable collection method over card scraping.

tech.bg.recommended_method: Use a real browser (Chrome automation) to pass the Cloudflare challenge, then scrape front_job_search.php listing pages; not reproducible with plain curl/WebFetch
tech.bg.error_reason: HTTP 403 (Cloudflare bot challenge) on curl and WebFetch for both homepage and job-search page
tech.bg.next_action: Load in Chrome browser tool to clear Cloudflare, then scrape job listings
tech.bg.notes: Bulgaria. Bulgarian IT job board (peer/competitor of jobs.bg, dev.bg). Cloudflare-protected. Homepage https://www.tech.bg/en/ returns 403 to automated fetch.

web.lakorda.com.next_action: Switch collection to official State Gazette dv.parliament.bg (free, public) for regulatory bulletins
web.lakorda.com.notes: Bulgaria. Lakorda AD commercial legal/expert software; login wall. Recommend official replacement dv.parliament.bg (Държавен вестник).

skop.cloud.recommended_method: SKOP itself exposes no public data. For A3 procurement monitoring in Bulgaria, collect from the official Public Procurement portal (CAIS EOP, https://app.eop.bg/) and AOP (https://www.aop.bg/) which publish tenders/contracts
skop.cloud.next_action: Redirect collection to official Bulgarian procurement sources (app.eop.bg / aop.bg); treat skop.cloud as vendor context only
skop.cloud.notes: Bulgaria. Homepage reachable (HTTP 200) but no public procurement dataset — data is behind login. Not a usable open source; official EOP/AOP portals recommended instead.

dnevnik.hr.recommended_method: Poll RSS feed https://dnevnik.hr/rss (returns application/xml) for headlines; scrape article/listing HTML for A1 corporate-disclosure/news items; Biznis content lives at forbes.dnevnik.hr
dnevnik.hr.next_action: Use RSS for polling; deep-scrape Biznis (forbes.dnevnik.hr) for business news
dnevnik.hr.notes: Croatia. General/business news portal (Nova TV). RSS works. Sample URL /vijesti/hrvatska reachable.

fer.unizg.hr.recommended_method: Scrape the HTML listing directly (curl/Apache serves 200 with browser UA); no RSS/API observed. Follow each job link for employer/company details
fer.unizg.hr.error_reason: WebFetch returned 403, but plain curl GET returns HTTP 200 — WAF sensitive to fetch signature
fer.unizg.hr.next_action: Collect via curl/browser with a normal UA; parse job cards
fer.unizg.hr.notes: Croatia. University career-center job board. Reachable via curl (200); WebFetch blocked by WAF. Use browser-like UA.

itbizcrunch.com.error_reason: Homepage HTTP 403 (nginx WAF) to curl/WebFetch; RSS endpoint works with browser UA
itbizcrunch.com.next_action: Consume RSS feed for A1 news; for full articles fetch item links via browser UA
itbizcrunch.com.notes: Croatia. IT/business news (Joomla). Homepage 403 to bots but RSS feed tested working.

poslovnipuls.com.recommended_method: Poll WordPress RSS https://poslovnipuls.com/feed/ (tested, application/rss+xml); category feeds available at /<category>/feed/; homepage HTML also open (200)
poslovnipuls.com.notes: Croatia. WordPress business news site, open RSS feed tested working.

t.me.recommended_method: Scrape the /s/ web preview (server-rendered, no login) — parse .tgme_widget_message blocks; paginate via ?before= param. No API key needed. For robustness could use Telegram Bot/MTProto but web preview suffices

thedubrovniktimes.com.recommended_method: Poll RSS https://www.thedubrovniktimes.com/?format=feed&type=rss (tested, valid RSS 2.0); also scrape /news/croatia listing HTML (200) for economy/business items
thedubrovniktimes.com.next_action: Consume RSS + filter economy/business articles for A1
thedubrovniktimes.com.notes: Croatia. English news portal. RSS tested working; no separate business vertical (economy items under News/Croatia).

hrportfolio.hr.recommended_method: For A1 market/stock data prefer the official source Zagreb Stock Exchange (zse.hr), which publishes quotes, indices and downloadable data. hrportfolio.hr requires a Cloudflare-clearing browser session; use Chrome automation only if the aggregator view is specifically needed

hrportfolio.hr.next_action: Collect from official zse.hr; if aggregator required, load hrportfolio.hr in Chrome browser tool to pass Cloudflare
hrportfolio.hr.notes: Croatia. Cloudflare-protected ZSE aggregator. Sample URL /burza/zagrebacka-burza-zse blocked to bots. Recommend official Zagreb Stock Exchange zse.hr.

fiu.gov.al.resource_type: HTML page (WordPress) linking downloadable PDF documents
fiu.gov.al.recommended_method: Static scrape of the section pages (both /en/ English and Albanian roots): /en/legislation/guidelines/ (udhezime), /en/legislation/orders/ (urdhera), /en/legislation/ (ligje, VKM, draft acts /projekt-aktet/), /en/news-activities/publications/, /raporte/ (annual reports), /deklarata-fatf/ (FATF grey/black list). fiu.gov.al.next_action: Set up recurring static crawl of the listed section pages; extract and diff wp-content/uploads PDF links to catch new instructions/orders/reports and updated FATF lists (e.g. grey-and-black-list-june-2026.pdf).

Site is plain WordPress; every legal/publication document is a directly downloadable PDF under /wp-content/uploads/. Content is current (FATF list June 2026, Instruction no.25 Nov 2025). /raporto/ and /raporto... note: /raporto/ is the online-reporting portal (data submission, not a data source). paysera.com.recommended_method: Scrape the blog index (https://www.paysera.com/v2/en/blog -> redirects to /blog-international), the press/newsroom page (https://www.paysera.com/v2/en/press, 'More press releases...' link), and localized editions (Bulgarian: https://www.paysera.com/v2/bg/blog-bulgaria; Albania articles under /v2/en/blog/*-albania). paysera.com.next_action: Set up an HTML scraper over blog + press + Bulgarian blog + career sections with a browser-like UA; filter articles by Balkans keywords (Albania/Bulgaria/Bosnia/EMI/BNB/Central Bank of Albania). No API or bulk download available.

No statistics/open-data/downloads — it's a marketing/newsroom site.
