ais.al.next_action: Map dataset export/API endpoints on spending.data.al and opendata.gov.al; note open.data.al redirect to ndiqparate.al and confirm which is the current live Open Data Albania front
ais.al.notes: Albania. AIS is the NGO behind Open Data Albania / Open Spending Albania — high value A2/A4. Both sample URLs 200. open.data.al now redirects to ndiqparate.al (verify).

amcham.com.al.recommended_method: WordPress site — HTTP GET /event/ (200) gives the first page of events; additional events load via a 'Load More' AJAX call (admin-ajax.php). For reliable structured harvest test the WordPress REST API (https://amcham.com.al/wp-json/wp/v2/) and any events post-type, or the WP feed (/feed/). Homepage carries member/press news.
amcham.com.al.next_action: Probe /wp-json/wp/v2/ and admin-ajax load-more params to paginate events; check /feed/ for press news
amcham.com.al.notes: Albania. AmCham (American Chamber of Commerce) Albania. Both sample URLs 200. Events beyond first page require AJAX load-more.

noafin.al.recommended_method: Site returns HTTP 403 to curl and WebFetch (both desktop Chrome and Safari UAs) — WAF/bot protection. Retrieve via a real headless browser (Playwright/Selenium with full browser fingerprint and cookies) or an approved proxy; the pages themselves are static HTML once the WAF challenge is passed. No CAPTCHA content observed, just a 403 gate.
noafin.al.error_reason: HTTP 403 Forbidden (bot/WAF block) on homepage and management-team page, multiple UAs
noafin.al.next_action: Access with a headless browser that passes the WAF challenge; then scrape struktura/ekipi_drejtues and any /karriera vacancies page
noafin.al.notes: Albania. NOA sh.a. non-bank financial/microfinance institution. Both sample URLs return 403 (bot protection), not real 404s — pages likely exist. Needs browser-based collection.

borica.bg.resource_type: HTML page + PDF report/register downloads + press-release list
borica.bg.recommended_method: Direct HTTP GET (curl/requests, no JS, no auth). Scrape the Documents & Resources sections (Operationals, Financial Reports, Legal, Certifications) and the /en/latest/novini press-release list for anchor hrefs; PDFs live under /attachments/BobsDocument/... and /attachments/BobsProduct/... and download directly. Poll periodically for updated files (dates are embedded in filenames, e.g. -11-2025). Certified ATM/POS terminal lists (A6 vendor data) and annual financial reports (A1) are the highest-value structured artifacts.
borica.bg.next_action: Build a scraper that enumerates the four Documents & Resources category pages and the paginated /en/latest/novini and /latest/novini lists, extracting PDF hrefs and article links; schedule periodic re-crawl to catch date-stamped file updates. No manual validation needed.
borica.bg.notes: Critical Bulgaria source. BORICA AD = national card operator and operator of BISERA (BGN/EUR-SEPA) and instant-payment (BLINK) systems; covers A1-A6. Site runs on the 'BOBS' CMS; all inspected pages are plain static HTML (no JS rendering, no API, no login). News list is paginated ([1][2][3][Next]); no RSS feed detected. All 15 sample URLs reachable (HTTP 200). Financial-reports landing page (/en/documents-and-resources/Finansovi-otcheti) rendered thinly via WebFetch but is a live static category page; actual annual-report PDFs sit within that section's HTML.

ba.linkedin.com.resource_type: HTML page (JS-rendered social platform; public 'About' partial, rest auth-gated)
ba.linkedin.com.recommended_method: For firmographics: fetch individual company /company/<slug> 'About' pages, which return HTTP 200 with partial public content (name, industry, size band, HQ, website, latest post). Reliable at low volume but LinkedIn ToS prohibits automated scraping and enforces anti-bot rate limiting / login walls at scale. For jobs (A5 early-intent) and employee/leadership moves (A1/A6): requires an authenticated session or the official LinkedIn Talent Solutions / Marketing Developer API (OAuth partner program) - treat as manual or licensed-API collection. Do NOT build unauthenticated scraping against jobs endpoints.
ba.linkedin.com.next_action: Decide collection mode: (1) low-volume public 'About' page fetches for firmographics (A1/A6 baseline), and/or (2) apply for official LinkedIn API access or use a compliant licensed jobs feed for A5 jobs and hiring-intent signals. Confirm ToS/legal posture before any automated harvesting.
ba.linkedin.com.notes: Serves Bosnia. Single-domain batch. Company 'About' pages (cbbih, bamcard, asa-banka, raiffeisen-bank-dd-bih, addiko-bank-sarajevo, intesa-sanpaolo-banka-bih, nlb-banka, novabanka-banjaluka, udruzenje-banaka BiH banking association, agencija-za-bankarstvo-fbih FBiH banking agency, partner-mko MKO/leasing, bloomberg-adria-bih showcase) all resolve and load; useful for org identity/size and occasional public posts. Jobs URLs (/jobs, /jobs/jobs-in-sarajevo, /jobs/compliance-jobs) return 200 shells but require login to see full results. No sample URL was dead. Primary blocker is LinkedIn auth wall + anti-scraping ToS, not a broken link.

mojposao.ba.recommended_method: Plain HTTP GET the /pretraga-poslova search URLs (no auth, no JS needed). Nuxt SSR renders job cards directly into the HTML (1000+ data-v- nodes, job titles/employers present), so parse listings from the returned HTML. Use query params to filter (positions=IT, sortBy=adtype) and paginate. Homepage and /poslovi also return 200. An internal JSON/GraphQL API likely exists (references to baseURL in bundle) but was not needed — SSR HTML is sufficient and reproducible outside a browser.
mojposao.ba.next_action: Build a parser for the SSR job-card HTML on /pretraga-poslova; enumerate relevant position filters and pagination; optionally sniff the internal XHR/JSON endpoint via a browser for cleaner structured data.
mojposao.ba.notes: Serves Bosnia (BiH). No dead sample URLs — all six sample URLs on this domain resolve 200. Site is Alma Career BH (sister of mojposao.hr; shared static.mojposao.hr brand assets).

nezavisne.com.recommended_method: Requires a real browser session: whole domain sits behind Cloudflare bot protection (returns HTTP 403 to curl and to WebFetch, even with a desktop Chrome User-Agent). Use a headless/full browser that passes the Cloudflare JS challenge (e.g. Playwright/Puppeteer with stealth, or the Chrome browser tool) to load /ekonomija (and sub-sections /ekonomija/privreda, /ekonomija/trziste) or the RSS feeds under /rss. Article URLs follow /ekonomija/<sub>/<slug>/<id> and can be crawled once past the challenge.
nezavisne.com.error_reason: HTTP 403 (Cloudflare bot protection / JS challenge) on all URLs incl. /rss, /rss.xml, /feed
nezavisne.com.next_action: Load /rss (or /ekonomija) through the Chrome browser tool / a stealth headless browser to solve the Cloudflare challenge, capture a working RSS feed URL or the rendered article list, then automate via that session (persist Cloudflare clearance cookie).
nezavisne.com.notes: Serves Bosnia (Republika Srpska daily). Content confirmed to exist and be relevant (Ekonomija/Privreda/Trziste/Analize), but not reproducible outside a browser due to Cloudflare. Dead to automated fetch: all six sample URLs 403 via curl/WebFetch (blocked, not truly dead).

kpp.al.recommended_method: Scrape the server-rendered Historiku decisions registry (and Ankesa complaints register / PraktikaGjyqesore) via HTTP GET with the search filters as query params; harvest per-decision detail pages and use the built-in JSON export where present. No login needed. Note that /Raporte (Biblioteka annual reports & complaint statistics) currently returns 'Nuk ka te dhena per te shfaqur' (no data) — monitor for republished reports.
kpp.al.next_action: Map the exact query-string parameters of the Historiku search form and the JSON-export endpoint by inspecting one live search; confirm pagination scheme for bulk decision harvesting.
kpp.al.notes: Albania — Public Procurement Commission (Komisioni i Prokurimit Publik). Platform by 'Communication Progress'. All 6 sample URLs live (both /al/Historiku and /Historiku resolve). /Raporte reachable but reports list empty at time of check. Workstreams A1 (corporate/EO decisions) and A2 (procurement).

qbz.gov.al.recommended_method: Download Official Gazette issues directly from the Alfresco WebDAV path (FZ/{year}/{n}/FZ-{year}-{n}.pdf) — no login, supports HTTP range requests (206). Enumerate issue numbers per year sequentially. For consolidated acts, resolve the WebDAV path from the ELI act metadata. The /eli/fz, /eli/bnjz, /eli/akte browse pages are an Angular SPA (JS-rendered) that fetches metadata from a backend API — use browser/headless rendering to discover act paths, then fetch PDFs directly.
qbz.gov.al.next_action: Use headless browser network capture on /eli/fz to identify the real metadata JSON API endpoint (host + params) that maps ELI ids to WebDAV PDF paths, enabling fully automated enumeration; meanwhile bulk-fetch FZ issues via the predictable WebDAV pattern.
qbz.gov.al.notes: Albania — Qendra e Botimeve Zyrtare (Official Publications Centre / Official Gazette). Platform by 'Communication Progress' (Angular Fuse SPA). All 6 sample URLs reachable; the two /alfresco/webdav PDFs are directly downloadable and the primary automation target. The 4 HTML/ELI URLs are JS-rendered browse UIs, not static. Workstreams A1/A2/A3 (gazette publication of AMF board decisions, official notices, consolidated acts/regulation).

nlb-rs.ba.recommended_method: Scrape the server-rendered HTML sections (reports, saopstenja, karijera) with a simple HTTP client (curl/requests, no JS). Reports/disclosures live on Adobe AEM /content/dam/... paths as direct application/pdf links; harvest those hrefs and download PDFs. Poll saopstenja-i-aktuelnosti and karijera pages for A1/A3/A5 items.
nlb-rs.ba.next_action: Automate periodic HTML fetch of reports/news/careers pages and download new PDFs; monitor saopstenja for 'javni poziv'/'oglas' tender items.
nlb-rs.ba.notes: Serves Bosnia (Republika Srpska), NLB Banka a.d. Banja Luka. Site is Adobe AEM, server-rendered, no login. Two sample URLs 404: https://www.nlb-rs.ba/o-banci/oglasi (careers now at /o-banci/karijera) and https://www.nlb-rs.ba/javni-poziv-za-pretkvalifikaciju (public calls/tenders are published as items under /o-banci/saopstenja-i-aktuelnosti, e.g. the 'oglas--javni-poziv...eksternih-agencija' post). Note trailing slashes trigger a 301 to iso-8859-1 error page then 404 on some paths; request without trailing slash.

posao.klix.ba.recommended_method: Scrape server-rendered HTML with a plain HTTP client (no JS needed). Crawl /oglasi and category pages /kat/<slug> for listings; fetch employer pages at /poslodavci/<slug>/<id> for company detail and active/expired ads. Company URLs use the /poslodavci/ path (older /companies/ paths 301-redirect to /poslodavci/).
posao.klix.ba.next_action: Set up periodic crawl of /oglasi and category pages plus watched employer profiles (Payten, Monri, MKF Mikra) for new job ads.
posao.klix.ba.notes: Serves Bosnia. Job board operated by Klix.ba. Fully server-rendered, no login/paywall. /companies/<slug>/<id> permanently redirects to /poslodavci/<slug>/<id> (301) - use the poslodavci path. No dead sample URLs (redirects resolve to 200).

raiffeisenbank.ba.resource_type: HTML page + PDF reports (also tenders HTML page, press room)
raiffeisenbank.ba.recommended_method: Static HTTP scrape via curl/requests. Site runs Adobe Experience Manager: report pages list PDFs as /content/dam/rbi/retail/eu/ba/.../<file>.pdf.coredownload.pdf which return application/pdf directly (200, no auth/cookies). For A1 corporate disclosures, scrape the publications.html page for .coredownload.pdf hrefs and fetch each. For A2/A3 tenders, poll the aktuelni-tenderi page (parse HTML for notice titles, publish/deadline dates, procurement contact email). EN and BS (/en/ vs /bs/) mirror versions exist for language coverage.
raiffeisenbank.ba.next_action: Build a scheduled scraper: (1) parse publications.html for *.coredownload.pdf links (A1/A4), (2) parse aktuelni-tenderi page for current procurement notices+deadlines (A2/A3), (3) for press room render the Novosti page with a headless browser or find its underlying AEM content-fragment JSON since news items are JS-injected.
raiffeisenbank.ba.notes: Serves Bosnia (Raiffeisen Bank dd BiH). All 5 spot-checked sample URLs returned 200; no dead sample URLs found. Publications page carries a rich, historical PDF archive (annual reports 2014-2024, consolidated statements 2023-2025, Pillar 3 disclosures) - strong A1/A4 source. Tenders page had 2 live procurement calls with deadlines (solar panels, advertising panels) - good A2/A3. The EN /about-us/media/Novosti.html press room renders individual news items via JavaScript (WebFetch saw only the shell); the report/tender pages themselves are static and fully scrapeable. iso-8859-1 charset on the 301 but utf-8 on actual pages.

montran.com.recommended_method: Poll the WordPress RSS feed https://www.montran.com/feed/ for new posts; also scrape /resources/ and /client-success/ index pages (static HTML, curl-accessible) to catch vendor/competitor and TIPS/RTGS implementation news relevant to Bulgaria (BORICA).
montran.com.next_action: Add /feed/ to RSS collection; optionally filter items mentioning Bulgaria/BORICA/TIPS.
montran.com.notes: Serves Bulgaria (vendor for BORICA TIPS connectivity). Both sample URLs live. WordPress site, fully curl-accessible.

fintech.bg.recommended_method: Poll WordPress RSS: site-wide https://fintech.bg/feed/ and category feed https://fintech.bg/category/банкови-технологии/feed/ (WordPress appends /feed/ to any category). Static HTML, curl-accessible; no JS needed.
fintech.bg.next_action: Subscribe site-wide feed and the banking-technologies category feed for A2/A6 monitoring.
fintech.bg.notes: Bulgaria. Both sample URLs live (Cyrillic-encoded category URL works). WordPress with RSS.

paymentsindustryintelligence.com.recommended_method: Poll WordPress RSS https://paymentsindustryintelligence.com/feed/ for new items; for Bulgaria backfill use the search URL https://paymentsindustryintelligence.com/?s=Bulgaria (static HTML, curl-accessible) and filter. A WordPress search feed is also available via ?s=Bulgaria&feed=rss2.
paymentsindustryintelligence.com.next_action: Add site feed to collection; periodically scrape ?s=Bulgaria for country-specific items.
paymentsindustryintelligence.com.notes: Referenced for Bulgaria (A2/A4). Global media, not Bulgaria-specific, but has substantive Bulgaria coverage. WordPress, curl-accessible.

beabg.com.recommended_method: Poll WordPress RSS https://beabg.com/feed/ for news/position statements (A3 regulation, A5 early-intent via events/working groups); scrape the members directory and news section (static HTML, curl-accessible) for member/vendor lists.
beabg.com.next_action: Add /feed/ to RSS collection; scrape members directory and position statements pages periodically.
beabg.com.notes: Bulgaria. Both sample URLs (/ and /za-bea/) part of live WordPress site. News + members data available.

kinstellar.com.recommended_method: Scrape the server-rendered listing with query filters, e.g. https://www.kinstellar.com/news-and-insights?filter%5Bexpertise%5D=1 for Banking/Finance, adding office filters for Sofia (Bulgaria) and Zagreb (Croatia). Paginate via next-page links. No RSS found (/rss returns an HTML page, not a feed).
kinstellar.com.next_action: Build a filtered-URL scraper (expertise=1 + Sofia/Zagreb offices) and paginate; parse article links.
kinstellar.com.notes: Serves Bulgaria (Sofia office) and Croatia (Zuric i Partneri / Zagreb). Core content server-rendered; filter query params reproducible outside a browser. No genuine RSS.

developer.mastercard.com.recommended_method: Use a headless browser (JS render) to load the bulletin-announcements page and capture the underlying content/XHR JSON. Root returns HTTP 200 but is a JS SPA that yields near-empty HTML to curl/WebFetch; document content is client-rendered and some sections require a Mastercard Developers account. Requires manual/browser validation to identify the content API.
developer.mastercard.com.error_reason: JS-only SPA (curl/WebFetch return title-only shell); portions may require login
developer.mastercard.com.next_action: Open the bulletin-announcements page in a headless browser, inspect network XHR/fetch for a JSON docs endpoint; confirm whether login is required.
developer.mastercard.com.notes: Referenced for Bulgaria (A3 regulation/deadlines). Global vendor docs portal, JS-rendered; not curl-reproducible. Not blocked by CAPTCHA/paywall at root but content needs JS and possibly auth.

schoenherr.eu.recommended_method: Scrape the server-rendered news/publications listing (chronological, newest first) for Banking & Financial Services Regulatory; also monitor the Croatia location page https://www.schoenherr.eu/locations/croatia. No RSS (/rss = 404); a newsletter subscribe page exists at /news/subscribe (email signup, not needed for scraping).
schoenherr.eu.next_action: Build a scraper for the banking-regulatory news listing (parse article links + dates) and the Croatia location insights page.
schoenherr.eu.notes: Serves Bulgaria and Croatia (CEE law firm). Both sample URLs live. Server-rendered HTML; no RSS feed available.

thebanks.eu.recommended_method: Directory of EMIs/banks with structured profiles (A1 disclosures, A4 stats) is high value, but the site returns HTTP 403 to curl and WebFetch even with a browser User-Agent (bot protection). Collect via a real/headless browser session that passes the bot check, or an approved scraping service that renders JS and carries cookies. Do NOT bypass protections automatically without approval.
thebanks.eu.error_reason: HTTP 403 (bot/Cloudflare protection) on both sample URLs and homepage; blocked for curl (incl. browser UA) and WebFetch
thebanks.eu.next_action: Validate in a headless/real browser that clears the challenge; if consistently gated, mark for manual/approved-scraper collection.
thebanks.eu.notes: Serves Bulgaria (EMI list) and Croatia (bank profiles + ratings). Both sample URLs return 403 to automated fetchers. Content itself is valuable structured register data but access is blocked by anti-bot protection.

pbz.hr.resource_type: HTML index page linking direct PDF reports
pbz.hr.recommended_method: Fetch HTML index pages (financial-reports.html and per-year pages e.g. /en/gradjani/financial-reports/2025.html), parse hrefs under /document/documents/PBZ/financijska-izvjesca/ and download the linked PDFs. MUST send a real browser User-Agent header (default curl/bot UA gets 302->404->403). No login/cookies needed. Also crawl Investor Relations page for General Meeting PDFs and arhivadoc.pbz.hr for press releases.
pbz.hr.next_action: Automate crawl of financial-reports.html + per-year pages with browser UA; harvest PDF links for A1 corporate disclosures/A4 stats. Monitor IR page for financial calendar and General Meeting filings.
pbz.hr.notes: Croatia — Privredna banka Zagreb (Intesa Sanpaolo subsidiary). Whole site is reachable and content-rich; the ONLY obstacle is User-Agent/bot filtering that rejects default curl (returns 302->/404.html->403). With a browser UA every sample URL returns 200. Correct IR URL is /en/gradjani/nasa-grupa/Odnosi-s-investitorima.html (the sample 'Nas-svijet' path 301-redirects to it). Press releases live at archive subdomain https://arhivadoc.pbz.hr/en/priopcenja-i-novosti. Open-API page (A6) and Careers page (A5) both live (200). No JSON API for reports; content is static PDF/HTML.

bloombergtv.bg.recommended_method: Scrape the topic/tag pages (HTML, article titles/dates/links, paginated) and/or subscribe to the RSS listing at /p/rss-listing for new banking/finance articles.
bloombergtv.bg.next_action: Set up periodic scrape of the 'търговски банки' tag page and/or RSS feed; classify for A1/A4.
bloombergtv.bg.notes: Bulgaria. English/Bulgarian business news TV site. RSS available at https://www.bloombergtv.bg/p/rss-listing. Both sample URLs live.

extri.bg.recommended_method: extri.bg homepage is a thin landing page (has TLS chain issue - use curl -k / browser). The disclosure content lives on x3news.com which lists issuer disclosures via JavaScript showNews(id) calls and ?page=News / ?page=Reports; requires a browser or reverse-engineering the showNews endpoint (numeric news IDs). Recommend headless browser capture of x3news News/Reports pages.
extri.bg.error_reason: TLS: unable to verify first certificate on WebFetch; x3news content is JS-driven (javascript:showNews)
extri.bg.next_action: Use browser automation on https://www.x3news.com/?page=News to enumerate disclosures; inspect XHR behind showNews() to find a JSON/HTML endpoint for automation.
extri.bg.notes: Bulgaria. Corporate disclosure (A1) source. extri.bg has an invalid/incomplete cert chain; extri.fms.capital returns HTTP 496 (SSL cert required). Real data is at x3news.com (200).

investormediapro.bg.recommended_method: Scrape individual /event/* pages for agenda, speaker list and sponsor tiers (banks/fintechs = early-intent signals). Monitor the events listing/archive for new conference announcements.
investormediapro.bg.next_action: Enumerate the events index to find new banking/fintech conferences; scrape speaker & sponsor rosters for A5/A2 signals.
investormediapro.bg.notes: Bulgaria. Both sample event URLs (investor-finance-forum-2025, banking-today-2026) valid. Good A2 (event) and A5 (early-intent) source.

rate.economic.bg.resource_type: HTML long-form publication with embedded stats/SVG charts
rate.economic.bg.recommended_method: Scrape the yearly banks<YEAR>/ pages (banks2025, banks2026 both live) for ranking narrative and embedded figures; parse asset/market-share numbers from text. No downloadable dataset - data is inline HTML/SVG.
rate.economic.bg.next_action: Add a yearly check for new banks<YEAR>/ edition; extract bank asset/market-share figures for A4 market statistics.
rate.economic.bg.notes: Bulgaria. A4 market statistics. Data embedded as narrative + SVG, no CSV/Excel export.

sofiaglobe.com.recommended_method: Consume the WordPress RSS feed at https://sofiaglobe.com/feed/ (200, application/rss+xml) and/or a category feed (e.g. /category/business/feed/) for English coverage of Bulgarian banking legislation and corporate news.
sofiaglobe.com.next_action: Subscribe to the RSS feed (and category feed) for A1/A3 monitoring; keyword-filter for banks/regulation.
sofiaglobe.com.notes: Bulgaria. WordPress site; RSS confirmed working. Good English-language A1/A3 source.

pwc.bg.recommended_method: Homepage and publications URL return 200 to curl but PwC's WAF returns HTTP 403 to WebFetch/automated fetchers. Use a real browser session (headless with realistic headers) to scrape the publications list and download the linked Tax/Legal Alert PDFs.
pwc.bg.error_reason: 403 Forbidden to WebFetch on /en/publications.html (bot/WAF block; server also geo-tags x-client-location: GR)
pwc.bg.next_action: Retry with browser automation and standard browser headers to enumerate publications; identify direct PDF links for A1/A3 alerts.
pwc.bg.notes: Bulgaria. Content is public (no login/paywall) but protected by anti-bot WAF. High/medium priority A1/A3.

econt.com.recommended_method: Homepage and service pages return 200 but are client-side rendered (WebFetch retrieved only 'Econt' shell). Use a headless browser to render service/news pages. For the EMI/financial-services angle (A1), a more authoritative signal is the BNB register and press (e.g. Boyanov & Co / SeeNews reported the 2021 EMI licence) rather than the marketing site.
econt.com.next_action: Render econt.com news/services via browser if product-level tracking needed; otherwise track Econt Financial Services via BNB EMI register and financial press for A1.
econt.com.notes: Bulgaria. Marginal A1/A4 relevance (logistics + EMI). Site is SPA/JS-rendered.

cio.bg.recommended_method: Domain does not resolve from this environment (DNS SERVFAIL for cio.bg, ENOTFOUND for www.cio.bg) but WebSearch confirms the site is live and actively publishing. Validate reachability from a different network/DNS resolver, then scrape the digitalizacia section (and any RSS) for A2/A6 vendor/tech signals.
cio.bg.error_reason: DNS SERVFAIL (cio.bg) / getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND (www.cio.bg) from this sandbox; likely local resolver/geo issue, not a dead site
cio.bg.next_action: Re-test DNS/HTTP from a network that can resolve .bg (or via browser proxy); if reachable, mark Accessible and set up scrape of /digitalizacia/ and homepage.
cio.bg.notes: Bulgaria. A2/A6 (tech vendors/digitalization). Only blocker is DNS resolution in this environment; site itself appears healthy per search. Sample URL https://cio.bg/digitalizacia/ could not be resolved here.

bankacredins.com.recommended_method: Site was rebuilt on Webflow (assets on cdn.prod.website-files.com). For A1/A3 disclosures: scrape /reports-and-announcements and download the linked PDFs (Reg.60 transparency reports, quarterly + consolidated) directly from the Webflow CDN (HTTP 200, application/pdf, no auth). For A1 news: crawl /media-collection listing then fetch each /media/{slug} article (dates in D.M.YYYY). For A5: crawl /careers. Pages are Webflow SSR so plain HTTP GET returns readable HTML; no browser session needed. Also /branches-and-atms-collection for ATM/branch locator and /documents for T&Cs.
bankacredins.com.error_reason: 404 on legacy /lajme/ (newsroom path retired in Webflow rebuild)
bankacredins.com.next_action: Update tracker: replace dead https://bankacredins.com/lajme/ with https://www.bankacredins.com/media-collection. Set up PDF harvesting from /reports-and-announcements for periodic disclosures.
bankacredins.com.notes: Albania (Credins Bank). Domain redirects apex -> www. Full site migrated to Webflow; reports/news pages are server-rendered and fetchable without JS. Only dead sample URL is https://bankacredins.com/lajme/ (404) -> use /media-collection instead. Careers/branch pages 200 but link lists are JS-hydrated (not in static grep) though WebFetch renders them fine.

nlb-fbih.ba.resource_type: HTML index page with PDF + Excel downloads
nlb-fbih.ba.recommended_method: Scrape the izvjestaji-emitenta and godisnji-izvjestaji index pages for the dated PDF/XLSX links, then fetch each report file directly over HTTPS (static server, no JS/API needed). Also monitor /saopcenja-i-aktuelnosti/saopcenja1 (press) and /saopcenja-i-aktuelnosti/finansijski-kalendar for A3 deadlines.
nlb-fbih.ba.next_action: Enumerate individual report file URLs from the two index pages and set up periodic fetch; add finansijski-kalendar for release dates.
nlb-fbih.ba.notes: NLB Banka d.d. Sarajevo (FBiH), Bosnia. Sample URLs all reachable (homepage, /en/o-nama, /karijera, /stanovnistvo/... all 200). Corporate disclosures (A1) live under /o-nama/izvjestaji-emitenta and /o-nama/godisnji-izvjestaji rather than the sample about/services pages. Careers (A5) at /karijera. No dedicated tender page (matches sample note). ATM locator page reachable. Group-level reports also at nlbgroup.com if needed.

sparkasse.ba.resource_type: HTML index page linking PDF reports (CDN-hosted)
sparkasse.ba.recommended_method: Scrape the finanijski-izvjestaji page for the yearly PDF links (pattern https://cdn0.erstegroup.com/content/dam/ba/sba/www.sparkasse.ba/<file>.pdf?forceDownload=1) and fetch each PDF directly over HTTPS; tested one PDF = HTTP 200, application/pdf, 166KB. spending.data.al.recommended_method: Scrape the server-rendered HTML (behind Cloudflare but returns HTTP 200 to normal requests). Use per-year endpoints e.g. /en/treasury/list/year/2019 and filter path segments (/perf_id/{institution-or-supplier}, treasury branch, institution dropdown). Suppliers index at /en/treasury/suppliers. No public JSON API or CSV export button was found; collect via paginated table scraping. Language toggle en/sq via /en or /sq path prefix.
spending.data.al.next_action: Build an HTML scraper iterating year ranges (2012-13, 2014, 2015-18, 2019-26) and institution/supplier filters; optionally email AIS (contact on site) to ask about bulk/API access
spending.data.al.notes: Serves Albania (workstream A2 tenders/procurement/treasury spending). All 4 sample URLs live. Server-rendered tables make scraping straightforward; no dead URLs. No official downloadable file or documented API surfaced.

ecepp.ebrd.com.recommended_method: Scrape noticeSearchResults.html with a browser-like User-Agent header (mandatory - default curl UA gets nginx 403). Individual notices are public at /delta/viewNotice.html?displayNoticeId={id}. Filter by country to isolate Albania/Bosnia. Also cross-check the human-friendly aggregate list at https://www.ebrd.com/home/work-with-us/project-procurement/procurement-notices.html . Login+MFA only required to submit responses, not to read notices.
ecepp.ebrd.com.error_reason: blocked (nginx HTTP 403 when no/!default User-Agent; resolves to 200 with a normal browser UA)
ecepp.ebrd.com.next_action: Automate collection of noticeSearchResults.html + viewNotice.html?displayNoticeId= pages with a spoofed browser UA, filtered by country=Albania and Bosnia; consider parsing the ebrd.com procurement-notices listing as a secondary feed
ecepp.ebrd.com.notes: Serves Albania and Bosnia (workstreams A1 disclosures, A2 procurement, A3 regulation). viewNotices.html is a login page but the public search (noticeSearchResults.html) and per-notice pages are readable unauthenticated. Key gotcha: a valid User-Agent header is required or nginx returns 403.

uba.com.al.resource_type: HTML page + PDF downloads (also WordPress REST JSON API and RSS feed)
uba.com.al.recommended_method: Scrape /downloads/annual-reports/ and /downloads/financial-statements/ for PDF hrefs (wp-content/uploads paths; older ones on new.uba.com.al mirror) and fetch PDFs directly. Poll /careers/job-openings/ and /careers/internship/ (job posts under /blog/jobs/) plus /latest-news/ for A5/A3. WP REST API at /wp-json/wp/v2/posts and RSS at /feed/ available for news/jobs. Must send a browser User-Agent header.

api.params: per_page, page, categories (standard WP REST params); useful for Latest News/blog and job posts (jobs live under /blog/jobs/)
api.headers: User-Agent required (default WebFetch/curl UA gets 403; a normal browser UA returns 200)

uba.com.al.next_action: Set up scheduled scraper with browser UA; enumerate PDF links from the two downloads pages and job posts under /blog/jobs/. Also cover Albanian-language mirror paths /sq/ (e.g. /sq/karriera/vende-pune/).
uba.com.al.notes: Serves Albania. Site requires a real browser User-Agent (default bot UAs get HTTP 403 from server/WAF, but content is otherwise fully open). Bilingual (English + Albanian /sq/). Older PDFs (2014-2019) hosted on new.uba.com.al mirror, newer ones on uba.com.al/wp-content/uploads. No dead sample URLs — all six worked with browser UA.

wbif.eu.resource_type: HTML page / dashboard (projects database + procurements listing)
wbif.eu.recommended_method: Site is behind Cloudflare 'challenge' bot protection (cf-mitigated: challenge, JS/Turnstile). All plain HTTP GETs (curl, WebFetch) return HTTP 403 regardless of User-Agent, including the homepage and sitemap.xml. Collect via a real headless browser (e.g. Playwright/Puppeteer with stealth, or the Chrome MCP browser) that executes the Cloudflare JS challenge and holds cf_clearance cookies, then read the procurements/projects tables and any export links from the rendered DOM. No public JSON/CSV API discovered.
wbif.eu.error_reason: HTTP 403 (Cloudflare bot challenge: 'cf-mitigated: challenge', server: cloudflare) on all URLs incl. homepage and sitemap.xml
wbif.eu.next_action: Use a Cloudflare-challenge-capable headless browser session to render https://www.wbif.eu/procurements and https://www.wbif.eu/wbif-projects, capture the table data and inspect XHR/network for any internal JSON endpoint once past the challenge. Fall back to periodic browser-based scraping.
wbif.eu.notes: Serves Albania and Bosnia (and wider Western Balkans). Not irrelevant — highly relevant tenders/projects source — but blocked from headless reproduction by Cloudflare challenge. None of the sample URLs are dead per se; they are all reachable in a normal browser but return 403 to automated fetchers.

moj-bankar.hr.recommended_method: Static HTML scraping of /vijesti and article pages; sitemap at https://www.moj-bankar.hr/sitemap.xml (HTTP 200) can seed URL discovery for A1/A5 monitoring.
moj-bankar.hr.next_action: Scrape /vijesti listing + sitemap for new bank-ranking / product articles.
moj-bankar.hr.notes: Croatia. Both sample URLs return HTTP 200. No RSS feed found; use sitemap.xml instead.

hamagbicro.hr.recommended_method: Collect via a real browser / headless Chrome with realistic headers; site is publicly readable in-browser but blocks scripted clients. Target pages: /otvoreni-natjecaji/ (A2 tenders), /vijesti/ (A5 news), /o-nama/uprava/ (management).
hamagbicro.hr.error_reason: HTTP 403 Forbidden (bot protection) on both curl and WebFetch, even with browser User-Agent
hamagbicro.hr.next_action: Use browser-based collection (claude-in-chrome / headless) to reach otvoreni-natjecaji and news; verify no full-JS gate once past the 403.
hamagbicro.hr.notes: Croatia. State agency. Server returns 403 to non-browser clients (WAF/bot protection); pages exist and are indexed. Correct tenders page is /otvoreni-natjecaji/ (sample only linked homepage + uprava).

n1info.hr.recommended_method: Poll RSS feed https://n1info.hr/feed/ (HTTP 200) and scrape /biznis/ listing for banking/ATM/business coverage (A1/A2).
n1info.hr.next_action: Set up RSS polling + keyword filter (banke, ATM, bankomat, platni promet); WordPress feed likely supports category feeds (e.g. /biznis/feed/).
n1info.hr.notes: Croatia. WordPress-based news site; both sample URLs 200. RSS available.

akd-zastita.hr.recommended_method: Static HTML scraping of service/news pages; low-frequency change so periodic full-site crawl is sufficient (A2/A4 vendor/market intel).
akd-zastita.hr.next_action: Crawl service pages and any news/press section for cash-handling contracts/capacity signals.
akd-zastita.hr.notes: Croatia. Corporate site, static HTML. Both sample URLs reachable. Mostly qualitative vendor info, limited structured data.

combis.talentlyft.com.recommended_method: Fetch /jobs and regex/parse the window.initialData object to enumerate current job IDs + locations (no browser needed for the list). For full job descriptions, either render with headless Chrome or replicate the dynamicLoader getJob fetch. Currently 1 open role (id 179632, Zagreb).

api.params: job objects carry id (e.g. 179632), filterLocations (e.g. Zagreb|HR); details fetched by dynamicLoader getJob using page id/websiteId

combis.talentlyft.com.next_action: Parse window.initialData for job list; add headless render for descriptions if needed (A5 hiring signal / A6 vendor).
combis.talentlyft.com.notes: Croatia. TalentLyft-hosted ATS. Job list IS available server-side in window.initialData (parseable via plain HTTP); only per-job detail is JS-loaded. reCAPTCHA present only on application form.

mmpi.gov.hr.recommended_method: Static HTML scraping of the specific procurement/postal-services pages; for structured national tenders cross-reference EOJN (eojn.nn.hr) rather than this CMS. Suitable for A2/A4 targeted monitoring.
mmpi.gov.hr.next_action: Monitor the named postal-services procurement page; for full tender data use national procurement portal EOJN.
mmpi.gov.hr.notes: Croatia. Gov CMS (gov.hr platform), static content on deep links. Both sample URLs 200.

mer-banking.hr.recommended_method: Poll RSS feed https://mer-banking.hr/feed/ (HTTP 200, WordPress) and scrape /blog/ articles for payments/fintech regulation commentary (A3/A4).
mer-banking.hr.next_action: RSS polling + keyword filter for platne usluge / fintech / regulativa.
mer-banking.hr.notes: Croatia. WordPress blog; both sample URLs 200; RSS available. Opinion/commentary source, low structured-data value.

reports.hanfa.hr.recommended_method: For A3/A4/A6 collect from public www.hanfa.hr/publikacije/ (reports + statistics, PDF/Excel). For reporting deadlines use public https://reports.hanfa.hr/DOF/Calendar (HTTP 200, no login). The reports.hanfa.hr submission app itself requires registered-user login (Pristupnica + qualified e-signature) and cannot/should not be automated.
reports.hanfa.hr.error_reason: reports.hanfa.hr root is a login gate (Prijava/Registracija) for registered reporting obligors only
reports.hanfa.hr.next_action: Point collector at www.hanfa.hr/publikacije/ for reports/statistics and reports.hanfa.hr/DOF/Calendar for reporting deadlines; do not attempt to log in to the submission portal.
reports.hanfa.hr.notes: Croatia. reports.hanfa.hr = e-reporting submission system (login/e-signature required, out of scope for scraping). Public reporting Calendar and rich statistics/publications live on the main hanfa.hr domain.

epbih.ba.recommended_method: Scrape the HTML listing (organizational-unit dropdown filters: Direkcija HE na Neretvi, TE Tuzla, TE Kakanj, ED Bihac/Mostar/Sarajevo/Tuzla/Zenica/Travnik) and follow each notice's PDF links (Obavjestenje o nabavci / Odluka o izboru).
epbih.ba.next_action: Build HTML scraper for the notice list + PDF harvesting; note company-level procurement, not the national EJN portal.
epbih.ba.notes: Bosnia (A2). Company-level tender notices for the FBiH electric utility. Static server-rendered HTML, no pagination controls observed.

open.ejn.gov.ba.recommended_method: Consume the OData API directly: page through each entity set with $top/$skip, filter by date via $filter, no auth/cookies needed; reproducible with plain HTTP. Load entity list from swagger.json.

api.params: OData query params: $filter, $select, $orderby, $skip, $top, plus ietfTag (language, default bs-latn-ba). ~40+ entity sets incl. AnnouncementProcedureNotices, AnnouncementDecisions, AnnualMasterAgreementAwardNotices, AnnouncementProcurementPlans.

open.ejn.gov.ba.next_action: Enumerate entity sets from swagger.json and schedule incremental $filter-by-date pulls; this is the primary machine-readable BiH tender source.
open.ejn.gov.ba.notes: Bosnia (A2), critical. First-in-region real-time open procurement data (OCDS-aligned). API base is the host root (not under /docs). Highest-value source in this batch.

next.ejn.gov.ba.recommended_method: For UI/announcement browsing use next.ejn.gov.ba; for automated collection use the open.ejn.gov.ba OData API it links to. Announcement search UI at next.ejn.gov.ba likely also backed by an XHR/OData endpoint if per-tender detail is needed.

api.endpoint: Delegates to https://open.ejn.gov.ba (OData API, see open.ejn.gov.ba entry)
api.params: see open.ejn.gov.ba

next.ejn.gov.ba.next_action: Use the open.ejn.gov.ba API as the collection backend; optionally inspect next.ejn XHR calls for detail pages if needed.
next.ejn.gov.ba.notes: Bosnia (A2), critical. This is the human-facing portal; the machine source is open.ejn.gov.ba.

docs.ejn.gov.ba.recommended_method: Do not crawl the root (returns 403). Resolve individual document URLs from IDs/links contained in the open.ejn.gov.ba API responses and next.ejn detail pages, then fetch each document directly.
docs.ejn.gov.ba.error_reason: HTTP 403 on root and /index.html (directory listing forbidden; IIS)
docs.ejn.gov.ba.next_action: Extract document identifiers from the EJN API/notice pages and validate one full document URL to confirm the pattern.
docs.ejn.gov.ba.notes: Bosnia (A1). Document CDN for EJN; only reachable via specific document links, not a directory. Blocked = expected 403 on listing, not a real outage.

aml-cft.msb.gov.ba.recommended_method: Scrape the Dokumenti (PDF) section for guidelines/risk assessments and monitor news for deadlines; for designated-persons/targeted financial sanctions use the CONSO search at consosearch.msb.gov.ba (likely has its own query endpoint to inspect).
aml-cft.msb.gov.ba.next_action: Enumerate the Dokumenti PDF list; separately inspect consosearch.msb.gov.ba for a searchable sanctions API/export.
aml-cft.msb.gov.ba.notes: Bosnia (A3). Regulation/deadlines source. Sanctions data lives on companion host consosearch.msb.gov.ba.

sipa.gov.ba.recommended_method: Scrape the SIPA site for FID publications/annual reports and news (multi-language: Bosanski/Srpski/Hrvatski/English). The linked sample page is a static org description; locate the reports/news section via site navigation for actual documents.
sipa.gov.ba.next_action: Crawl site navigation to find the FID/FIU publications and annual-report pages; confirm English mirror.
sipa.gov.ba.notes: Bosnia (A3). National FIU (Egmont). Sample page is descriptive only; data resource = the agency's reports/news sections to be located via nav.

e-register.fsc.bg.recommended_method: Use the FSC public register at eis.fsc.bg (Public register 501 = public companies & other securities issuers; verified HTTP 200) as the collection surface for issuer disclosures; e-register.fsc.bg itself is the signed-in submission portal. English registers index at fsc.bg/en/registers-and-checks.
e-register.fsc.bg.error_reason: DNS: e-register.fsc.bg could not be resolved from this environment (host fsc.bg resolves fine, subdomain did not)
e-register.fsc.bg.next_action: From a network that resolves e-register.fsc.bg, test the disclosure query UI; meanwhile collect issuer disclosures via eis.fsc.bg public register (inspect its XHR endpoints).
e-register.fsc.bg.notes: Bulgaria (A5). Subdomain DNS-unresolvable here (likely geo/DNS, not permanently dead). Public disclosures reachable via eis.fsc.bg. Portal proper needs e-signature login (do not bypass).

kbc.com.recommended_method: Scrape the IR reports/presentations sections for quarterly & annual PDFs and the Excel 'Table of results'; monitor the press-release archive and financial calendar. Relevant to Bulgaria via KBC's ownership of UBB and DZI (group-level disclosures).
kbc.com.next_action: Harvest the reports & presentations archive; map which group filings mention UBB/DZI Bulgaria for A1.
kbc.com.notes: Listed under Bulgaria (A1) but kbc.com is the Belgian KBC Group corporate site; relevance is via its Bulgarian subsidiaries (UBB, DZI). Static, downloadable-heavy IR site.

eumis2020.government.bg.recommended_method: Use the public search UI (eumis2020.government.bg/en/s/...) which is a JS front-end — inspect its XHR/JSON endpoints for programmatic project/contract queries; complement with the 2020.eufunds.bg public reporting portal. Both returned HTTP 200 incl. English (/en).
eumis2020.government.bg.next_action: Open the public search in a browser to capture the backing XHR/JSON API for procurement/EU-funded contract data (A2).
eumis2020.government.bg.notes: Bulgaria (A2). JS/dashboard front-end; needs network-tab inspection to find the query API. Public data available without login.

sofia.bg.recommended_method: Send a browser User-Agent (BigIP WAF blocks default/empty UA with 403). Page is a Liferay/Clay React app rendering the buyer-profile table client-side — inspect Liferay portlet resource URLs (p_p_resource / API) in the browser network tab for the JSON feed, or render via headless browser to scrape the notices table.
sofia.bg.error_reason: HTTP 403 (BigIP WAF) with default UA; content is JS-rendered (Liferay/@clayui React portlet)
sofia.bg.next_action: Use a headless browser (browser tools) to load the page, capture the Liferay resource/XHR request that returns the buyer-profile notices, then reproduce it with the browser UA.
sofia.bg.notes: Bulgaria (A2). Sofia Municipality buyer profile. Two blockers: BigIP UA filtering (solvable with UA header) and JS/Liferay rendering (needs browser or portlet endpoint).

bifidex.com.recommended_method: Interactive JS portal with per-entity search; free basic searches, financial/analytic services behind login+subscription. Automate via authenticated session/browser; check for internal XHR/JSON endpoints behind the search UI. Consider national source (APR-RS/BiH registries, or CBBH) for BiH-specific data.
bifidex.com.error_reason: DNS: host www.bifidex.com not resolvable from collector sandbox (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND) - domain is live per public sources; also subscription-gated data
bifidex.com.next_action: Validate from a network that resolves the host using a browser session; inspect network tab for search API endpoints; evaluate subscription need for BiH financial data
bifidex.com.notes: Serves Bosnia (Republika Srpska registry, plus Serbia/N.Macedonia/Albania/Montenegro). Commercial subscription aggregator, free basic search. Sample URL /sr-latn/registries not reachable from sandbox (DNS) - canonical is /en/registries.

abanks.bg.recommended_method: Poll https://abanksb.bg/en/bulletin/ for new quarterly issues; direct PDFs follow predictable pattern https://abanksb.bg/bulletin/{n}-en.pdf (EN) and /bulletin/{n}.pdf (BG). Scrape member lists at /en/full-members/ and /en/associated-members/, press at /en/category/press-en/.
abanks.bg.next_action: Set up recurring fetch of latest bulletin PDF and member-list pages on abanksb.bg
abanks.bg.notes: Bulgaria. Tracker domain 'abanks.bg' does not resolve; correct/current domain is abanksb.bg (Association of Banks in Bulgaria). 84 bulletin issues archived 2007-2026. Direct PDF pattern verified.

careers.unicreditbulbank.bg.recommended_method: Public ATS careers portal; jobs removed once filled. Automate via headless browser or inspect the ATS JSON/XHR search endpoint (portal exposes /public/help path, suggesting a hosted ATS - likely Lumesse/SAP TalentLink family). Cross-check with jobs.bg company page (jobs.bg/en/company/unicreditbulbank/jobs) as an alternate structured source.
careers.unicreditbulbank.bg.error_reason: DNS: careers.unicreditbulbank.bg not resolvable from sandbox (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND); parent unicreditbulbank.bg resolves - live per public sources
careers.unicreditbulbank.bg.next_action: Open portal in browser from a resolving network; capture the job-search XHR/API endpoint and response format; confirm ATS vendor
careers.unicreditbulbank.bg.notes: Bulgaria (A3/early-intent hiring). Portal is real; unreachable from collector sandbox due to DNS. Alternate structured feed: JOBS.BG company profile.

b-trust.bg.recommended_method: Scrape /en sections (services, queries, client-center) and monitor parent borica.bg/en/latest for news/press. Follow document links (accessibility declaration, system requirements, required documents) for PDFs. Portal at my.b-trust.bg is login-gated (skip).
b-trust.bg.next_action: Enumerate the document/queries pages for direct PDF links; add borica.bg/en/latest to the news watch
b-trust.bg.notes: Bulgaria (A1). Corporate disclosures/news are thin on B-Trust itself; the parent BORICA site carries press. my.b-trust.bg requires login.

mfi.bg.recommended_method: Scrape /en/news-mfi/ for disclosures/news and the documents section for financial-report/tariff PDFs. Bulgarian-language pages under /bg/ likely have fuller disclosures. Static HTML, no JS needed.
mfi.bg.next_action: Enumerate document/disclosure section for direct PDF links; add /en/news-mfi/ to news watch
mfi.bg.notes: Bulgaria (A1). Subsidiary of Bulgarian Development Bank. Site labels vary (MFI/BBR/BDB Microfinance).

lei.csd-bg.bg.recommended_method: This CSD site is only an LEI-application hub (email lei@csd-bg.bg) with no public lookup/bulk data. For Bulgarian LEI records, use GLEIF: api.gleif.org/api/v1/lei-records?filter[entity.legalAddress.country]=BG (JSON REST, no auth) or GLEIF golden-copy CSV/XML bulk download. Use lei.csd-bg.bg only to monitor CSD LEI terms/news.
lei.csd-bg.bg.next_action: Switch LEI data collection to GLEIF API/golden copy; keep CSD page for terms/announcements only
lei.csd-bg.bg.notes: Bulgaria (A1). No public register or downloads on CSD site itself - authoritative LEI data lives at GLEIF.

company-informer.com.recommended_method: Free tier: company name quick-search and NACE-sector/size filtering usable for discovery. Paid credit/financial reports need login+payment (no public API advertised). For automation use free basic reports; escalate to commercial account for financials. Authoritative alternative for BG filings: Bulgarian Commercial Register (portal.registryagency.bg).
company-informer.com.next_action: Decide whether free basic reports suffice; otherwise evaluate paid account or use Commercial Register as primary
company-informer.com.notes: Bulgaria (A1). Commercial third-party aggregator; deeper financials paywalled. Consider official Bulgarian Commercial Register as primary source.

crunchbase.com.recommended_method: Public pages return HTTP 403 to non-browser clients (Cloudflare/bot protection). Do not scrape. Use the official Crunchbase v4 REST API with a paid user_key, or capture data via an authenticated browser session for the specific org permalinks. No unauthenticated reproduction possible.

api.params: field_ids, card_ids; user_key (API key) required

crunchbase.com.error_reason: HTTP 403 - bot protection on public HTML (both default and browser UA)
crunchbase.com.next_action: Provision a Crunchbase API key or use browser-session extraction for the listed org profiles
crunchbase.com.notes: Bulgaria fintech profiles (A1). Global site; blocked to scrapers. Requires paid API or manual/browser access.

bgtrader.elana.net.resource_type: HTML page + PDF research reports (login-gated) + newsletters
bgtrader.elana.net.recommended_method: Public research index at bgtrader.elana.net/en/research/ and analysis.elana.net lists report titles/dates (usable for headline/metadata tracking). bgtrader.elana.net.next_action: Scrape public research listing metadata; obtain ELANA Online demo login if full report bodies are needed
bgtrader.elana.net.notes: Bulgaria (A1). Report list public; full content behind broker portal login. Related endpoints: analysis.elana.net, online.elana.net, newsletter.elana.net.

fintechnews.sg.recommended_method: WordPress site. Track new items via RSS: https://fintechnews.sg/feed/ (site-wide, HTTP 200 application/rss+xml verified) and category feed https://fintechnews.sg/category/payments/feed/. Also WP REST API https://fintechnews.sg/wp-json/wp/v2/posts is typically available for structured pulls. Keyword-filter for Balkans/BORICA/EU-payments topics.
fintechnews.sg.next_action: Subscribe to RSS/category feed and filter for SEE/Balkans payments coverage; optionally use wp-json REST API
fintechnews.sg.notes: Bulgaria-relevant coverage (A2) though site is Singapore-based general fintech press. RSS + likely WP REST API make automation easy.

lova.ba.recommended_method: Scrape /blog (news/press) for corporate disclosures (A1) and /karijere for job postings (A5). Bosnian + English via language toggle. No PDFs/reports; monitor blog and careers HTML pages.
lova.ba.next_action: Set up periodic scrape of https://www.lova.ba/blog and https://www.lova.ba/karijere
lova.ba.notes: Bosnia (Republika Srpska). Licensed e-money issuer by ABRS. Static HTML, no open data. Key pages: /o-nama, /blog, /karijere, /faq, support.lova.ba

mi-bospo.org.recommended_method: Scrape /vijesti (news, A1) and /zaposlenje (jobs, A5). Harvest PDF reports (auditor report, sustainability report, general business conditions, price list) linked from site. Bosnian + English.
mi-bospo.org.next_action: Locate the reports/publications section page to enumerate direct PDF URLs; scrape /vijesti and /zaposlenje
mi-bospo.org.notes: Bosnia (Tuzla). Microcredit foundation. PDFs present (Independent Auditor's Report 2025, Sustainability Report 2025). Static HTML.

nlbgroup.com.recommended_method: Scrape the financial-reports listing page for direct download links; PDFs and Excel 'Key Financial Data' files served under /content/dam/nlb/nlb-group/documents/investor-relations/financial-reports/[YEAR]/[PERIOD]/. English IR hub, well-structured, no auth.
nlbgroup.com.next_action: Enumerate download links per year/period; capture XLSX key financial data for A4 market stats
nlbgroup.com.notes: Bosnia (NLB has BiH subsidiaries; this is parent group Slovenia IR, relevant for group-level A1/A4). Direct PDF/XLSX downloads, no JS needed.

pwc.ba.recommended_method: Scrape https://www.pwc.ba/en/publications.html with a real browser User-Agent (site is behind Akamai bot protection - WebFetch returned 403 but curl with Mozilla UA returns 200). Follow sub-pages: /en/publications/nextgen-survey.html, /en/publications/CFO-Compass-Survey-third-edition.html, /en/publications/newsletter.html.
pwc.ba.error_reason: WebFetch 403 (Akamai bot protection); curl with browser UA succeeds (200)
pwc.ba.next_action: Automated collector must send browser User-Agent header to avoid Akamai 403
pwc.ba.notes: Bosnia. PwC firm site. Requires browser UA header. Publications are HTML pages linking to survey PDFs (A1). Bilingual EN/BS.

rvp.ba.recommended_method: Scrape server-rendered HTML table at /ListaEmitenata (46 pages, paginated). Each issuer links to detail page /Papir?papir=<CODE> (e.g. /Papir?papir=AAIS). No official API/export; parse HTML. IIS/ASP.NET site, no auth, no JS needed for the listing.
rvp.ba.next_action: Iterate pagination on /ListaEmitenata and parse /Papir?papir=<CODE> detail pages for A1 corporate disclosures / A3 regulatory data
rvp.ba.notes: Bosnia (FBiH central securities register). Data is in the HTML (not JS-only). Language switch links use javascript: but content is server-rendered. No export button/API found.

srna.rs.next_action: Scrape paginated economy category; check for RSS feed; capture A1 (corporate/press) and A5 (early-intent) signals
srna.rs.notes: Bosnia (Republika Srpska news agency). Server-rendered HTML news. No RSS visible on category page but likely exists; content in Serbian.

bank.ba.recommended_method: Scrape job listings page for bank-sector vacancies (A5 jobs/early-intent, A1 institution signals). Filter by institution/city. Bosnian only. Individual ads at /posao/<id> pattern.
bank.ba.next_action: Periodically scrape oglasi-za-posao.php; capture individual ad pages /posao/<id>
bank.ba.notes: Bosnia. Aggregator job board for banks/MFIs/leasing/insurance. Low posting volume (ads submitted via email to info@bank.ba). Static HTML.

bizreg.ba.recommended_method: Use CompaniesList search (Latin script required) for company registration data (A3/A6). Open Data page offers a weekly-generated XML dump but the download control is a JS-triggered placeholder link (href='#') and covers only QSS-project courts - resolve the actual XML URL via browser/network inspection before automating. IIS/ASP.NET portal; search likely form-POST with anti-forgery token.

bankofalbania.org.resource_type: statistics portal (server-rendered HTML tables) + HTML registers + PDF reports
bankofalbania.org.recommended_method: Direct HTTP GET scraping with a normal browser User-Agent header (the site 403s the default WebFetch UA but returns 200 to curl/browser UAs). For market statistics (A4): iterate the Time_series parameterized endpoint over cregtab_id/periudha_id values and parse the returned HTML tables. For registers (A1 - licensed banks / payment institutions / e-money): scrape the static HTML register pages under /Mbikeqyrja/Subjekte_te_licencuara/. For reports (A3) and press releases: fetch HTML pages and download linked /rc/doc/*.pdf files directly. English mirror paths exist under /Statistics/, /Supervision/, /Payments/, /Publications/ alongside the Albanian /Statistikat/, /Mbikeqyrja/, /Pagesat/, /Botime/ paths.

api.params: evb=agregate; evn=agregate_detaje; cregtab_id (numeric table id, e.g. 431,434,435,702...); periudha_id (period id, e.g. 1 or 3). Optional crd/uni/ln session-style tokens appear in on-page form but are NOT required — direct cregtab_id URL returns the data.
api.format: HTML table (data rendered as <td> cells; ~51 cells in tested response)
api.headers: Standard browser/curl User-Agent required. NOTE: the default WebFetch user-agent is blocked with HTTP 403; a normal UA (curl default, or a browser UA) returns HTTP 200.
api.auth_needed: No (no login/cookies needed for the tested cregtab_id URL)

download.type: PDF (registers/reports served under /rc/doc/*.pdf; also statistics calendar PDF /rc/doc/2019_Statistics_Calendar_English_13543.pdf)

bankofalbania.org.next_action: Build collectors: (1) enumerate cregtab_id list from the Time_series index page and pull each aggregate_detaje table; (2) parse the licensed-entity register HTML pages; (3) harvest /rc/doc/*.pdf for the Annual Supervision Report and press releases. Set a browser User-Agent to avoid the 403 seen with WebFetch's default UA.
bankofalbania.org.notes: Serves Albania (central bank). All 15 sample URLs returned HTTP 200 and are current - no dead links. Bilingual site (Albanian /Statistikat,/Mbikeqyrja,/Pagesat,/Botime and English /Statistics,/Supervision,/Payments,/Publications). Key gotcha for automation: default WebFetch user-agent is blocked (403); curl/browser UAs get 200. Time series has no visible one-click Excel/CSV export - data comes as HTML tables via the cregtab_id/periudha_id GET parameters, which acts as a de-facto read API. PDF reports/registers downloadable under /rc/doc/.

api.params: keywords, location (e.g. Croatia), geoId, f_TPR (time posted e.g. r86400), f_C (company id), start (offset, +25 per page); paginate by incrementing start until empty
api.format: HTML fragments (job cards with data-entity-urn urn:li:jobPosting:<id>, title, company, hr.linkedin.com/jobs/view/ links)
