posao.hr.recommended_method: Primary: pull https://www.posao.hr/rss/ (valid RSS 2.0 XML) for fresh postings. Secondary: HTTP GET + HTML scrape of keyword search pages (e.g. /trazeni-izraz/banka/) and employer profile pages (/profil/{slug}/{id}/). Listings render server-side in HTML; behind Cloudflare but plain curl with a browser UA returns 200 - no JS needed.
posao.hr.next_action: Poll RSS feed for early-intent hiring signals; scrape 'banka'/payments keyword searches and target employer profiles (e.g. Intesa Sanpaolo Card) for A5
posao.hr.notes: Croatia job portal. Cloudflare-fronted but reachable with browser User-Agent; RSS feed is the cleanest collection path. All 3 sample URLs live.

online.selekcija.hr.recommended_method: Requires a real browser session (headless Chrome/Playwright). The online.selekcija.hr host returns HTTP 403 to curl/WebFetch even with a desktop browser User-Agent (Cloudflare bot protection). Career pages are likely JS-rendered ATS listings; inspect XHR/fetch calls in a browser to find a JSON job-listing endpoint, otherwise render the page and scrape the DOM.
online.selekcija.hr.error_reason: HTTP 403 (Cloudflare bot protection) on all requests to online.selekcija.hr, including with a desktop browser User-Agent
online.selekcija.hr.next_action: Validate via headless browser: load careers/otpbanka and careers/fina, capture network XHR for a jobs JSON API; if none, DOM-scrape rendered listings
online.selekcija.hr.notes: Croatia - Selekcija.hr ATS hosting bank/institution career pages (OTP banka, FINA). Blocked by Cloudflare to non-browser clients; JS-rendered. Sample career URLs return 403 to curl/WebFetch (not truly dead - bot-blocked).

oradian.com.recommended_method: HTTP GET + HTML scrape of https://oradian.com/careers for the 'Open roles' block. Note: at time of check no roles are listed (only a 'send your story to careers@oradian.com' fallback) and no external ATS (Greenhouse/Lever/Workable) is embedded. The about/team page describes the company (bankers/engineers/operators across Manila, Lagos, Zagreb) but lists no named individuals. Monitor careers page HTML periodically for open roles appearing; supplement with LinkedIn for team/leadership (A6).
oradian.com.next_action: Schedule periodic scrape of /careers to catch newly posted roles; use LinkedIn/Crunchbase for A6 vendor/competitor and leadership intel
oradian.com.notes: Croatia (Zagreb HQ) core-banking SaaS vendor. Static HTML site, no ATS and no live job listings at check time; team page has no individual names. Low real-time data yield; useful mainly as a vendor/competitor (A6) reference and for occasional job signals. /about-oradian/careers/ redirects (301) to /careers.

hnb.hr.resource_type: statistics portal (Liferay) with Excel/CSV/PDF downloads + JSON REST API + register
hnb.hr.recommended_method: Server-side HTTP scraping: fetch each landing page (curl returns full static HTML with /documents/ links despite Liferay), extract current-period /documents/20182/... file URLs, and download the xlsx/csv/pdf directly (Content-Disposition gives filenames). Poll press-release hub and publication pages for new releases each period. Use api.hnb.hr/tecajn-eur/v3 JSON for FX. No auth, no JS, no cookies needed.

api.endpoint: https://api.hnb.hr/tecajn-eur/v3 (exchange-rate list; also api.hnb.hr mirrors the site content). Data files served from Liferay document store at https://www.hnb.hr/documents/20182/{id}/{filename}
api.params: tecajn-eur/v3 optional filters e.g. datum-primjene, valuta; returns full daily rate list

hnb.hr.next_action: Build per-page link extractors keyed to the Liferay /documents/20182/ pattern for each workstream section; schedule periodic re-scrape since document UUIDs/filenames change per reporting period.
hnb.hr.notes: All 15 sample URLs return HTTP 200 and are valid. Excel time-series (supervisory indicators) and CSV register download and tested OK; publications are PDF; press releases are an HTML hub. Public unauthenticated JSON REST API confirmed at api.hnb.hr (FX rates). No /en/rss feed (404) — monitor HTML hubs instead. WebFetch's markdown conversion drops the document links but curl retrieves them in static HTML, so plain HTTP collection works (js_used=false). No dead sample URLs. Serves Croatia.
hnb.hr.worked_example: GET https://api.hnb.hr/tecajn-eur/v3?valuta=USD (Croatian NB reference rates JSON, no auth).

ekapija.com.recommended_method: Collect via a headless/real browser that solves the Cloudflare JS bot challenge (curl and WebFetch both return HTTP 403). After the challenge, tender listings are plain server-rendered HTML (data embedded in page, not an XHR/JSON API) and can be parsed and paginated (~124 pages). Use the B&H territory filter for Bosnia scope. No login needed for public listings; login only required to post tenders.
ekapija.com.error_reason: HTTP 403 (Cloudflare bot protection) on curl -sSIL and on WebFetch; interstitial 'verifying you are not a bot' JS challenge
ekapija.com.next_action: Set up a browser-based collector (Playwright/Puppeteer with Cloudflare challenge handling) targeting /en/tender and /tender search with B&H territory filter; parse HTML rows for tender title + procuring entity + location + dates
ekapija.com.notes: Regional business/procurement portal (Serbia/B&H/Montenegro/Kosovo); serves Bosnia via 'B&H' territory filter. Content confirmed relevant and reachable through a browser, but NOT reproducible with plain HTTP due to Cloudflare. Sample URLs all live but Cloudflare-gated to non-browser clients. EN and local (bs) versions exist (/en/ and /bs/).

paragraf.ba.recommended_method: Plain HTTP GET + HTML parsing (Apache server, HTTP 200, static server-rendered pages, no JS or auth needed). Crawl /propisi/<jurisdiction>/<slug>.html for legal texts, and registar-sluzbenih-glasila.html plus arhiva-sluzbenih-novina-fbih.html for gazette issue links. Content served inline as HTML; poll the register / 'Alarm za glasila' section for new gazette issues.
paragraf.ba.next_action: Build an HTTP+HTML-parse collector; map the /propisi/ URL scheme (republika-srpska, bih, fbih) for payments/e-money/procurement laws and the gazette register/archive pages for new-issue monitoring (A3 regulation/deadlines, A2 procurement)
paragraf.ba.notes: Bosnia (BiH) legal/regulatory aggregator (Paragraf Lex BA). Covers payments & e-money laws, Zakon o javnim nabavkama, and official gazettes for all BiH jurisdictions. All 6 sample URLs reachable (HTTP 200). Legal texts and gazette register are inline HTML; individual gazette issues open as internal pages rather than direct PDF downloads. Has an 'Alarm za glasila' subscription notifier.

hbor.hr.recommended_method: For A1 corporate disclosures: scrape the financial statements download hub (https://www.hbor.hr/naslovnica/hbor/financijska-izvjesca-pregled-preuzimanje/) and the financial plans page for PDF/DOCX links; a fixed publication calendar exists (Q1 by 31 May, H1 by 31 Aug, 9M by 30 Nov, annual by 30 Apr) so poll around those dates. English equivalent at /financial-performance/322. For A3/A5 news: scrape /category/obavijesti (news/priopcenja) and /otvoreni-natjecaji (open calls). For A2 tenders/procurement: HBOR's own /javna-nabava/132 only holds rules + archive; active tenders are published on Croatia's national e-procurement portal EOJN (https://eojn.nn.hr/Oglasnik/) — collect HBOR tenders there by contracting authority.
hbor.hr.next_action: Build scraper for the financial statements download hub + news/open-calls listing pages; add EOJN portal as the tender source for HBOR as contracting authority
hbor.hr.notes: Croatia — Croatian Bank for Reconstruction & Development (national development bank). Fully reachable. Financial statements archive 2017–2026 in PDF+DOCX. /en/about-us/ 301-redirects (trailing slash removed) but resolves fine — not a dead URL. Document links on the download hub are injected dynamically so a JS-capable fetch or the underlying listing endpoint may be needed to enumerate exact file URLs; page itself is server-rendered HTML.

nexi.hr.recommended_method: Plain HTML scrape of the bilingual page set: /en/about-us/overview/ (and /hr/), /en/company-data/, /en/merchants-solutions/overview/ and /card-acceptance/acquiring-agreements/, /en/banks-and-financial-institutions/acquiring/atm-solutions/. Static server-rendered HTML, no JS or API needed. Use these for A1 (company profile/management), A6 (vendor/competitor product & acquiring/ATM offering). Note: Nexi Croatia d.o.o. does NOT publish financial statements or annual reports on this site — for A1 financial disclosures collect them from the Croatian court/company registry (sudreg.pravosudje.hr) or FINA rgfi by OIB, not from nexi.hr.
nexi.hr.next_action: Scrape the static bilingual corporate page set for A1/A6 intel; add sudreg/FINA registry lookup by OIB as the source for Nexi Croatia financial statements
nexi.hr.notes: Croatia — Nexi Croatia d.o.o. (merchant acquiring/POS, ex-PBZ Card; part of Nexi Group). Fully reachable, static HTML, EN and HR versions. Root www.nexi.hr 301-redirects to /hr/ (expected, not dead). No downloadable reports/financials on site; site is marketing/corporate-info only.

balkaninsight.com.recommended_method: Poll WP REST API /wp-json/wp/v2/posts filtered by tag/category ids (resolve slugs via /wp/v2/tags and /wp/v2/categories), paginate with per_page&page, and use after=<ISO date> for incremental collection. Alternatively subscribe to per-tag RSS feeds e.g. https://balkaninsight.com/tag/central-bank-of-albania/feed/ for lightweight monitoring.

api.params: per_page, page, tags (numeric id), categories, search, after/before (ISO dates), _fields; tag slug->id via /wp/v2/tags?slug=central-bank-of-albania (id 91933)

balkaninsight.com.next_action: Build collector against WP REST API with the tag/category ids relevant to each country; schedule incremental pulls via after= param
balkaninsight.com.notes: Serves all four countries (Albania, Bosnia, Bulgaria, Croatia) — regional English-language press. All sample URLs (homepage, /tag/central-bank-of-albania/, /tag/croatian-ministry-of-finance/, /category/bi/croatia/croatia-business/) returned HTTP 200. Category/tag pages map cleanly to REST API filters.

fibank.al.recommended_method: Scrape the reports listing page https://www.fibank.al/raporte-vjetore/ (Albanian) or /en/raporte-vjetore/ to extract PDF links hosted on the S3 bucket fibank-media.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com, then download each annual report PDF (14 years, 2012-2025 available). Same pattern for /pasqyrat-financiare/ financial statements. Parse /lajme/ for news and /en/karriera/ for jobs.
fibank.al.error_reason: Homepage root https://www.fibank.al/ returns HTTP 404 (both HEAD and GET, serves ~456KB soft-404 page); use https://www.fibank.al/en/ (200) as entry point instead
fibank.al.next_action: Automate PDF harvesting from the reports/financial-statements listing pages; monitor /lajme/ (news) and /en/karriera/ (jobs) for early-intent signals
fibank.al.notes: Albania only. All PDFs are on public S3 bucket fibank-media.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com (no auth). Dead URL: https://www.fibank.al/ (root) returns 404 — use language-prefixed paths (/en/ or /raporte-vjetore/ etc) which all work. Bilingual Albanian/English.

www2.aop.bg.resource_type: statistics/open-data portal (data.egov.bg REST API) + Excel + HTML register (app.eop.bg)
www2.aop.bg.recommended_method: Pull ROP open datasets programmatically from data.egov.bg via its REST API (AOP organisation profile) using a registered api_key; use the opendata_fields_mapping.xlsx for schema. For live tender notices, scrape/query the CAIS EOP platform at app.eop.bg/today/reporting/search.

api.endpoint: https://data.egov.bg/api/ (Bulgarian national open-data portal REST API; AOP org id e9a95e08-7759-497a-a478-55f331d59447). Notices/register UI: https://app.eop.bg/today/reporting/search
api.params: org_id / dataset resource uri, locale, api_key
api.format: JSON / CSV / XML (data.egov.bg); XLSX on aop.bg
api.headers: Accept: application/json; requires api_key parameter for authenticated calls
api.auth_needed: Public open data; some endpoints require a free api_key. Direct unauthenticated calls returned 403 in this test.

download.type: Excel (xlsx) field mapping + Приложение_2.xlsx data sample; full open datasets via data.egov.bg

www2.aop.bg.next_action: Register a free data.egov.bg api_key, enumerate AOP org datasets via getOrganisationDatasets/getResourceData, and confirm CAIS EOP (app.eop.bg) search reproducibility.
www2.aop.bg.notes: Serves Bulgaria. Primary A2 procurement source. Best machine-readable path is the national open-data portal data.egov.bg (AOP org), not the wp CMS. No dead sample URLs. WebFetch of the open-data page returned 403 (WAF) but curl with UA worked.

portal.registryagency.bg.recommended_method: For company-level A1/A2/A5 lookups, drive the SPA with a headless browser (capture the /CR/api XHR JSON) or subscribe to the official BRRA commercial-register data service for bulk feeds. Not reproducible via plain HTTP.

api.endpoint: SPA calls backend JSON endpoints under /CR/api/* (not reproduced). BRRA also offers a separate paid/registered bulk data web service (SOAP/REST 'data service') for the commercial register.
api.params: search criteria (company name/EIK/UIC); backend endpoints require the app's session/anti-forgery tokens
api.format: JSON (UI backend); XML/SOAP for the registered data service
api.headers: Session cookies + CSRF token required; browser session needed
api.auth_needed: Public single lookups are free but JS/session-gated; bulk/programmatic access requires registration and a paid subscription to the BRRA data service.

portal.registryagency.bg.error_reason: JS-only SPA; internal API session/token-gated; bulk feed behind registration/paywall
portal.registryagency.bg.next_action: Use headless browser automation to capture the /CR/api search XHR, or evaluate the paid BRRA data service subscription for bulk company data.
portal.registryagency.bg.notes: Serves Bulgaria. Official Commercial Register (BRRA). Public UI is a JS SPA; automated collection needs headless browser or the registered/paid data service. No dead sample URLs.

fmfib.bg.recommended_method: Scrape the buyer-profile page (https://fmfib.bg/proceduri) for A2 procurement procedures and the news page (https://fmfib.bg/en/novini or /bg/novini) for A5/A6 signals. Static server-rendered HTML; simple HTTP+HTML parsing works.
fmfib.bg.next_action: Confirm current news path (/novini vs /en/novini) and buyer-profile item listing structure for the scraper.
fmfib.bg.notes: Serves Bulgaria. Static CMS site; www. host 301-redirects to apex fmfib.bg and legacy paths redirect to new slugs (buyer -> /proceduri, struktura -> /ekip-i-struktura). Sample URLs all resolve via redirects; note the old /bg/page/7-struktura and /bg/buyer slugs are now moved.

disclosures.ifc.org.resource_type: JSON API / CSV download (World Bank Data Catalog & Finances One); source portal is a dashboard/SPA
disclosures.ifc.org.recommended_method: Do NOT scrape the JS disclosure portal. Pull the 'IFC Investment Services Projects' (0037737/DS00499) and 'IFC Advisory Services Projects' (0037738) CSV from the World Bank Data Catalog API, then filter rows by Country = Albania / Bosnia and Herzegovina and industry = Financial Institutions Group for A1/A2/A6. Refresh daily.

api.endpoint: https://datacatalogapi.worldbank.org/ddhxext/DatasetDownload?dataset_unique_id=0037737 (World Bank Data Catalog download API). Portal search UI: https://disclosures.ifc.org/search?Type_Description=Investment&sortBy=Disclosed_Date&sortOrder=desc
api.params: dataset_unique_id=0037737 (Investment) / 0037738 (Advisory), version_id, format; portal search params Type_Description, Project_Type, country/industry filters, sortBy, sortOrder, page
api.headers: None required for public catalog; rate-limited (returned HTTP 429 'rate limit exceeded' — confirms live public endpoint)

download.type: CSV (full IFC Investment Services Projects dataset; also Advisory 0037738)

disclosures.ifc.org.error_reason: Source portal disclosures.ifc.org is JS-only (returns app shell / 403 to WebFetch on /project-disclosures); mitigated by the catalog dataset API.
disclosures.ifc.org.next_action: Retrieve DatasetDownload CSV (respect rate limit/backoff), map schema, and set country filters for Albania & Bosnia; optionally use Finances One dataset view for pre-filtered country subsets.
disclosures.ifc.org.notes: Referenced by Albania and Bosnia. The disclosures.ifc.org SPA is not directly scrapable, but the same data is open on WBG Data Catalog / Finances One as downloadable CSV + public API (rate-limited). No dead sample URLs; duplicate homepage URL in sample list.

unicreditbulbank.bg.resource_type: HTML page listing direct-download PDFs (+ JSON API and careers/news HTML sub-pages)
unicreditbulbank.bg.recommended_method: Use an HTTP client (curl/requests) with a browser User-Agent (WebFetch/default UAs are 403-blocked by the WAF; JS not required). Scrape the Financial Reports HTML index and collect the /media/filer_public/... PDF hrefs for annual reports & disclosures (A1). Poll the /bg/api/fxrates/featured.json JSON endpoint for FX market data (A4). Scrape /bg/za-nas/media/novini/ and ?page=N for press releases, and /bg/za-nas/karieri/svobodni-pozitsii/ (+/en/about-us/careers/vacancies/) with ?page=N for jobs (A5).

api.params: none (static path); a full/all-currencies variant likely exists under /bg/api/fxrates/
api.headers: Browser User-Agent recommended (default/bot UAs get 403); no auth/cookies needed

unicreditbulbank.bg.error_reason: One sample URL (supplier info) returns HTTP 404 persistently; WebFetch default returns HTTP 403 (WAF bot-block) but curl with browser UA returns 200
unicreditbulbank.bg.next_action: Build scraper for the Financial Reports PDF index and the FX JSON API; drop the dead supplier-info URL (utility bill-pay list, not procurement — low A2 relevance) or relocate via site search if bill-pay providers are wanted.
unicreditbulbank.bg.notes: Serves Bulgaria. UniCredit Bulbank (largest BG bank). All access works over plain HTTP with a browser User-Agent; no login/JS/CAPTCHA. Dead sample: informaciya-za-dostavchici (404, Google-indexed but removed) — note it was a utility bill-payment providers list, not procurement suppliers. RSS at /rss/ redirects to homepage (none). FX JSON API is a bonus market-data source.

joberty.com.recommended_method: Render with a headless browser (JS required). Homepage/listing returns only a ~3.6KB React shell via curl and WebFetch shows no listings. Capture the internal XHR/fetch (likely a JSON/GraphQL endpoint on api.joberty.com or /api) via browser devtools/network capture, then reproduce with proper User-Agent/headers. Paginate via page= and sort=created.
joberty.com.error_reason: JS-only (empty app shell served to non-browser clients)
joberty.com.next_action: Load listing in headless browser, inspect Network tab for the jobs JSON/GraphQL endpoint, then reproduce outside browser
joberty.com.notes: Croatia. JS SPA; no public API documented. Listing pages reachable but content client-rendered. Serves Croatia via /hr/ path with location=Croatia filter.

sredisnjanabava.gov.hr.recommended_method: Static HTML page is scrapable directly (curl/WebFetch both return 200). For real procurement/contract-award datasets, collect from the EOJN RH bulletin (eojn.nn.hr) which is the successor/authoritative system this office points to; the gov.hr page itself only offers guidance PDFs.

download.url: https://sredisnjanabava.gov.hr/ (REGISTAR_UPUTE 0.4.pdf, UPUTE korisnicima novi EOJN registar.pdf)

sredisnjanabava.gov.hr.next_action: Scrape register page for framework-agreement listings; set up EOJN RH (eojn.nn.hr/Oglasnik) as the primary tender/award data source
sredisnjanabava.gov.hr.notes: Croatia. A1/A2 central procurement. Page reachable, static HTML. Actual dataset is on EOJN, not on this domain.

udrugafranak.hr.recommended_method: Direct HTML scraping of WordPress site (LiteSpeed, HTTP 200). Use date/category archive listings (sidebar 2011-2026) to enumerate posts; optionally try WordPress REST API at /wp-json/wp/v2/posts for structured JSON.
udrugafranak.hr.next_action: Scrape WordPress posts; test /wp-json/wp/v2/posts for JSON feed
udrugafranak.hr.notes: Croatia. WordPress advocacy site; static-scrapable articles on bank/HNB complaints and CHF disputes.

hrvatska.posta.hr.recommended_method: Scrape via curl/HTTP client with a normal browser User-Agent. Cloudflare returns 403 to WebFetch but curl GET returns HTTP 200 with static HTML containing many 'nabav' references and ~9 linked .pdf documents. Collect procurement PDFs and careers listings from /hr/zaposljavanje/304.
hrvatska.posta.hr.error_reason: WebFetch blocked (Cloudflare 403); curl works with UA
hrvatska.posta.hr.next_action: Set collector User-Agent to a browser string; scrape procurement PDFs and careers HTML
hrvatska.posta.hr.notes: Croatia. Cloudflare-fronted but reachable via curl. Static HTML + PDF tender docs.

novac.hr.recommended_method: novac.hr 301-redirects (novac.hr -> novac.jutarnji.hr -> www.jutarnji.hr/novac). Point the collector at the final URL https://www.jutarnji.hr/novac. Scrape article listings; consider RSS if available at jutarnji.hr. Note Hanza Media titles may have article paywalls.
novac.hr.next_action: Update tracker URL to https://www.jutarnji.hr/novac; check for RSS feed and paywall behavior
novac.hr.notes: Croatia. Domain moved/merged into Jutarnji list. Original novac.hr URLs are dead (redirect only).

croatiabanka.hr.recommended_method: Direct HTML scraping (Microsoft-IIS, HTTP 200). Job vacancies are inline HTML text (title, location, deadline, status), not PDFs. Homepage 302-redirects to /naslovnica/. Poll the natjecaji page for new/cancelled postings.
croatiabanka.hr.next_action: Scrape careers HTML page on schedule for job posting titles/deadlines
croatiabanka.hr.notes: Croatia. Small state-owned bank. Static HTML careers listings; current 3 postings marked cancelled.

etranet.hr.recommended_method: Direct HTML scraping (Apache, HTTP 200). Rich vendor profile: product lines, hardware partnerships, client list (OTP, Raiffeisen, HT, INA, Splitska banka). Scrape o-nama, products, and any news/reference pages for competitor/vendor mapping.
etranet.hr.next_action: Scrape company + product/reference pages for vendor-competitor dataset
etranet.hr.notes: Croatia. Static HTML corporate site; high-value A6 source (payment terminal vendor with named bank clients).

infobiz.fina.hr.recommended_method: Scrape individual company pages by OIB slug (pattern /tvrtka/{name-slug}/OIB-{oib}) — these render headline financials publicly (revenue, EBIT, EBITDA, net profit, employee count, sector rank) as confirmed for Printec Croatia. Page is JS-rendered so use a headless browser or capture the underlying JSON XHR. Deep/full financial statements and bulk access sit behind FINA's paid packages + login; do not attempt to bypass. Company OIBs can be enumerated from other sources.
infobiz.fina.hr.error_reason: curl to /, /landing and common paths returns HTTP 404 (bot/UA filtering); WebFetch of root and company page succeed
infobiz.fina.hr.next_action: Use headless browser or captured JSON endpoint to pull per-company headline financials; treat detailed data as paid/manual
infobiz.fina.hr.notes: Croatia. Authoritative FINA financial registry. Sample /landing URL 404s to curl but the site works via browser; company pages public with headline data, deeper data paywalled. Serves Croatia.

monitor.al.recommended_method: Poll the RSS feeds on a schedule: main feed https://monitor.al/feed/ and topic feeds https://monitor.al/financa/feed/, https://monitor.al/ekonomi/feed/, https://monitor.al/teknologji/feed/, https://monitor.al/biznes/feed/. These pass Cloudflare with a plain curl/HTTP client and return structured items (title, link, pubDate, dc:creator, content:encoded). For full-text or search/date filtering the WP REST API (/wp-json/wp/v2/posts) is available but requires a browser session (Cloudflare-Chrome/Playwright) since GET requests hit a managed challenge.

api.params: per_page, page, categories, search, after, before, _fields (standard WP REST params)
api.headers: none required by WP, but Cloudflare challenge blocks non-browser clients
api.auth_needed: No login, but Cloudflare managed challenge (JS+cookies) blocks plain HTTP clients on GET

monitor.al.next_action: Configure RSS polling of the main + category feeds for automated collection; optionally add a browser-session fetcher for the WP REST API if full-text/date-range querying is needed.
monitor.al.notes: Albania. WordPress 7.0.2 site. All 14 sample URLs reachable (200). The /en/ URL https://monitor.al/en/nderhyrjet-e-bankes-se-shqiperise-nga-ulja-e-komisioneve-tek-instant-payments/ 301-redirects to the Albanian article (no separate English edition). RSS feeds are the reliable, Cloudflare-passing access path; WP REST API exists but is gated by Cloudflare managed challenge for non-browser HTTP clients. No dead sample URLs.

imf.org.recommended_method: For A4 market statistics: call the IMF DataMapper JSON API (no auth, tested working) or the new SDMX 2.1 API at api.imf.org for FSI/IFS/WEO series per ISO3 (ALB/BIH/BGR/HRV). For A1/A3 Article IV, FSAP and Staff Country Reports: use a headless/authenticated browser session (Cloudflare/Akamai bot protection returns 403 to curl and WebFetch); discover new reports via the country hubs (imf.org/en/countries/{alb,bih,bgr,hrv}) and the CR series listing (imf.org/en/publications/cr), then fetch the PDF via browser. elibrary.imf.org also hosts each report as XML/PDF but is equally bot-protected.

api.endpoint: https://www.imf.org/external/datamapper/api/v1/{INDICATOR}/{ISO3} (e.g. .../NGDP_RPCH/BIH); indicator list at https://www.imf.org/external/datamapper/api/v1/indicators ; country list at .../api/v1/countries . Newer SDMX: https://api.imf.org/external/sdmx/2.1/dataflow and /data/...
api.params: Path params: indicator code (WEO/FSI/etc) + ISO3 country (BIH, ALB, BGR, HRV); DataMapper also accepts multiple countries; SDMX API uses standard dataflow/data/{key} with startPeriod/endPeriod query params
api.headers: None required for DataMapper; standard Accept header for SDMX format negotiation

imf.org.error_reason: 403 Forbidden on all imf.org and elibrary.imf.org HTML/PDF pages via curl and WebFetch (bot protection); DataMapper /api/v1/countries/BIH intermittently returned an 'under maintenance' apology page while other API paths returned live data
imf.org.next_action: Wire the DataMapper/SDMX APIs directly for statistics. For reports, stand up a browser-based fetcher (or use IMF Search Hub / elibrary) to pull Article IV/FSAP PDFs for ALB, BIH, BGR, HRV; validate the report-download step manually once through a browser session.
imf.org.notes: Global source referenced by Albania, Bosnia, Bulgaria (and relevant to Croatia). Statistics side fully reproducible via free JSON/SDMX APIs; report side needs a browser due to bot protection. Dead/blocked sample URLs: bs/Countries/BIH redirects to a 404 (Bosnian-language IMF path does not exist — use English pages); en/countries/bih, en/countries/alb, publications/cr series page, and the Bulgaria PR article all return 403 to automation. No true Bosnian-language IMF site exists; use /en/ paths.

hub.hr.resource_type: HTML pages + PDF reports + RSS feeds (Drupal); PSD2 directory links to bank APIs
hub.hr.recommended_method: Plain HTTP GET (curl/requests, no JS, no auth). Poll the RSS feed(s) at /hr/taxonomy/term/<id>/feed for new items (press releases, analize), scrape section landing pages (hub-analize, pregledi-i-izgledi, istrazivanja, EU-regulativa, registri) for article links, and download report PDFs from /sites/default/files/inline-files/. For PSD2 (A6/A1): grab the API spec (YAML/ZIP) and the table of 14 bank developer-portal URLs (Addiko oapideveloper.addiko.hr, PBZ apiportal.pbz.hr, OTP api.otpbanka.hr, etc.).

download.type: PDF (Excel/YAML/ZIP also present on PSD2 page)

hub.hr.next_action: Enumerate taxonomy term IDs per section for RSS polling; schedule periodic scrape of section pages + inline-files PDF downloads; capture PSD2 bank portal list for vendor/competitor workstream.
hub.hr.notes: Croatia. Croatian Banking Association (HUB) — covers A1 (bank/sector disclosures), A3 (EU regulativa, SEPA/PSD2 deadlines), A4 (HUB Analize/Pregledi i izgledi market stats + chief-economist outlook survey), A6 (PSD2 bank developer portals, scheme participant registers). Standard Drupal static-HTML site, fully reachable, no login/paywall/JS. All 15 sample URLs returned HTTP 200. Both www.hub.hr and hub.hr resolve. PSD2 page is a directory (not a live API) linking to individual bank ASPSP portals.

rbinternational.com.resource_type: HTML page with direct PDF/Excel(XLSM)/ZIP downloads
rbinternational.com.recommended_method: Static HTTP GET. Scrape the results-reports / annual-reports / quarterly-reports / press-releases HTML pages for anchor hrefs matching '/content/dam/rbi/...coredownload.<ext>' then GET each file directly (no login/cookies/JS needed). File-naming is date-prefixed and predictable. Poll quarterly (Q reports ~May/Aug/Nov) and annually (FY ~late Feb/Mar).

download.type: PDF (annual report); also XLSM databooks, ZIP ESEF, PDF financial statements

rbinternational.com.next_action: Build a scraper that harvests '.coredownload.' hrefs from the IR and media-hub pages; optionally add Raiffeisen Research CEE Banking Sector report page for A4 market statistics.
rbinternational.com.notes: Parent group Raiffeisen Bank International AG (Vienna, Austria); referenced by Albania, Bosnia, Croatia trackers for the SEE segment (subsidiaries Raiffeisen Bank Albania, RB Bosna i Hercegovina, Raiffeisenbank Austria d.d. Croatia). All 15 sample URLs resolve (HTTP 200); results-reports/reports/annual-reports.html 301-normalizes to results-reports/annual-reports.html. Adobe Experience Manager site; downloads served via predictable /content/dam/...coredownload paths. No dead sample URLs.

api.params: DATABASE_ID=WB_FINDEX (required); optional REF_AREA=ALB|BGR|HRV (ISO3), INDICATOR=<code>, TIME_PERIOD, skip/top for paging. Indicator list: https://data360api.worldbank.org/data360/indicators?datasetId=WB_FINDEX
api.format: JSON (count + value[] of observations: OBS_VALUE, INDICATOR, REF_AREA, TIME_PERIOD, SEX, AGE, UNIT_MEASURE, etc.)

data360.worldbank.org.next_action: Enumerate needed WB_FINDEX indicator codes and pull ALB/BGR/HRV series via the tested JSON API.
data360.worldbank.org.notes: High-priority A4 market stats for Albania, Bulgaria, Croatia. Clean unauthenticated JSON API confirmed working. Note: query param is REF_AREA not the sample 'country'; metadata endpoint needs different param but data works fine.

financa.gov.al.resource_type: HTML pages (WordPress) with PDF report attachments; statistics/publications hub
financa.gov.al.recommended_method: Site sits behind Imperva/Incapsula bot protection: plain curl, WebFetch and the headless preview browser all receive a 200 JS-challenge page (iframe /_Incapsula_Resource) instead of content, including for direct wp-content/uploads PDF URLs. Collect via a full real/stealth browser (e.g. Playwright/Puppeteer with realistic fingerprint) that executes the Incapsula JS challenge to obtain the visid_incap/incap_ses session cookies, then reuse those cookies to fetch the WordPress PDF URLs (pattern financa.gov.al/wp-content/uploads/YYYY/MM/*.pdf). PDF URLs are discoverable via Google/site search or by scraping the section listing pages (e.g. /rezultatet-e-ankandeve-te-titujve-qeveritare/, /raporti-mujor-i-titujve-qeveritare/, /buletini-statistikor-i-borxhit/) once the challenge cookie is held. English versions available at /en/<same-slug>/.
financa.gov.al.error_reason: Blocked: Imperva/Incapsula JS bot challenge (HTTP 200 but body is a ~950-byte challenge with iframe to /_Incapsula_Resource; 'Request unsuccessful. Incapsula incident ID: ...'). Headless preview browser hung on the challenge (screenshot/get_page_text timed out).
financa.gov.al.next_action: Assign to browser-session collector: run a stealth headless browser against the section listing pages to solve the Incapsula challenge, harvest PDF links, then download PDFs with the acquired cookies. Alternatively cross-check auction/securities data against Bank of Albania (bankofalbania.org/Markets/Auctions_of_the_Government/), which publishes the same primary auction results and is reachable without bot protection.
financa.gov.al.notes: Serves Albania. Highly relevant (workstreams A1/A2/A3/A4/A5): government securities, public debt, auctions, issuance calendars, eurobonds - core banking/payments market intel. All 15 sample URLs are live (HTTP 200) but every request from automated tools is intercepted by Imperva/Incapsula, so no sample URL could be content-validated programmatically - none are truly 'dead', they are gated. Real report files live under financa.gov.al/wp-content/uploads/. arkiva.financa.gov.al is an unprotected archive of the older site (useful for historical data). Bank of Albania is a clean alternative for auction results.

api.params: limit, offset, observations=1 (include values), dimensions (JSON filter), format=csv|json, align_periods
